About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
10 The Role: Senior Consultant – Critical Minerals
Join S&P Global's critical minerals consulting team and work on the supply chain, pricing and policy questions shaping the energy transition, for governments, miners, manufacturers and investors, with direct exposure to senior industry leaders and policy makers.
This role will contribute to the growth of our global critical minerals consulting team and to the execution of our broader Energy Transition team’s projects for private and public sector clients by providing analytical rigor, expertise in model development, and the ability to develop complex analytical work on small and large consulting projects, working under the direction of a Principal Consultant or Project Manager.
The Senior Consultant, focused primarily on critical minerals but with working knowledge of adjacent energy transition topics, is expected to strengthen our critical minerals consulting capabilities and work closely with clients and internal consulting team members to deliver their workstreams on time and to a high standard.
The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work with a dynamic team of consultants and experts with wide-ranging backgrounds in energy and the energy transition. The varied and changing nature of our projects leads to development of a diverse set of skills, and exposure to different industries and clients. As a Senior Consultant, you will be mentored by experienced managers and directors, gain exposure to client leadership, and have a clear route to grow within the team.
Responsibilities:
• Deliver analytical workstreams: Own and deliver analytical workstreams within larger projects, working with a Principal Consultant or Project Manager to produce on-time, client-ready outputs.
• Build models: Build and maintain models covering supply, demand, pricing, costs, and valuation across critical minerals value chains, including energy transition scenarios.
• Generate insights: Synthesize market intelligence on critical minerals and low-carbon technologies into clear, evidence-based insights for client deliverables.
• Engage clients: Conduct client metings and workshops, and present recommendations alongside project leads.
• Support business development: Draft proposal sections, join scoping calls, drive some of the IP development within our critical minerals consulting team.
• Strengthen the team: Review colleagues' analysis and give constructive feedback to raise project quality.
What We’re Looking For:
• Typically 2–5 years of experience in industry, management consulting, or finance, with demonstrated exposure to metals and mining, critical minerals, or energy markets.
• Solid mineral economics skills and a working knowledge of the metals and mining industry and critical minerals are key for this position.
• Exposure to energy or minerals value chains, including production, processing, distribution, or end-use consumption, and technical experience in areas such as chemical processing or process engineering, is valued.
• Demonstrated ability to conduct quantitative data analysis, build structured models, and translate complex datasets into clear, evidence-based insights and recommendations.
• A team player: good communication and collaboration are critical success factors in this role.
• Bachelor’s degree (BS/BSc) in Engineering, Earth Sciences, Economics, Finance, or a closely related discipline. A post-graduate degree (Master’s or MBA) in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related technical or scientific discipline is preferred.
• Demonstrated written and oral presentation skills in English, including the ability to prepare and deliver structured client-ready materials to professional audiences. Proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese (written and spoken) is preferred.
• Preferred: direct experience in metals and mining (in a strategy, finance, or operational role) or critical minerals supply chain analysis; management consulting experience with energy, mining, or commodities clients; and an understanding of energy transition dynamics, including low-carbon technologies, renewable energy, energy storage, hydrogen, or carbon markets.
Expectations:
• Some travel is required, with an average around 20% of the time (but could occasionally be more)
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate in team-oriented environments, contributing ideas and constructive feedback across multidisciplinary project teams.

About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
08 The Team:
Enterprise Solutions is building a new AI team to turn ambitious ideas into practical solutions used across a global business. Each Associate will align with a business line or function while collaborating as one team across New York, London, and Dallas.
As part of this new team, you will help shape its ways of working, technology, and standards while developing AI solutions with the potential to scale across Enterprise Solutions. You will have access to S&P Global’s data, market expertise, and complex, real-world business challenges.
The Associate, Applied AI Solutions is a hands-on builder role for someone who wants to explore what AI can accomplish in practice. You will identify high-value opportunities, rapidly prototype and rigorously validate ideas, and help deploy AI-enabled solutions that business teams trust and use.
Responsibilities and Impact:
• Discover and diagnose business processes: Partner with teams across Enterprise Solutions to map workflows, identify inefficiencies, and determine which business problems are suitable for AI or automation.
• Design, build, and test AI solutions: Create and iterate on prompts, agent workflows, assistants, and automation concepts using modern AI tools, Microsoft 365, Python, JavaScript, PowerPoint, and related analytics technologies.
• Validate solutions rigorously: Evaluate outputs for accuracy, reliability, usefulness, and repeatability; identify failure modes; and clearly document the limits of what each solution can be trusted to do.
• Measure and communicate impact: Quantify time saved, manual steps reduced, error rates improved, and other business outcomes. Present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and Enterprise Solutions leadership.
• Document solutions and enable adoption: Develop process documentation, playbooks, user guides, and support materials. Lead walkthroughs, office hours, and training sessions that help business teams use solutions effectively and strengthen their AI fluency.
• Build for repeatability and scale: Contribute shared prompt patterns, templates, evaluation methods, and starter kits. Take increasing ownership of business problems from discovery through delivery and help move successful pilots into repeatable operating practices.
First-Year Expectations
Days 1–30: Orientation and Immersion
Learn the Enterprise Solutions landscape, data environment, tooling, governance expectations, and current AI enablement priorities. Shadow live business processes and develop hands-on familiarity with internal AI platforms.
Days 31–90: Capstone Build
Scope, build, and test an AI solution for a real business problem with support from a project sponsor and mentor. Demonstrate practical value, document the solution clearly, and present results and recommended next steps to Enterprise Solutions leadership.
Months 4–6: Depth and Repeatability
Contribute to additional use cases, improve reusable team standards, support stakeholder enablement, and demonstrate consistent judgment in solution design, testing, documentation, and business adoption.
Months 7–12: Autonomous Execution and Scale
Take increasingly independent ownership of business problems from discovery through delivery. Manage stakeholder relationships with appropriate guidance, identify opportunities for scalable reuse, and help move successful solutions from pilot concepts into repeatable operating practices.

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $85,000 to $90,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience using modern AI technologies, such as Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, large language models, AI assistants, or agent-building tools, to complete practical work.

About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
10 The Team
Dividend Forecasting at S&P Global provides announcements and forecasts for dividend amounts and dates for more than 40,000 stocks globally, as well as dividend index points and equity and fixed-income ETF distributions. Forecasts are up to five to ten years in the future, subject to availability and region. Dividend forecasts are a key input used to price options, futures, structured products, as well as key inputs in portfolio management decisions and risk monitoring. Our main customers include investment banks, hedge funds, portfolio managers, asset managers, risk managers and derivatives exchanges.
Responsibilities and Impact:
• Build dividend forecasts for North American and LATAM equities. Apply bottom-up fundamental analysis — drawing on financial statements, company guidance, historical distributions, and peer group trends — to generate high-accuracy dividend forecasts, gaining direct exposure to how leading companies plan and execute their capital allocation strategies.
• Author institutional-grade research. Produce dividend research papers at sector, country, and regional level, contributing to S&P Global's Market Intelligence offering and to the continued growth of the team's methodological capabilities.
• Monitor markets and assess dividend impact in real time. Track news flow and corporate announcements for North American and LATAM coverage, evaluating their implications for dividend policy and updating forecasts to remain current under fast-moving market conditions.
• Model forward-looking dividend payment schedules. Generate and maintain dividend payment schedules with a clear understanding of how dividend forecasts influence the pricing and risk management of equity derivatives — including options and futures.
• Deliver bespoke client analysis. Respond to daily research requests from investment banks, hedge funds, and derivatives exchanges with timely, tailored analysis — establishing yourself as a trusted expert counterpart to some of the world's most sophisticated institutional investors.
• Engage directly with companies. Build and sustain relationships with investor relations departments across your coverage universe, gathering first-hand insight into corporate capital allocation plans to deepen forecast accuracy and analytical quality.
• Public speaking and client-facing activities . Willingness to collaborate in client meetings, webinars and conferences.
• ETFs and product innovation . Handle ETF-distribution forecast related operations, collaborate in improving our ETF dividend forecast engine and willingness to participate in product innovation activities to expand the Dividend Forecasting product suite to collaborate with the Dividend Forecasting team revenue growth and market expansion targets.

• Demonstrated ability to manage, validate, and analyse large volumes of time-sensitive financial data to strict processing deadlines, maintaining a high degree of accuracy throughout.
• Demonstrated ability to produce clear, structured written financial analysis suitable for stakeholder review.

Location: NYC: 55 water street, two days per week onsite.
Role Overview
The AI Data Engineer will specialize in building and optimizing machine learning data pipelines, focusing on AI model tracking, lifecycle management, and integration with AI governance systems. This role combines data engineering expertise with AI/ML knowledge to support the organization's broader data and AI infrastructure initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
• Design and implement specialized data pipelines for AI model metadata, training data lineage, and model performance metrics tracking.

• Develop MCP servers and enable AI data distribution via MCP.
• Develop feature engineering pipelines and data preprocessing workflows for AI model training and inference.
• Implement model versioning, experiment tracking, and model registry integration using MLflow or similar tools.
• Create automated workflows for AI agent discovery, classification, and inventory management across the enterprise.
• Design and maintain knowledge graph structures for representing AI model relationships, dependencies, and data lineage.
• Build real-time data pipelines for AI model monitoring, drift detection, and performance tracking.
• Develop data quality frameworks specific to AI training datasets and validation data.

• Create comprehensive documentation for AI data architectures, schemas, and integration patterns.

• Deep understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including model training, deployment, and monitoring processes.
• Experience with feature engineering, data preprocessing techniques, and ML data pipelines.
• Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and similarity search for AI applications.
• Proficiency in SQL for structured and unstructured data management.
• Understanding of data governance, model governance, and AI ethics principles.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to data quality.
• Excellent collaboration skills for working with data scientists, ML engineers, and architects.

Preferred/Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with generative AI applications, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and fine-tuning.
• Knowledge of LangChain, HuggingFace, or other GenAI frameworks.
• Familiarity with Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI platforms.
• Experience with graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) for knowledge graph implementation.
• Understanding of AI model explainability and interpretability techniques.
• Experience with A/B testing frameworks for ML model evaluation.
• Certification in Databricks, AWS, Azure, or GCP AI/ML services.
• Publications or contributions to open-source ML projects

The Manager, Fraud Investigation and Prevention leads a team responsible for complex fraud investigations and fraud prevention, detection, and response activities. This role oversees investigative casework, evaluates fraud trends and intelligence, and helps develop controls, processes, and solutions that protect clients, employees, information, and assets. The manager partners closely with business stakeholders to address fraud risks, resolve escalated matters, and strengthen fraud prevention and detection capabilities. The role also develops investigators through coaching, training, performance management, and fraud education programs.
Responsibilities:
• Lead a team responsible for fraud investigations, prevention, detection, incident response, and case resolution.
• Hire, coach, develop, and supervise investigators, providing performance guidance, training, mentoring, and ongoing development.
• Oversee complex fraud investigations and determine appropriate actions and resolutions needed to close cases.
• Review case chronologies, investigative findings, reports, fraud trends, and intelligence to identify emerging risks and mitigation opportunities.
• Develop and implement processes and controls designed to prevent, detect, and respond to fraudulent activity.
• Evaluate fraud prevention and detection systems, tools, and proposed solutions for potential implementation.
• Partner with business units and stakeholders to recommend and implement fraud prevention, detection, and response measures and controls.
• Analyze complex fraud situations, resolve escalated matters, and recommend practical solutions involving systems, policies, procedures, or controls.
• Maintain internal and external relationships that support the gathering and exchange of actionable fraud and security intelligence.
• Ensure fraud and security policies and procedures remain consistent with established standards and practices.
• Deliver fraud and enterprise security education, training, awareness, onboarding, and guidance on fraud control methods and investigation practices.
• Support projects and initiatives involving fraud prevention, fraud detection, investigations, security intelligence, and related controls.
Qualifications
• Minimum of five years related work experience, with two years of fraud investigation and prevention experience. Supervisory experience preferred.
• Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred.
• Professional certification (CFE) required.

Shape the Workflow Solutions That Power FAS Sales and Enhance Advisor Experience
Vanguard's Financial Advisor Services (FAS) organization relies on workflow technology to help Sales and service teams efficiently support financial advisors and intermediary clients. Two Appian-based applications are at the center of these workflows today:
Advisor & Intermediary Request Management (AIRM). AIRM supports request management for the Sales Development Desk (SDD) and Client Account Administration (CAA), including strategist engagements, literature and gift orders, website support, advisor access management, and intermediary client requests.
Service Request Tool (SRT). SRT enables FAS Sales to request consulting services from investment strategists and other subject-matter experts across FAS.
We are seeking a Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for SRT and AIRM while defining the future of workflow solutions across FAS. This role will identify opportunities to simplify workflows, integrate systems, reduce manual work, and use automation and AI to improve how FAS serves advisors and intermediaries.
Role Overview
As the FAS Workflow Solutions Product Manager, you will own the strategy and evolution of business-critical workflow products that help FAS scale its services efficiently and consistently. You will deeply understand user workflows and business problems, set product direction, decide what to build and why, and make prioritization decisions based on customer and business value, data, risk, and technical feasibility.
You will work across Sales, the Sales Development Desk, Client Account Administration, strategist teams, engineering, architecture, and other partners to take opportunities from discovery through delivery and adoption. And, you will define measurable outcomes and use data to determine whether the solutions we build are creating meaningful value.
What You'll Own
Product Strategy & Roadmap
• Define and communicate a clear, forward-looking vision and roadmap for SRT and AIRM that aligns with FAS business objectives and enterprise architecture.
• Define the future-state workflow product strategy for FAS, including how existing platforms, integrations, automation, and AI should evolve to meet changing business needs.
• Lead continuous product discovery with Sales, SDD, CAA, strategists, and other users to understand end-to-end workflows, identify root problems, test assumptions, and translate insights into product opportunities.
• Prioritize competing opportunities using customer insight, data, projected business value, risk reduction, technical feasibility, and effort.
• Define measurable product outcomes before significant investments are made. Track results such as hours saved, turnaround time, adoption, capacity created, and service quality, and use those results to inform future investment.
Delivery & Execution
• Own and refine the product backlog, making scope and sequencing trade-offs based on user and business value, compliance, data availability, integration complexity, technical health, and team capacity.
• Partner with engineering, technology delivery, architecture, and production support to ensure reliable delivery and operation of the products, making appropriate trade-offs across new capabilities, technical health, defects, and risk.
• Lead change management and adoption planning so that new capabilities translate into sustained user and business value.
• Balance priorities across stakeholder groups and keep leaders informed through clear, outcome-oriented updates on decisions, roadmap progress, risks, and value delivered.
AI-Enabled Workflow
• Identify and deliver AI capabilities that reduce manual effort and improve service quality, including AI-assisted email intake, request triage and classification, routing, summarization, and next-best actions.
• Evaluate emerging capabilities, including Appian Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, to improve workflow efficiency, interoperability, and the user experience.
• Partner with technology, risk, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure AI-enabled capabilities are useful, reliable, explainable, and appropriate for production use.
Product Analytics & Metrics
• Define the product instrumentation, metrics, and reporting needed to understand demand, workflow performance, capacity, adoption, and business outcomes.
• Establish and monitor measures such as turnaround time and SLA performance, request volume, aging items, strategist capacity, adoption, user satisfaction, hours saved, and service quality.
• Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to identify opportunities, evaluate product performance, and guide roadmap and investment decisions.
• Ensure teams and leaders have clear visibility into demand, capacity, performance, and value delivered.
Required Skills & Experience
• 3+ years of product management or product ownership experience with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a digital product, including discovery, product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and measurement of business outcomes.
• Experience owning workflow or business process management (BPM) applications and improving end-to-end business processes.
• Demonstrated ability to make product trade-offs and prioritize competing opportunities using customer insight, data, business value, risk, and technical feasibility.
• Experience delivering system integrations, including APIs and data flows, in partnership with engineering and architecture teams.
• Strong analytical skills, including defining success metrics, establishing product instrumentation, and using data to guide product decisions.
• Strong communication and influence skills, with the ability to translate business problems into clear product requirements and explain technical concepts, decisions, and trade-offs to business and executive audiences.
• Ability to manage multiple products and stakeholder groups while creating clarity, aligning expectations, and maintaining focus on the highest-value outcomes.
Preferred
• Experience with the Appian low-code platform.
• Experience delivering AI/automation capabilities in production workflow applications.
• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodology.
Why This Role
You will own two products that FAS teams rely on every day, with a real opportunity to modernize how Vanguard serves advisors and intermediaries. You'll shape how system integrations and AI reduce manual work and help scale FAS offers. Your work will have a visible, direct impact on how quickly and consistently FAS teams serve external advisors.

At Vanguard, our core purpose is to take a stand for all investors and give them the best chance for investment success. Financial Advisor Services (FAS) delivers investment products and insights that help advisors navigate increasingly complex markets and build better outcomes for their clients.
We are seeking a Product Strategist to provide product expertise to crew and clients and to collaborate with business and investment teams to ensure the health and commercial success of the products.
This role plays a critical part in scaling and commercializing our product lineup; activating the sales and marketing organizations behind strategic product priorities. Additionally, it will focus on bringing the voice of the client back to the enterprise, shaping the roadmap and delivering recommendations to leadership and governance forums.
Core Responsibilities
• Serve as an investment product expert. Provide investment product expertise and strategic guidance to internal partners, relationship management teams, and Sales. Participate in meetings with clients and intermediaries to explain investment strategies, portfolio applications, product positioning, and relevant market developments.
• Contribute thought leadership. Develop informed perspectives on investment products, markets, industry trends, and competitive developments that advance product discussions and strengthen the firm’s product strategy.
• Shape product positioning and go-to-market strategy. Partner with Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to develop differentiated product positioning, technical content, and go-to-market strategies. Support new product launches and significant changes to existing products.

Apply a strong understanding of investment products, markets, and client needs to identify implications and recommend a clear path forward.

• Partner across the organization. Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders and subject-matter experts across Product, Investments, Sales, Marketing, Compliance, Operations, and other relevant functions. Lead or coordinate cross-functional teams when required to advance product priorities.
• Bring the client and marketplace perspective into product decisions. Synthesize feedback from clients, advisors, Sales, and relationship management teams with market, competitive, and product-performance insights to assess product health, identify unmet needs, and recommend ongoing improvements.
• Deliver effective product communication. Create and present clear, compelling written and verbal communications for senior leaders, internal partners, clients, and industry audiences. Ensure that product-related messaging is accurate, consistent, and aligned across internal and external channels.
• Build organizational capability. Facilitate product training and internal communications related to investment strategies, product launches, enhancements, and positioning. Provide guidance, feedback, and subject-matter support to analysts and other junior team members.

• Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear goal-setting narratives, options, and decision-ready materials.
• Comfort operating in a matrixed environment and partnering effectively with Sales, Finance, HR, Legal, Data & Analytics , and Distribution Strategy teams.

The Product Manager partners across product, risk, technology, and data teams to communicate findings, define remediation needs, and support the accurate, timely, and well-controlled use of data.

At Vanguard, we're on a mission to give clients the best chance for investment success. We're seeking Financial Sales Consultants for remote opportunities available to candidates located in the Tampa, Florida area. As a Financial Sales Consultant, you'll build meaningful client relationships, help clients navigate key financial decisions, and connect them with Vanguard products, services, and advice resources that meet their needs.
About the Role
This is a high touch, consultative sales role with an assigned book of business. Success in this role is driven by proactive outbound outreach, as Financial Sales Consultants connect with clients and prospects by phone to build relationships, understand financial goals, identify opportunities, and deliver exceptional client experience. In addition to base salary, Financial Sales Consultants are eligible for performance-based incentive compensation, offering an opportunity to be rewarded for delivering strong client experience and business results.
While this is a remote role, you'll collaborate with experienced specialists across Vanguard's dynamic and growing retail division. Financial Sales Consultants do not provide personalized financial advice or create financial plans. Instead, they serve as trusted points of contact who conduct discovery conversations, provide education, identify opportunities, and connect clients with the appropriate Vanguard resources, specialists, or advice professionals when needed.
Responsibilities
• Conduct discovery conversations to understand clients’ goals, priorities, life events, outside assets, and unmet needs.
• Manage a book of business through proactive outreach, responsive support, timely follow up, and thoughtful prioritization.
• Educate clients about Vanguard solutions and connect them with specialists or advice professionals when appropriate.
• Use consultative sales skills to deepen relationships, support retention and growth, and guide next steps.
• Coordinate referrals and collaborate across Vanguard to deliver a positive client experience.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
• Work life harmony: Enjoy a balance between your professional and personal life while making a meaningful impact on our clients’ financial well-being.
• Professional growth: Benefit from a workplace that prioritizes your professional development.
• Inclusive environment: Thrive in a supportive and inclusive environment where everyone is given a chance to succeed.
Compensation and Benefits
• Comprehensive benefits: Beyond your competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial, health, and overall, well-being.
• Performance bonus: We reward your hard work and dedication with opportunities for quarterly performance bonuses.
• Partnership Plan: Our Partnership Plan is an annual cash award tied to our collective company’s performance and client outcomes. When we succeed together, we all share in the rewards.
• Merit based salary increases: Your achievements and contributions are recognized through merit-based salary increases.
To learn more about our benefits, visit: Benefits and rewards | Vanguard careers
Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Three or more years of relevant experience, preferably in financial services, sales, relationship management, wealth management, banking, or consulting.

Role Profile
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. We enable financial markets around the world through trusted data, technology and market infrastructure.
Data Collection Development Americas develops and supports real-time systems that collect, process and distribute financial market data from stock exchanges and other data providers across the United States, Canada and Latin America.
The Business Analyst works at the intersection of financial markets, data and technology. The role involves developing expertise in assigned market data feeds, analyzing stock exchange specifications and notifications, gathering and documenting business and technical requirements, supporting testing, and helping deliver market changes into LSEG's production systems.
Responsibilities
• Develop knowledge of assigned stock exchanges, market data feeds, asset classes and market structure.
• Review and interpret stock exchange specifications, technical documentation, market notices and vendor communications.
• Monitor stock exchange and contributor notifications and assess potential impacts to LSEG products, services and customers.
• Gather, analyze and document business, functional, technical and data requirements.
• Translate stock exchange specifications and market behavior into clear requirements for Software Engineers and other technical teams.
• Analyze messages, fields, data types, identifiers, mappings, code sets and market rules.
• Create and maintain product specifications, data mappings, test cases and technical documentation.
• Validate market data against requirements, stock exchange specifications and expected market behavior.
• Investigate data discrepancies and support root-cause analysis, regression testing and production readiness.
• Work with data using tools such as Excel and SQL, with opportunities to use Python or similar scripting languages for analysis, validation and lightweight automation.
• Use approved Generative AI and AI-assisted tools to support specification analysis, requirements drafting, data exploration, test-case development and knowledge discovery.
• Critically review and validate AI-generated outputs and use AI responsibly in accordance with LSEG policies.
• Work collaboratively with Business Analysts, Product Delivery Managers, Software Engineers, Quality Assurance, Product and Operations teams.
• Manage multiple assignments and priorities in a fast-paced, real-time market data environment.
Skills & Requirements
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
• High attention to detail when working with data, specifications and testing.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to understand and organize complex technical information.
• Foundational financial markets literacy, including an understanding or interest in equities, fixed income, derivatives and other asset classes.
• Understanding or interest in developing knowledge of trades, quotes, bid/ask prices, order books/market depth, reference data and trading sessions.
• Strong data literacy and familiarity with structured datasets and data analysis.
• Proficiency with Excel or similar analytical tools.
• Ability and willingness to develop skills in SQL, Python, APIs, data visualization and AI-assisted analysis.
• Ability to learn new financial, market data and technical concepts quickly.
• Ability to work effectively within cross-functional and Agile delivery teams.
Desired Skills
• Degree or equivalent experience in Business, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
• Interest in global financial markets, financial technology and real-time market data.
• Exposure to SQL, Python, Power BI, APIs, JSON/XML or other data-analysis technologies.
• Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and an understanding of responsible AI use.
• Experience with data-intensive, real-time or production systems is beneficial.
• Exposure to Agile software development and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence or SharePoint is beneficial.
The successful candidate will progressively become a market data and market logic subject-matter expert for assigned feeds while developing strong business analysis, technical, financial markets, data and AI capabilities.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Digital Product Manager in Technology as part of Cybersecurity. Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com.
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Digital Product Manager – Lead Product Owner to join the Cyber Threat Management (CTM) organization in Cybersecurity. You will own the vision, roadmap and delivery of the firm's offensive security and threat-informed defense capabilities. These include red teaming, adversary emulation, threat intelligence and continuous control validation.
The role sits where product management meets offensive security. You'll take real-world adversary behavior and turn it into product strategy, features and measurable improvements in how Wells Fargo detects, prevents and responds to cyber threats. You'll work closely with engineering, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), the Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), detection engineering and architecture teams. You'll also present to senior leaders and regulators on the maturity of the firm's cyber defenses.
The ideal candidate has deep hands-on knowledge of adversary tradecraft and the product discipline to turn it into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap.
In this role, you will:
• Advise senior leadership on digital product strategies, initiatives, specifications, resources, and long-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs
• Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique product challenges requiring evaluation across multiple areas or the company
• Set product direction and guide long-term, large-scale solutions that require vision, innovation, advanced analytical thinking, and coordination of highly complex activities
• Translate customer, market, business, technology, and risk insights into integrated product strategies and enterprise-aligned roadmaps
• Provide direction and expertise for implementing significant digital product initiatives with broad impact
• Establish outcome measures and guide optimization of customer experience, adoption, controls, operational effectiveness, and business value
• Coordinate complex product dependencies and influence investment, capacity, and sequencing decisions across functions
• Strategically engage with professionals and managers across the company and serve as an advisor to leadership
Product Ownership & Strategy
• Define and own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for CTM capabilities, including red teaming, purple teaming, threat intelligence, adversarial simulation and breach-and-attack simulation (BAS).
• Translate complex threat scenarios into product features and security controls, with clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can deliver.
• Prioritize the backlog based on risk. Weigh changes in the threat landscape, red team findings, gaps in detection coverage, stakeholder input, regulatory commitments and business impact.
• Set and track product outcomes and KPIs. Examples: detection coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to respond (MTTR), how often controls are validated, and how quickly red team findings are fixed.
• Build business cases and secure investment for new capabilities. Explain to executive leadership what each one costs and how much risk it reduces.
• Assess the vendor and tooling landscape (threat intelligence platforms, BAS tools, adversary emulation frameworks). Make build, buy or partner recommendations.
Threat Expertise & Innovation
• Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on offensive security, red teaming, adversary emulation and penetration testing methodologies.
• Work with internal red and purple teams to benchmark detection capabilities, simulate adversary behavior and validate security controls, using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND and the Cyber Kill Chain.
• Integrate threat intelligence into product development so the firm anticipates threats relevant to financial services, including ransomware, nation-state activity, fraud-driven intrusions and supply-chain compromise.
• Drive detection engineering improvements by building a repeatable feedback loop from red and purple team exercises into SIEM and SOAR detection content, playbooks and tuning.
• Lead innovation in emerging threat areas, including cloud attack paths, identity-based attacks, AI-driven threat modeling and the security of AI/GenAI systems (for example, adversarial machine learning and LLM red teaming).
• Promote threat-informed defense as a guiding principle across Cybersecurity.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner with engineering, CTI, CSIRT, detection engineering, the Security Operations Center (SOC) and architecture teams to deliver scalable, secure and resilient solutions.
• Influence senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk and the lines of business. Turn technical findings into clear business risk narratives.
• Engage with industry partners, government agencies and threat-sharing communities (for example, FS-ISAC and public-sector partners) to improve situational awareness, threat modeling and collective defense.
• Work with Second Line of Defense, Internal Audit and Compliance so that CTM capabilities meet regulatory and supervisory expectations.
Execution & Delivery
• Lead agile ceremonies for CTM initiatives as Lead Product Owner, including PI/quarterly planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
• Deliver features on time that support cyber defense KPIs, risk-reduction objectives and regulatory commitments.
• Manage dependencies, risks and trade-offs across multiple agile teams and programs.
• Support incident response and threat briefings with product insight and technical context, including executive and board-level updates when needed.
• Mentor and guide product owners and analysts in the CTM portfolio to build a strong product culture.
Required Qualifications:
• 7+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
• 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity product management or offensive security operations.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in one or more of the following: red teaming, adversary emulation, threat intelligence or penetration testing.
• 5+ years of experience with threat modeling, detection engineering or cyber kill chain frameworks
• Experience working in highly regulated environments
Desired Qualifications:
• Demonstrated ability to develop and translate product strategies into prioritized roadmaps and measurable outcomes
• Skill in guiding product delivery and continuous product improvements across the lifecycle
• Capability to apply experience design and user experience strategies to digital products and customer journeys
• Effective stakeholder relationship management and consulting across business and technical partners
• Understanding of compliance requirements and risk controls applicable to digital product decisions
• Experience with cyber defense platforms, SIEM/SOAR, threat intelligence platforms (TIPs) and breach-and-attack simulation tools.
• Industry certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, OSEP, GIAC Red Team Professional (GRTP), GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN) or GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI).
• Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity-based attack techniques and zero trust architectures.
• Familiarity with AI-driven threat modeling, adversarial machine learning and emerging technology risks.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Cyber Security Research Consultant to serve as the strategic lead for AI Frontier Security Research within Attack Surface Intelligence (ASI).
This is a highly strategic, hands-on research role focused on understanding the rapidly evolving intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity . The individual will lead research into how frontier AI models and emerging AI technologies can be safely leveraged to advance cyber capabilities, while also assessing how the same technologies could change attacker behavior, capabilities, techniques, and the broader cyber threat landscape.
The role will help establish ASI's forward-looking perspective on AI-enabled security by evaluating emerging models, developing practical security use cases, researching adversarial applications of AI, and translating those findings into actionable intelligence, security strategies, and recommendations for senior leadership.
In this role, you will:
• Serve as the strategic lead for AI Frontier Security Research within ASI , establishing research priorities and helping shape the organization's approach to emerging AI capabilities and cyber risk.
• Research and evaluate frontier AI models, foundation models, agent-based systems, and emerging AI technologies to understand their potential application to cybersecurity.
• Identify ways AI can enhance defensive and offensive-security research, including areas such as attack-surface analysis, threat research, vulnerability discovery, security testing, data analysis, and cyber investigations.
• Conduct research into how threat actors could leverage frontier models and AI-enabled capabilities , with an emphasis on anticipating changes to attacker behaviors, techniques, scale, and sophistication.
• Develop and execute controlled research and experimentation designed to understand the security capabilities, limitations, and potential misuse of emerging AI technologies.
• Translate AI research into practical cybersecurity use cases , identifying where AI provides meaningful capability improvements versus where traditional approaches remain more effective.
• Develop frameworks and methodologies for assessing emerging AI models from a cybersecurity and adversarial-use perspective .
• Partner with ASI engineers, researchers, analysts, and other cybersecurity teams to turn research findings into prototypes, capabilities, security controls, or new areas of investigation.
• Monitor developments across the AI ecosystem, including frontier model providers, open-weight models, AI agents, emerging research, and attacker adoption of AI technologies.
• Establish repeatable approaches for comparing AI models and emerging capabilities as the technology evolves rather than evaluating individual models in isolation.
• Identify new attack surfaces introduced by AI , including risks created by models, agents, AI-enabled applications, integrations, and supporting infrastructure.
• Provide thought leadership on how AI may change the cybersecurity landscape and help ASI anticipate capabilities and risks before they become mainstream security problems .
• Present research findings, strategic implications, emerging risks, and opportunities to senior cybersecurity and technology leadership.
• Collaborate and consult with peers, engineers, researchers, intelligence analysts, and leaders across the organization to translate emerging AI research into actionable cybersecurity intelligence.
Required Qualifications:
• 7+ years of Cyber Security Research experience, or equivalent demonstrated through a combination of work experience, training, military experience, or education.
• Significant experience conducting advanced cybersecurity research, security engineering, offensive security, threat research, or related technical disciplines.
• Experience translating highly technical research into actionable recommendations for senior leaders and key stakeholders.
• Experience operating across both strategic and technical domains , taking emerging technologies from research questions through practical evaluation.
Desired Qualifications:
• Demonstrated knowledge of large language models, foundation models, generative AI, and AI agents .
• Experience evaluating AI technologies within cybersecurity or adversarial environments.
• Experience with offensive security, adversarial testing, penetration testing, or security research .
• Understanding of AI security concepts such as model abuse, prompt-based attacks, agent security, unsafe tool use, data exposure, model supply-chain risk, and adversarial evaluation.
• Familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework .
• Experience developing research methodologies, prototypes, proofs of concept, or experimental security capabilities.
• Strong understanding of attacker behavior and the ability to evaluate emerging technologies from both defender and adversary perspectives .
• Comfortable operating ahead of established security practices . The individual will be expected to explore emerging capabilities, develop hypotheses, conduct responsible research, challenge assumptions, and translate uncertainty into informed cybersecurity strategy.
• Ability to work across engineering, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, application security, cloud security, and other cybersecurity disciplines.
• Ability to communicate complex and emerging technical concepts clearly to executive audiences.
• Ability to operate effectively in areas where technologies, risks, and industry practices are still evolving.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Risk Analytics Consultant (Lead Mortgage Valuation and Cash Flow Analytic) to join the Consumer Banking and Lending Finance team.
The role supports portfolio valuation, profitability measurement, forecasting, and business performance analytics across mortgage and consumer lending portfolios.
This position will also play a key role in helping establish future Home Equity portfolio analytics, valuation, reporting, and securitization capabilities as the business expands.
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and capital markets skills with the ability to build new frameworks, reporting, and performance measurement capabilities that support strategic growth initiatives.
This is not a pure model-development role. The successful candidate will combine strong mortgage product and secondary-market knowledge with the ability to apply cash flow, behavior, valuation, and profitability analytics to business and risk decisions across mortgage originations and portfolios.
Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com .
In this role, you will:
• Analyze and lead the portfolio performance, valuation, cash flows, forecasting, and profitability across mortgage and consumer lending portfolios while helping develop future Home Equity analytics and securitization capabilities.
• Evaluate mortgage pricing and product economics, including note rate versus par rate and price, points and lender credits, fixed-rate versus adjustable-rate mortgages, and 30-, 45-, and 60-day lock terms.
• Model origination behavior using pull-through assumptions that estimate the probability of locked loan funds, and assess fallout drivers such as rate movements relative to the lock rate and borrower characteristics.
• Decompose expected profitability into revenue components, including Net Interest Margin and fee income, and cost components, including fulfillment, hedge, capital, and liquidity costs.
• Produce and interpret core profitability metrics such as Net Present Value(NPV), Return on Assets, Return on Equity, and capital utilization and allocation measures.
• Partner with Mortgage Capital Markets, Secondary Marketing, and business teams to support securitization, capital markets, collateral analytics, portfolio optimization, and future Home Equity execution strategies.
• Assess the margin impact of rate volatility and optimize execution selection based on pricing, market conditions, and portfolio objectives.
• Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis across interest-rate shocks, CPR, pull-through, and spread assumptions, including the interaction between pricing, volume, fallout, and margin.
• Develop forecasts, reporting, dashboards, and analytical insights for senior leadership, translating complex findings into clear business recommendations.
• Partner across Finance, Risk, Treasury, Mortgage Capital Markets, and Business teams on portfolio optimization, profitability enhancement, and other strategic initiatives
Required Qualifications:
• 5+ years of Risk Analytics experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
Desired Qualifications:
• Demonstrated experience in Portfolio Analytics, Financial Analytics, Mortgage Finance, Consumer Lending, Capital Markets, Structured Finance, Secondary Marketing, securitization, or related disciplines.
• Experience supporting securitization, structured finance, capital markets, or secondary marketing initiatives, including cash flow analysis, collateral analytics, valuation, and execution economics.
• Comprehensive understanding of portfolio valuation, cash flow analytics, forecasting, securitization structures, capital markets activities, and secondary market execution. Experience with MBS, RMBS, ABS, home equity loans, or HELOC products is preferred.
• Relevant experience performing cash flow analytics, portfolio analytics, profitability analysis, forecasting, scenario analysis, business performance measurement, and mortgage-related modeling to support strategic decision-making.
• Strong understanding of pull-through, fallout, prepayment, pipeline, and loan-level performance drivers, with the ability to translate assumptions into profitability, capital utilization, valuation impacts, and broader business outcomes.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate mortgage portfolios, identify profitability and risk drivers, assess valuation impacts, and deliver actionable insights and recommendations to senior leaders and business partners.
• Experience developing and maintaining analytical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that support mortgage valuation, profitability measurement, capital markets activities, portfolio monitoring, forecasting, and executive decision-making.
• Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, SAS, Power BI, and Tableau to extract, analyze, model, visualize, and communicate complex mortgage, capital markets, and financial data.
• Experience working with large, complex financial datasets and partnering across risk, finance, capital markets, servicing, and business teams to drive analytical solutions and business performance.
• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions in a highly collaborative environment.

Job Title
Senior Product Partnership Manager, ERP Ecosystem
About your role:
The Payment Value Added Services team delivers a suite of consumer bill payment, B2B invoice presentment, and omnichannel payment solutions, including BillMatrix, CheckFree Pay, and Snap Pay. Snap Pay is a high-growth SaaS platform that helps organizations modernize their Order-to-Cash processes through integrated payments, ERP-connected workflows, electronic invoicing, actionable data insights, and value-added services that improve efficiency, accelerate collections, and drive stronger business outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing businesses within Merchant Solutions, Snap Pay continues to expand its market leadership through innovative solutions and a transformational product roadmap.
We are seeking a Senior Product Partnership Manager to lead and expand Snap Pay's ERP ecosystem, a critical growth area focused on embedding payments into enterprise software platforms. In this role, you will define partnership strategy, build and strengthen relationships with leading ERP providers such as SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards, and Microsoft, and drive commercially impactful integrations and joint initiatives. Success requires the ability to influence across complex organizations, shape strategic roadmaps, navigate partner dynamics, and deliver mutual business value through innovative partnerships that accelerate growth for both Fiserv and its ecosystem partners.
What you'll do:
• Develop and execute Snap Pay's ERP partnership and ecosystem strategy for lead generation and revenue growth.
• Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage strategic alliances with ERP providers, technology platforms, and complementary solution providers.
• Lead commercial discussions with partners, including contract negotiations, business terms, pricing models, revenue-sharing structures, and partnership agreements.
• Build business cases, revenue forecasts, and financial models to evaluate partnership opportunities and measure investment returns.
• Nurture existing relationships with existing partners and firms.
• Own partner commercialization efforts, including joint go-to-market planning, sales enablement, partner onboarding, and market launch strategies.
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure successful execution of partnership initiatives.
• Influence joint product roadmaps and co-development opportunities that deliver differentiated value for mutual customers.
• Advocate for Snap Pay's strategic priorities in executive-level partner discussions through compelling business cases, market insights, and customer needs.
• Establish and track partnership performance metrics including revenue contribution, pipeline creation, customer adoption, implementation success, and partner engagement.
• Monitor market trends, competitor partnerships, customer feedback, and emerging technologies to identify growth opportunities and inform strategy.
• Drive alignment across stakeholders while navigating complex partner ecosystems and competing priorities.
• Serve as a trusted advisor and executive relationship manager for key ERP and technology partners.
What you'll need to have:
• Bachelors Degree
• Prior experience working in financial services and/or technology industry.
• 6+ years of experience in product partnerships, strategic partnerships, business development, ecosystem management, or related commercial leadership roles.
• 5+ years of experience building partnerships from scratch that incorporate multiple GTM motions (referral, reseller, white-label product)
• 6+ years of experience working with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, JDE, Microsoft, etc) or similarly adjacent enterprise technology platforms
• 5+ years of experience developing pricing strategies, commercial models, forecasts, and business cases that drive growth and profitability.
• 5+ years of experience negotiating commercial agreements, strategic partnerships, licensing arrangements, or revenue-sharing contracts.
• Proven ability to drive cross-functional execution in complex, matrixed environments delivering measurable business impact (revenue, adoption, growth)

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex concepts and bring others along your thinking
• Bias for action, and shares responsibility for the team’s success and progress
• Executive presence with the ability to influence working teams and senior leaders both internally and externally.
• Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data architectures to solve customer needs and expand use cases

Title: Client Due Diligence (KYC) Implementation Manager
Location: Jacksonville, FL
Job Code: #LI-MB1 #LI-03
About Deutsche Asset Management:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at Deutsche Asset Management , and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.
This is your chance to invest in your future.
Overview:
The Client Due Diligence (CDD) Team operates as part of Client & Investment Monitoring (CIM) within the Deutsche Asset Management CAO Division. The team has a global footprint and plays a vital role in supporting the Client Coverage Division, ensuring that all new client onboardings and ongoing regular or event-driven reviews comply with regulatory AML/S&E requirements and internal policies.
The team collaborates with multiple stakeholders, including Client Coverage, Anti-Financial Crime, Client Onboarding, Legal, and other stakeholders, to implement DB/DWS’ Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Client (KYC) and Sanction & Embargo (S&E) processes.
“Know-Your-Client” is your focus area. You will support the Americas Client Due Diligence (CDD) Implementation Team with enthusiasm and dedication in the full management of all relevant tasks throughout the entire KYC lifecycle. With your US regulatory expertise, you will act as the central point of contact for all KYC requirements and support our Client Coverage Division (CCD). In collaboration with the responsible CCD contact persons, you will take care of all types of KYC reviews, keep deadlines in view, and ensure reliability and quality. Teamwork is your priority. With your committed nature, you’ll establish a strong internal network and help to always ensure high KYC quality standards.
If you’re looking for a versatile role in a global, dynamic environment where no two days are the same, and enjoy taking a holistic view on the entire KYC process, then you’re in the right place and we look forward to your application!
Your Key Responsibilities:
• Review and verify client documentation, including legal and corporate documents, to identify discrepancies or potential risks.
• Perform enhanced due diligence (EDD) on high-risk client relationships, ensuring that all identified risk-factors are well-documented and escalated as necessary.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all KYC-related activities, findings, and supporting documents in compliance with audit and regulatory standards.
• Monitor ongoing client relationships by conducting periodic reviews and event-driven refreshes to ensure continued compliance with KYC requirements.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as Client Coverage & Anti-Financial Crime to address KYC-related inquiries and resolve complex cases.
• Stay up to date on changes in AML/KYC regulations and ensure implementation of new requirements in the processes.
• Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members to enhance the team's overall expertise and performance.
• Support in handling ad-hoc requests as well as in the context of projects, audits, and initiatives
Your Skills & Experience:
• Experience: A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a KYC, AML, or compliance-related role within the financial services industry. Previous experience with client due diligence processes in an asset management firm is highly desirable.
• Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of global AML/KYC regulations, including FATF recommendations, the USA PATRIOT Act, and local compliance requirements.
• Analytical Skills: Proven ability to analyse complex client structures, identify potential risks, and provide actionable insights for mitigating such risks.
• Attention to Detail: Exceptional attention to detail to ensure accuracy and compliance in all aspects of KYC reviews and documentation.
• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with internal stakeholders and external clients.
• Problem-solving Ability: A proactive mindset and strong problem-solving skills to address challenges and find effective solutions promptly.
• Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with KYC-related tools and systems (e.g. Salesforce, Fircosoft, RDC), as well as proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
• Initial hands-on experience with AI tools, with an interest in leveraging these technologies to enhance productivity and streamline day-to-day activities.
• Educational Background: A bachelor's degree in finance, business administration, law, or a related field is required. Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist) are a plus.
• Teamwork: A collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment
How we’ll support you:
• Training and development to help you excel in your career
• Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
• Coaching and support from experts in your team
What we’ll offer you:
At Deutsche Asset Management, we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves sand it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work - feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.

Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of renumeration.

That’s why we are focused on providing benefits and perks that enable our colleagues to live authenti­cally and be their whole selves, at every stage of life. Position Description :
Leads data‑driven, hypothesis‑based initiatives to analyze customer behavior across multiple platforms to generate actionable insights. Transforms largescale, disparate datasets using advanced analytical and statistical techniques to build scalable dashboards, reports, and decision ready visualizations that inform
strategic priorities and elevate customer experiences. Applies sophisticated experimentation methods -- including causal inference, multivariate testing, and behavioral measurement frameworks -- to evaluate digital performance and guide optimization efforts. Shapes analytical approaches, integrating diverse data
sources, resolving data quality challenges, and applying advanced modeling to illuminate customer behavior and business performance. Partners cross functionally with analytics, engineering, marketing, and product teams to synthesize complex findings into concise, compelling narratives that influence
business strategies and customer focused solutions.
Primary Responsibilities:
• Defines and leads enterprise-level data strategy and analytics initiatives.
• Develops and implements advanced analytical frameworks.
• Performs database management, including tasks related to scheduled jobs, data business requirements, and data lineage in an Agile environment.
• Partners with key stakeholders to understand their business questions, and delivers self-service experimentation solutions.
• Performs validation and tests models to ensure adequacy and reformulate models as necessary.
• Collaborates with senior managers and decision makers to identify and solve problems and clarify management objectives.
• Defines data requirements, gathers and validates information, and applies sound judgment and statistical testing.
• Performs validation and testing of models to ensure adequacy and reformulate models, as necessary.
• Prepares management reports defining and evaluating problems and recommending solutions.
• Collaborates with others to ensure successful implementation of chosen problem solutions.
• Participates in continuous improvement efforts to streamline analytical processes, enhance tools, and introduce best practices.
• Develops clear documentation for analytical processes, data workflows, and methodologies to ensure transparency and repeatability.
• Advises senior leadership on data-driven decision-making.
• Mentors junior analysts.
• Performs independent and complex technical and functional analysis for multiple divisional initiatives.
• Develops innovative insights to support strategic business goals.
Education and Experience :
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a closely related field (or foreign education equivalent) and five (5) years of experience as a Senior Manager, Data Analytics and Insights (or closely related occupation) building and delivering customer‑facing analytics products within distribution or commercial business functions.
Or, alternatively, Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a closely related field (or foreign education equivalent) and three (3) years of experience as a Senior Manager, Data Analytics and Insights (or closely related occupation) building and delivering customer‑facing analytics products within distribution or commercial business functions.
Skills and Knowledge :
Candidate must also possess:
• Demonstrated Expertise developing data warehousing and reporting solutions for financial institutions; creating high-impact interactive reporting dashboards using BI tools – Power BI and Tableau; and ensuring data quality and performing data analytics related to portfolio performance, risk analysis and customer segmentation using structured databases – SQL Server.
• Demonstrated Expertise performing hypothesis‑driven analysis and developing structured analytical approaches to translate complex business questions into validated insights; and synthesizing disparate data sources into clear, decision‑ready narratives using SQL, Python, and visualization tools --Tableau and Power BI.
• Demonstrated Expertise conducting data exploration, statistical testing, and trend identification to evaluate customer behaviors and operational performance; and assessing data quality, identifying anomalies, and producing repeatable, well‑documented analytical outputs in Agile environments.
• Demonstrated Expertise designing and executing experimentation frameworks, including A/B testing and measurement strategies; validating model performance and analytical methodologies; and communicating insights to technical and non‑technical audiences through structured reports and presentations.

Job Description
About Invesco
Invesco Fixed Income manages $648 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026. The platform is organized to meet the diverse needs of our global client base with 197+ investment professionals across 12 global locations. Our clients are a mix of retail investors and institutions.
About the Team
Product Management owns the core sales and marketing collateral for our investment platforms and is responsible for delivering high-quality, timely content and reporting, along with managing various product initiatives to support business development across retail, institutional and retirement channels. The Product Management team acts as a liaison between the client portfolio managers (CPMs) & investment teams with other cross-functional business areas on product-specific matters, ensuring alignment of the investment team needs with commercial priorities across the business.
About the Role
The Product Manager is responsible for supporting a set of investment strategies and will maintain critical connectivity with CPMs and portfolio teams, enabling alignment on product positioning, messaging, internal sales needs, portfolio data, and other potential issues to ensure strategic priorities are met. The Product Manager is expected to have a deep subject matter expertise of their product platforms, which includes an intimate knowledge of each strategy’s investment philosophy, process, positioning, and performance drivers. The person in this role also must understand fixed income asset classes and markets, maintain awareness of competitive landscape and trends, and ensure they can clearly articulate how our products differentiate from peers across relevant distribution channels.
This position is a multi-faceted, dynamic, and challenging role that demands highly developed skills in analytics, content management, communications, relationship building and business acumen.
Key Responsibilities of the Role:
Product & Investment Expertise
• Own the month- and quarter-end product collateral update process, including production and maintenance of quarterly presentations, factsheets, commentaries, infographics, annual reports, risk and performance attribution data reporting, and portfolio team information.
• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders within Invesco (including legal, compliance, risk, technology, sales/marketing, and other departments) to ensure clear, compliant product messaging, with timely review, approval and delivery of content for client and prospects aligned with firm standards.
• Support regulatory and governance deliverables, including preparation of fund board materials, prospectus/SAI review support, and contributions to other reporting.
• Serve as a key point of contact for marketing and RFP teams, maintaining accurate product data, managing consultant databases, and supporting standard RFP/DDQ content and positioning.
• Maintain quality control for product-related websites and internally posted content to ensure information remains current, accurate, and aligned with approved messaging and disclosures.
• Support product change management by coordinating stakeholders and ensuring timely updates across collateral systems, and client-facing communications.
Business & Distribution/Marketing Support
• Partner closely with the CPMs and investment teams to help drive collaboration across product, investments, distribution, marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
• Actively engage with the CPMs/investment teams to maintain deep subject-matter expertise about our strategies, portfolios, and investment results.
• Provide key support in creating and reviewing marketing materials.
• Support CPMs in regular communications, analysis and insights to our sales team for use with clients; Respond to ad hoc internal and external sales team and client requests.
• Monitor industry and product trends: compile, analyze, and interpret data to inform product strategy and prioritization.
• Conduct competitive and peer analysis using Morningstar and other related resources to help support CPMs with product positioning and go-to-market workflow.
Requirements of the Role
• Undergraduate degree required, preferably in business or related discipline.
• Minimum five (5) years of related work experience in financial services, preferably asset management.
• Series 7 and 63 highly preferred but not required.
• Experience across fixed income asset classes and an overall understanding of financial markets, investment concepts and processes.
• Experience in Global/Emerging Market Debt and/or Municipal Bonds is a plus.
• Strong technical skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office, Morningstar, eVestment, Bloomberg, and other software products; Experience with AI tools is also preferred.
• Strong analytic skills with a focus on data and content management processes, as well as research, writing, and marketing.
• Passion for the investment industry and capital markets is a must.
• Entrepreneurial spirit, with a focus on continuous improvement, willingness to take risks, embrace and lead change, determination to find creative solutions to problems.
• Strong work ethic and drive to succeed.
• Highly developed communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Detail and deadline oriented.
• Ability to demonstrate sound judgment.

• Support portfolio managers and analysts in responding to client, consultant, and internal inquiries.

• Participate in education, onboarding, and training efforts to build understanding of investment strategies, markets, and asset classes.

What Is the Opportunity?
The Risk Control organization consists of motivated professionals with diverse risk engineering expertise across multiple commercial insurance disciplines. By delivering high quality risk assessments and consultative services, we help clients better understand and mitigate their risks while empowering underwriters with the insights needed to make informed account selection and pricing decisions that drive profitable growth. As a Risk Control Consultant, CAG, you will apply and expand your technical competencies in risk assessment and loss control by independently consulting with clients on lower to moderate complexity risks across multiple industries and lines of coverage. What Will You Do?
• Maintain a consistent field presence, spending approximately 20% to 50% of the time with customers. Overnight and extended trips may be required depending on business need. Car and air travel may be necessary.
• Independently prepare, conduct, and complete technically detailed risk assessments of lower to moderate complexity to evaluate potential hazards and risk factors. Complexity is defined by industry, account size, number of locations, and exposure type.
• Apply consultative skills with clients to implement recommended risk control measures to reduce, mitigate, or prevent losses.
• Build and maintain collaborative relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure coordinated, high-quality, consultative service focused on risk reduction across all accounts.
• Stay current on emerging industry trends, regulatory developments, and best practices by actively pursuing relevant training, certifications, and continuing education opportunities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.
What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?
• Bachelor's degree in environmental health and safety, construction management, basic sciences, or a related technical field.
• Four or more years of multiline risk control or risk management experience in the property and casualty insurance industry.
• Certification in one or more relevant industry-recognized designations or licenses such as ASP, ARM, CSP, CFPS, CIH, CPE, etc.
• Verbal and written communication skills.
• Critical thinking and analytical skills.
• Influencing and relationship-building skills.
• Organizational and time management skills.
What is a Must Have?
• Three years of experience in safety, risk control/management, or a related field, such as occupational/environmental health and safety, science, engineering, construction, manufacturing, or relevant military experience.
• Valid driver's license.
• Where applicable, must have or obtain appropriate certification to meet state-specific requirements within agreed upon timeframe.

• Health Insurance : Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
• Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

Experience Strategy & Studio helps Salesforce decide where to go next and makes that direction tangible. You'll join a small, hands-on team working closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Experience Architecture. The work moves from open questions to tangible proof, with successful ideas progressing into committed product plans and clear ownership for delivery.
We're hiring an Experience Design Architect to shape the direction of our most consequential product design challenges. • Use AI and agents to explore emerging possibilities, test new interaction models, and advance design practice. Apply sound judgment to their capabilities, limitations, and effect on the user experience.
• Elevate the thinking and craft of experienced designers and cross-functional leaders. Through hands-on work, critique, and mentorship, help others see the broader context, exercise stronger judgment, and establish new standards of quality.

• Leadership through craft and judgment: A record of helping experienced designers and cross-functional leaders see the bigger picture and make stronger decisions.
