Job Description:
This job is responsible for coordinating, reviewing, and optimizing data analysis to create revenue generating opportunities, and overseeing the development of effective risk management strategies. Key responsibilities include working with lines of business to identify and diagnose problems, utilizing sophisticated analytics, and deploying advanced techniques to devise solutions, and clearly communicating recommendations based on findings. Job expectations include demonstrating leadership, influence, accountability, and a commitment to fostering responsible growth for the enterprise.
Responsibilities:
• Coordinates and reviews data collection, trend identification, and pattern recognition, using advanced techniques to drive decision making and identification of data driven insights
• Contributes to the adoption of enterprise information products through communicating in a clear manner how enterprise information products answer material banking questions leading to decisions and actions
• Applies agile practices for project management, solution development, deployment, and maintenance
• Provides oversight and support of technical documentation, capturing the business requirements, and specifications related to the developed analytical solution, and implementation in production
• Reviews work products to ensure adequate quality and timeliness of work deliverables such as quantitative models, data science products, data analysis reports, or data visualizations, while exhibiting the ability to work independently and in a team environment
• Mitigates risk by identifying potential issues and developing controls
• Possesses deep knowledge and subject-matter expertise of the latest advances in the fields of data science and artificial intelligence to support business analytics
• Evaluating Proof of Concepts for Enterprise Credit Business Cases leveraging emerging AI technologies, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and assessing feasibility, scalability, and value across the model portfolio.
• Supporting Bank policy for Artificial Intelligence models and ensuring risks associated with advanced techniques are identified and mitigated
• Mentoring junior data scientists and analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
Required Qualifications:
• 5+ years of work experience in a Data Science role or related field.
• Proven ability in learning and strong programming (Python, SQL) skills.
• Strong interest in using data for business insight and experience in building and deploying models.
• Strong desire to learn and willingness to acquire needed knowledge and skills.
• Demonstrated project management skills, including ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and follow through on completion of high-profile projects or initiatives.
• Positive attitude, willingness to collaborate, strong work ethic, and demonstrated personal initiative.
• Organized; able to effectively prioritize and balance multiple efforts in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to lead and influence stakeholders across multiple levels and organizations, aligning technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
• Ability to identify and remediate risks in a timely manner.
• Ability to navigate the enterprise / source information across multiple functions.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• General knowledge of Enterprise Credit businesses, processes, systems, and policies.
• Experience building and implementing Natural Language Processing (NLP) solutions from scratch.
• Experience using Python packages such as: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, spaCy, NLTK, PyTorch, TensorFlow or other advanced scientific/ML/NLP Python packages.
• Hands‑on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, fine‑tuning, or parameter‑efficient adaptation (e.g., LoRA, adapters) for enterprise use cases (e.g., document understanding, semantic search, summarization, or decision support).
• Strong understanding of modern NLP architectures, including transformers, embeddings, attention mechanisms, and vector similarity search.
• Demonstrated experience operationalizing NLP/ML solutions, including model validation, monitoring, drift detection, and iterative improvement post‑deployment.
• Strong understanding of model risk, bias, explainability, and governance considerations, especially in regulated financial environments.
• Ability to document assumptions, limitations, and controls for NLP and generative AI solutions in a manner suitable for senior stakeholders and risk partners.
• Experience mentoring junior data scientists, providing technical guidance on NLP, modeling best practices, and code quality.
Desired Qualifications:
• 6-10+ years of work experience in Data Science or related field.
• Proven ability to integrate NLP solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources, including APIs, databases, document stores, and search indices.
• Experience working with model inputs and outputs at scale, including chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, and latency/performance tradeoffs in production systems.
• Experience designing multi‑step or agentic workflows, where NLP models reason across tools, data sources, or intermediate outputs to complete complex tasks (e.g., retrieval‑augmented generation, planning‑execution loops).
• Demonstrated success applying NLP or LLM‑based solutions to document‑heavy domains such as credit, risk, compliance, policy interpretation, or underwriting.
• Experience supporting proof‑of‑concept to production transitions, balancing research innovation with enterprise scalability and controls.
• Graduate degree in Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Quantitative Theory and Methods, Statistics, Mathematics, Management Science, Economics, Econometrics, Operational Research, Mathematics joint Political Science, or other similar quantitative discipline.

Job Description:
Global Markets Risk Management serves as independent market risk oversight of the Firm’s trading activities. The Global Market Risk Stress Testing team within this organization is responsible for the implementation and management of critical enterprise processes and analysis to support the global markets business and senior risk management.
The team is seeking a highly motivated individual to support market risk stress testing, including regulatory mandated stress testing activities, formal and ad-hoc scenario analysis. The candidate in this role will have a wide range of responsibilities from evaluating new and emerging risks in the portfolio to ensuring that the Firm surpasses regulatory expectations. This work will require extensive engagement across risk functions and other partners across the Firm. The candidate will also be a key participant in regulatory exams related to stress testing and will become the subject matter expert on key aspects of market risk stress testing. This role will be expected to support the team’s success through an individual contributor role and will have no formal management responsibilities.
Role Responsibilities:
• Support the end-to-end scenario design process by learning and evaluating the stress methodologies that use the mark shock projections
• Effectively designing and communicating enterprise-wide and GMIR requested scenarios to business partners
• Partnering with Risk Managers, Counterparty Risk Partners, ESPE, and other forecast teams during the development of market shocks and scenario narratives
• Understanding the Company’s risk identification processes and inventory, as well as the GMIR points of weakness documents to design a customized internal specific scenario
• Analyze scenario analysis results to better understand the key drivers of the results
• Facilitate sensitivity analysis and understanding downstream impacts to losses
• Integrating requirements for capital adequacy planning, stress testing, and risk appetite monitoring as defined across key international legal entities
• Identification of potential process improvements and implementation of solutions
• Support the Scenario Generation governance requirements such as policy and procedure adherence as well as quarterly control evidence throughout the year
• Engage with technology and data partners to improve the technology platforms used to manage the processes
The candidate will support the scenario design processes of the instantaneous Global Market Shock Scenario (GMS) as part of the stress testing team. Duties will include, but are not limited to, collaborating on the development and customization of internally-designed scenarios (including regulatory submission scenarios and management requested scenarios), conducting research and analyzing complex data to support future scenario work, assessing risks of the Company and how these risks may manifest in a specific scenario, communicating scenario requirements to downstream users, facilitating review and challenge of each scenario’s shocks and narrative, and creating presentation materials for various committees. The candidate will be a key liaison with risk partners and forecasting teams across GMIR. A requirement of the role will be to develop executive-level presentations, execute on ad-hoc priorities, and coordinate initiatives across GMIR.

Company Description
Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.
We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.
What’s the Role?
We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the Taxonomy team within the Inventory initiative. This is a full time role reporting to the Inventory Group Product Manager
What’s this team like at Etsy?
The Taxonomy squad owns Etsy’s taxonomy foundation — the category, attribute, and ontology systems that power how products are classified and discovered across Search, Recommendations, site navigation, and the listing experience (both what buyers see on a listing page and what sellers are asked to fill in on the listing form). Day to day, this means sustaining the underlying taxonomy system and the attribute, variation, and filter (AVS) data models, supporting translations across international storefronts, and partnering closely with a dedicated taxonomist to keep that classification system accurate and complete. The team develops the shared vocabulary the rest of the company uses to understand products on the marketplace, and is responsible for growing the coverage of essential product information across the catalog.
What does the day-to-day look like?
● Build and refine a seller strategy to close product information gaps – simplifying purchase decision making for buyers and making it easier for sellers to know what information they’re missing
● Partner with Buyer experience teams to align on how categories and attributes surface in navigation and listings
● Partner with the team taxonomist to turn classification decisions into scoped product requirements, running the intake, prioritization, and PRD cadence that keeps it working
● Use analytics and experimentation to prioritize taxonomy investments independently
● Own end-to-end release delivery: go/no-go criteria, cross-team launch coordination, post-launch measurement and rollback decisions
● Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.
Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:
● Comfortable in a technical domain where one change ripples across the marketplace
● Able to partner with a non-PM domain expert — a taxonomist — as a core operating partner
● Track record of building lightweight processes (intake, prioritization, PRDs) from scratch
● Comfortable prioritizing on hard-to-define metrics and explaining trade-offs to technical and non-technical partners alike
● Ability to connect day-to-day work to a longer-term company strategy
Compensation & Benefits
In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.
Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.
Location
We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here .
Salary Range:
• Geo-1: 165,000.00 - 223,000.00 USD Annual
• Geo-2: 149,000.00 - 201,000.00 USD Annual

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join Etsy’s Payments Analytics team and help make payments more seamless and reliable. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and fellow analysts to evaluate opportunities and inform product decisions through analysis, experimentation, and foundational data work.
This is a full-time position reporting to the Manager, Analytics.
What’s this team like at Etsy?
The Payments team improves buyer and seller financial experiences and the infrastructure that supports transactions across Etsy. Payments Analytics helps the team understand customer behavior, builds trusted data sources, and measures the impact of product decisions.

• Job similarity: Review how the model matches job titles, job profiles, and job families. Workday is expanding into identity management to govern access for both employees and AI agents across the enterprise. As enterprises adopt autonomous agents faster, CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs face a new governance challenge. They must manage identity, access, provisioning, lifecycle automation, and least-privilege controls across a combined workforce of people and AI agents.
Our Solution Engineering team is a strategic partner to the sales organization. We build a compelling vision of the Workday solution for some of the largest customers in the world. The team sits where Sales, Product Management, Consulting Services, Marketing, and Value Management meet. About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Solution Engineering, Identity to lead and grow Workday's specialized team of Solution Engineers focused on identity governance and access management. You will set the technical bar for how we win deals and help your team get better every week.
This role is a great fit if you have spent time running evaluations and architecting identity solutions and now want to multiply that impact through a team. You will stay close to the biggest deals while building a team that can run without you.
A key focus is mentoring your team. You will give clear expectations, actionable feedback, and growth opportunities so each person advances their skills, business acumen, and impact. Your greatest satisfaction will come from seeing your team stretch and grow and help Workday customers achieve outstanding outcomes.

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of Solution Engineers. Focus on technical depth, storytelling, and how they run a deal from first call to closed-won.
• Hire and onboard top talent, and build a ramp that gets new team members confident on the platform quickly.
• Own the technical side of the pipeline. Know where deals stand, spot risk early, and step in on strategic opportunities when it counts.
• Partner with Sales leadership and Account Executives on deal strategy, territory coverage, and forecasting. Keep the team's capacity matched to where the business is going.
• Shape how we run evaluations and proofs of value, with clear success criteria, tight scoping, and a repeatable playbook for the team.
• Sharpen our competitive positioning against legacy IGA vendors and emerging players, and make sure the team can explain why customers choose Workday.
• Be the voice of the customer to Product Management and Engineering. Bring back real feedback on connectors, workflows, and gaps, and help prioritize what matters.
• Report on team and pipeline health to executives with metrics that tell a clear story, such as technical win rate, POV outcomes, and coverage.
• Stay ahead of industry trends (IGA, CIEM, just-in-time access, Zero Trust, identity for machine and non-human accounts, and agentic AI). Bring that thinking to your team and our customers.
• Join customer workshops, whiteboard sessions, and demos when you can add something the team can't, and use those moments to teach.
• Foster collaboration and innovation across the broader Workday Solution Engineering organization. Share best practices, assets, and thought leadership that advance Workday's technology story in the market.

• 8+ years in technical pre-sales or solutions engineering.
• 3+ years of experience in identity governance, identity and access management (IAM/IGA), cybersecurity, or cloud security, including working knowledge of AI and agentic AI.
• 3+ years leading Solution Engineers or a similar technical team, with excellent leadership, management, and coaching skills.
• 3+ years navigating Go code, working with API scripts, reading source code documentation, and using GitHub.

• Experience selling or supporting the sale of enterprise software in a SaaS context. Experience in enterprise applications and technologies (e.g., ERP, CRM, public cloud, architecture, integrations, security, reporting/analytics, AI/agentic AI) is preferred.
• A strong grasp of identity governance and access management (IGA, IAM, PAM, CIEM, least privilege, Zero Trust) and of protocols and standards such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and FIDO2. You can discuss them with engineers and CISOs alike.

FDEs also serve as a critical feedback engine for Product and Engineering. Field insights, recurring customer friction, and proven build patterns become scalable, out-of-the-box capabilities that reach every developer building on Workday. About the Role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Developer Platform FDE team, you’ll combine hands-on agent engineering with direct customer work. Working alongside senior FDEs, you’ll help enterprise customers build, deploy, and optimize custom AI agents and agentic apps inside live customer environments.
You’ll work with the full Workday Developer Platform stack. You’ll run custom agents on the Workday Agent Harness, the same agent runtime and infrastructure Workday uses internally. You’ll build agents, apps, and orchestrations in plain language with Developer Agent, from the Workday Developer Site, a VS Code–compatible IDE plug-in, or any other MCP-compatible agentic tool, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. You’ll wire agents into hundreds of governed, LLM-native Agent-Ready Tools for HR and finance data over MCP, and build with industry-leading ADKs and agent frameworks. You’ll connect agents to each other and to the places people work using open standards like MCP, A2A, and A2UI, alongside REST APIs. And you’ll do it with governance built in, not bolted on, through Workday Extend AI, the Agent System of Record, Agent Passport, and Workday Data Cloud.
You’ll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside senior FDEs, AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. You’ll help drive immediate customer success while building deep expertise in enterprise agent engineering, and every engagement will sharpen both your technical skills and your sense of what makes a platform great to build on.

• Developer Toolkit Feedback: Be a hands-on, everyday user of Developer Agent, Agent-Ready Tools, and the Agent Harness. Document bugs, edge-case failures, and friction points with clear reproduction steps and context, and share them with Developer, AI, and Integration Platform product teams to improve the developer toolkit for the open Workday ecosystem.
• Productization of Field Insights: Spot recurring deployment challenges and contribute fixes, reusable components, sample code, and documentation to the reference architectures, playbooks, and pattern guidance that let customers and partners build without us.

• Collaboration: A highly collaborative, low-ego team player who learns quickly and works well within multi-disciplinary account and delivery pods.

• Working knowledge of Workday, including business processes, security and permissions, tenant configuration, or integrations.
• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent2Agent (A2A), including building or consuming MCP servers.
• Experience with one or more agent development kits or orchestration frameworks.
• Familiarity with evaluating and testing LLM-powered systems.
• Experience with Workday Extend, Workday Orchestrate, or Workday Integrations.

Introduction to the team
Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
The Pricing applied science team has critical impacts on the business health. The team is building a scalable and robust system to enable pricing as a lever to optimize business performance. The system should be steered based on desired outputs, such as a given tradeoff between volume and profit. Our work directly decides prices across different lines of business, influencing multi-billion dollar revenue.
As a Senior Manager of Applied Science, you will lead a team and collaborate with a strong team of strategists, engineers, product managers, operations and analytics. You will be deeply involved in the technical details of building applied science solutions to optimize business performance. As a leader in Applied Science, you will set best practices, architect solutions, design processes and manage a highly skilled team that continues to grow. You will also contribute to an area of active research: causal inference using machine learning methods, stochastic optimization, ML-based demand estimation, experiment design and analysis.
In this role, you will:
• Manage a team of applied scientists to deliver scalable and robust machine learning and data science solutions to pricing and monetization with engineering rigor.
• Architect solutions, review models and provide necessary technical guidance.
• Dissect business problems into digestible solutions.
• Follow company strategic directions and align with stakeholders on goals and roadmaps.
• Set the team vision, design roadmap and manage the execution to deliver outstanding results.
• Hire, mentor and grow the team.
• Collaborate with other applied science, analytics and data engineering teams to build a great data culture in EG.
Minimum Qualifications:
• 8+ years of related industry experience
• 4+ years of management experience in developing machine learning models at scale from inception to business impact
• Demonstrated ability to create and drive technical and impactful roadmaps for the business, and lead seamless execution of it
• Passion for management and creating opportunities for career growth for team members
• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels
• Proficiency in one of the tools such as Python, R, Scala, etc
• Experience with big data ecosystem (Hadoop/Spark)
Preferred Qualifications:
• PhD, MS, or BS in a quantitative field, such as Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics or equivalent professional experience
• Experience in working with pricing models
• Experience with large scale marketplace experiment design and analysis
• Understanding of modern machine learning and data science techniques and their mathematical underpinning

The Machine Learning Science team is building a scalable and robust system to enable pricing as a lever to optimize business performance. The system should be steered based on desired outputs, such as a given tradeoff between volume and profit. Our work directly decides prices across different lines of business, influencing multi-billion dollar revenue.
As a Machine Learning Scientist III, you will research and build this pricing system. You will work on end-to-end pricing problems. You will collaborate with a strong team of machine learning scientists, data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operation analytics. You will contribute to an area of active scientific research: causal inference using machine learning methods, operations research and optimization, ML-based demand estimation, experiment design with spillovers. And this is an applied research role – your models will be deployed to our production systems, and your results will be measured objectively through AB testing.

• Apply solid scientific skills, strong analytical and innovative thinking to quickly learn new domains and turn innovative ideas into working solutions
• Articulate technical solutions and plans to stakeholders based on detailed understanding of business requirements.
• Research and implement scalable machine learning and data science solutions end to end with engineering rigor.
• Follow the latest technology and research and be able to customize them to our problem space.
• Design success metrics for both short-term and long-term performance.
• Guide solutions using data insights based on deep understanding of business domains.
• Collaborate with other machine learning and data science teams to build a great data science culture in Expedia Group.

• 3+ years industry experience and a degree in Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science, or equivalent quantitative fields
• Comfortable to analyze complicated data sets to generate insights to guide effective solution development
• Passion for solving exciting and meaningful real-world problems using principled techniques and practices
• Focus on problem solving with pragmatical methods.
• Understanding of modern machine learning and data science techniques and their mathematical underpinning
• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels
• Collaborates well in a team and sensitive to clients' needs, while developing warm relationships and building trust with stakeholders
• Proficiency in one of the tools such as Python, Scala, etc
• Proficiency with big data ecosystem (Hadoop/Spark)
Preferred Qualifications:
• An advanced degree, PhD, in a quantitative field
• Expert in one or multiple areas of machine learning, causal inference, and operations research
• Experience in pricing
• Experience with large scale marketplace experiment design and analysis

AI Evaluation

Job Description
As the Value Engineering Lead, you will build a new function to support TRs AI Solutions. You will establish how Thomson Reuters defines, quantifies, and proves the value of our Legal, Tax, and Risk solutions with customers, from the first pursuit conversation through the hand-off to our success and professional services teams supporting rollout and adoption. You will be a founding leader in the Corporates, Customer Experience organization. You will help set the charter, operating model, and standards for this function, and the team that carries it forward.
This is a player-coach role. Roughly half your time is spent designing and launching the function, and the other half doing the work: engaging with customers, partnering with account teams, working with transformation SMEs and building defensible business cases for our highest-priority opportunities. What you learn from front-line work will shape the function you build, as all our work will be anchored to customer needs and developed to help drive customer value confidence and set customers up for success. You will work with colleagues responsible for scaling GTM operations to turn lessons learned and plans into repeatable processes and accessible support.
We are looking for someone who has run value engineering or pre-sales at scale and now wants to build the function from the ground up, with the credibility of having done the work yourself and committed to staying on the front-line with what value engineering means with new and evolving technology.
Key Responsibilities:
• Conduct value discovery with prospect customers and stakeholders to understand their processes, KPIs, pain points, and financial drivers that will inform the value narrative and drivers of the business case
• Build customer-specific value cases, modeling value scenarios by capabilities and supporting the broader deal structure, but showcasing ROI, TCO, payback periods that withstand scrutiny from finance and technical buyers
• Establish how product capabilities drive critical customer outcomes and manage value maps for supporting this narrative and keeping it current as the product changes
• Prepare and present value summaries and executive presentations as part of the sales cycle
• Track realized outcomes after the sale with Customer Success and feed actual results back into value models
• Train sales and pre-sales teams on value-selling methods
• Define the function's charter, operating model, and how it engages with sales, product, and customer success
• Develop the core processes: request intake and prioritization, discovery standards, model build and review, executive alignment, handoff to sales, and post-sale value tracking
• Establish model governance: approved benchmark sources, assumption documentation, version control, and a review process for any figure that goes to a customer
• Define and configure value tools that support scale and adoption (e.g., ROI calculators, CRM fields for value data and a shared repository of value cases)
• Set metrics and report on them: win-rate lift, sales cycle time, deal size, value-case usage, and realized-versus-promised value
• Manage the budget and partner with sales leadership to set priorities and expectations
• Build the team's capability through training, reusable templates, and case libraries
• Serve as the senior leader on high-value or executive-level deals
Required Qualifications
• 10+ years in value engineering, pre-sales consulting, solutions engineering, or management consulting in B2B software.
• Strong financial modeling skills (ROI, TCO, KPI modeling).
• Experience engaging with CFOs, CIOs, or procurement leaders. With the ability to influence sales and product leadership and identify creative solutions that meet stakeholder objectives
• Ability to learn a customer's applications and industry well enough to speak their language (i.e., legal, risk, tax and trade)
• Executive-level communication and presentation skills
•
• Deep financial modeling skills and a track record of defensible value cases
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience setting up a function or process from the ground up is a plus

Job Description
Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for a Data Scientist to support our Federal Law Enforcement customers. TRSS Data Scientists serve several Federal Law Enforcement agencies by collecting, integrating, resolving, analyzing, modeling, and explaining large data in support of complex investigations. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, the initiative to operate with minimal direction, creativity to develop novel solutions, the ability to work directly with customers, and a mission-focused mindset.
TRSS Data Scientists support the full range of Federal Law Enforcement missions including, but not limited to: Emerging Threat Detection, Money Laundering, Fraud, Force Protection, Human Rights Crimes, Transnational Crime, and more. Outside of contract work, TRSS Data Scientists contribute to internal innovation by participating in research and development (R&D), developing and maintaining shared capabilities, strengthening technical skills, and supporting business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.
This opportunity is specifically for positions located on US Government customer sites in the Arlington , Merrifield, Fairfax, Crystal City, and DC area. This is not a telework position. We recruit from a broad range of disciplines and experience. If you are passionate about the chance to put your Data Science skills to practice in support of Federal Law Enforcement, then we are looking for you!
Key Responsibilities
Data Scientists in this role will support Federal Law Enforcement missions by applying technical expertise to complex investigative and operational challenges. Responsibilities include:
• Collect, integrate, clean, verify, resolve, and maintain large and complex datasets.
• Analyze data using statistical methods, graph networks, anomaly detection, spatial analysis, pattern-of-life analysis, sentiment analysis, and related techniques.
• Develop and apply data models, including risk models, community detection, classification, computer vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence models.
• Translate data findings into actionable insights through dashboards, visualizations, briefings, and clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.
• Write, edit, customize, and execute Python code to support mission requirements.
• Use SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, and analysis.
• Work directly with customers to understand problem statements, define project goals, develop methods, and deliver results within required timeframes.
• Contribute to internal innovation, research and development, shared capabilities, technical skill development, and business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.
Required Qualifications
• United States Citizenship, as required to comply with government contract requirements.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance or agency work suitability determination, as required by assignment.
• Willingness to work full time on-site at U.S. Government customer sites in the Arlington , Merrifield, Fairfax, Crystal City, and DC area. This is not a telework position.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field, such as data science, statistics, computer science, mathematics, physical or biological sciences, geographic information systems, or a related discipline.
• At least 3 years of relevant experience in data management, data analysis, data modeling, data storytelling, programming, SQL, or related technical areas.
• Practical experience writing, editing, customizing, and executing code in Python.
• Experience using SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, or analysis.
• Ability to handle sensitive, confidential, or regulated data in accordance with applicable policies and requirements.
• Ability to interface directly with customers at all levels and represent TRSS professionally.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with Data Scientists, Subject Matter Expert Analysts, Data Engineers, and cross-disciplinary teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Preference will be given to candidates who meet the required qualifications and also bring one or more of the following:
• Current/Active government work suitability or security clearance.
• Experience working with law enforcement agencies.
• Programming skills in multiple languages other than Python (Python is a minimum requirement) including R, Java, or SQL.
• Experience with software development, including managing collaborative codebases, version control, linting/testing, containerization, and interacting with REST APIs

What if your next three years gave you three meaningful roles across LexisNexis Legal & Professional, each with goals you own and opportunities to build the capabilities needed for general management?
Most leadership programs teach you how a business works. This one puts you inside the work that moves it forward. Apply today!
About our Team
LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX (www.relx.com), a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles ( https://stories.relx.com/responsible-ai-principles/index.html ).
About the Program
Join the inaugural cohort of a competitive leadership development program. The LexisNexis Legal & Professional General Management Leadership Development Program (GMLDP) is a three-year program designed to build the capabilities needed for general management and business leadership roles through meaningful work across the business.
You’ll complete three 12-month rotations, each a full role within LexisNexis Legal & Professional. In each role, you will learn how the business operates, participate in the annual planning cycle, own goals, make decisions, implement changes, and take responsibility for results. Rotations span our three commercial business units and central functions, including Product & Technology, Strategy & Growth, and Finance & Operations.
Rotations are assigned according to business needs while considering your interests and development goals. Each rotation is designed to help you build experience beyond your existing areas of expertise.
We invest in our people because leadership development is critical to our future success. Your development will come from three areas:
• On-the-job experience: You will grow through three year-long roles. In each rotation, a manager will set expectations, provide ongoing feedback, and evaluate your performance.
• Learning from others: You will have a mentor to help you navigate the organization and prepare for future development opportunities. You will also receive HR support and have opportunities to engage with senior leaders and members of your cohort.
• Formal learning: A three-year, cohort-based curriculum will develop the business and leadership capabilities that complement your experience in each role.
As you complete the program, we will support you in identifying potential next-step opportunities. Placement will depend on your demonstrated skills, program experience, available opportunities, and business needs.
Why Join?
Through the program, you will have the opportunity to:
• Take on three year-long roles in which you own goals, participate in annual planning, and see the results of your decisions.
• Build experience across LexisNexis Legal & Professional and develop the broad business perspective effective general managers need.
• Apply AI tools and data-driven approaches to meaningful business challenges.
• Participate in a three-year, cohort-based curriculum with support from rotation managers, mentors, and HR partners.
• Help shape an inaugural program designed to develop business leadership capabilities.
• Grow through real work, continuous learning, and support from colleagues across the organization.
Program Requirements
• Work Authorization: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
• Graduation Requirements : Candidates should be on track to complete their advanced degree before the program starts in June 2027.
• Dedicated Office Locations: Raleigh, North Carolina; Dayton, Ohio; or New York, New York.
• Work Style Requirements: Hybrid, with an expectation of working from a dedicated LexisNexis office two to three days per week.
• Anticipated Start Date: June 14, 2027
• Application Review: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis
Some future opportunities may be based in other locations. Any location or relocation expectations will be discussed in advance.
Responsibilities
During each rotation, you will:
• Take on a full role with defined goals and performance measures.
• Participate in your team’s annual planning cycle, including setting targets, developing plans, and carrying out agreed actions.
• Make decisions within the scope of your role, implement changes, and measure results over the course of the rotation.
• Work with customers, partners, and cross-functional teams while taking responsibility for your work and its outcomes.
• Apply AI tools and data-driven analysis to improve how your area of the business operates.
• Build relationships across the organization and develop an understanding of how different teams and functions connect.
• Communicate results, insights, and lessons from each rotation to executive leaders.
• Contribute to the continued development of the program by sharing feedback and practical experience.
Requirements
• Be on track to complete an MBA, JD, or another relevant advanced degree before the program starts in June 2027. Relevant degrees may include a master’s degree in finance, management, business analytics, or a related field.
• Possess 5+ years of professional experience prior to graduation.
• Relevant knowledge or experience in business, law, technology, or a related field. This may include finance, economics, strategy, marketing, sales, engineering, computer or data science, information systems, or technology management.
• Demonstrated leadership through taking responsibility for results, leading initiatives, and building alignment with others, with or without direct reports.
• Experience using AI tools or an interest in continuing to develop AI-related knowledge and skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with varied audiences and build alignment with stakeholders across the organization.
• Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data to make and explain decisions.
• A collaborative approach that contributes to team success and supports the development of others.
• Ability to learn and apply new information, understand business considerations, adapt to changing priorities, take responsibility for outcomes, and continue developing professionally.
Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous well-being initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. The purpose of the Manager, Revenue Performance (Segment Strategist) is to serve as the chief architect of market growth, commercial strategy, and strategic revenue plays to achieve the organization's North Star: Driving sustainable, profitable revenue growth.
Operating as an autonomous, strategic thought partner to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), this role is fueled by deep intellectual curiosity about the end-to-end operations of the business. The incumbent systematically looks into every corner of the commercial engine—evaluating top-line expansion, gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), and churn mitigation—to uncover non-obvious levers that drive step-change growth.
This position establishes segment-level performance clarity, sizes high-confidence growth and risk levers (Enterprise, SMB, Government), models unit economics, forecasts early-stage customer friction, and translates complex operational data into scalable business processes, targeted improvement initiatives, and measurable commercial results. By integrating AI and enterprise automation into daily discovery, the Segment Strategist ensures long-term revenue predictability, capital efficiency, and sustainable revenue acceleration.
Key Responsibilities & Time Allocation (100%)
• Serve as the strategic domain expert and "Human in the Loop" for enterprise BI and predictive models—stress-testing statistical assumptions against commercial realities, validating algorithmic risk signals, and translating complex data science into actionable revenue strategies.
• Identify, size, and economically model high-impact enterprise, SMB, and government growth opportunities (e.g., fleet migration pipeline mapping, camera green space capture rates) to guide go-to-market investments.
• Conduct econometric and sensitivity analyses on core revenue drivers (win rate, early-stage churn, NRR, pipeline velocity) across customer cohorts to maintain less than 5% revenue forecast variance per month.
• Model customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, unit economics, and segment-specific margin contribution to provide executive leadership with financial framing for capital deployment, sales capacity, and incentive design.
GTM Process Optimization & Commercial Enablement (20%)
• Translate diagnostic insights into high-impact operational improvements, working in close partnership with Sales Enablement and Frontline Leadership to drive behavioral adoption and commercial results.
• Design commercial deal-qualification frameworks, customer fit criteria, and margin guardrails that eliminate point-of-sale revenue fallout and protect booked MRR.
• Partner with Customer Success/Sales Enablement to operationalize competitive playbooks, objection-handling frameworks, and bundle packaging strategies across frontline sales cohorts.
• Evaluate and streamline GTM business workflows (e.g., lead routing, rep tiering structures) by operationalizing AI-driven frameworks and low-code automation to eliminate administrative drag and accelerate pipeline velocity.
• Monitor the ongoing adoption and financial ROI of deployed GTM programs, continuously refining enablement and sales motions to ensure sustained performance lift.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & GTM Alignment (35%)
• Strategic Revenue Liaison: Serve as the central strategic liaison between Sales Directors (Enterprise, SMB, Government), Finance, Product, and RevOps technical modelers to synchronize go-to-market strategies and eliminating silos and process breakdowns that cause revenue leakage.
• GTM Program Framework Architecture: Partner closely with pipeline and operations leads to architect program frameworks and Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) targeting parameters (e.g., account-tier thresholds, unit minimums, and deal-yield criteria) that direct frontline sales focus toward high-margin, high-retention opportunities.
• Executive Influence & Decision Alignment: Influence cross-functional leaders through objective data, qualitative narratives, and clear financial framing, driving consensus across the business on where to deploy capital, sales capacity, and operational effort.
• Joint GTM Strategy Orchestration: Co-lead the commercial operating cadence between Segment Strategy and GTM Operations, ensuring cross-functional handoffs between strategic insights, enablement rollout, and sales floor execution are seamless and measurable.
Executive Data Analysis, AI, & Predictive Reporting (15%)
• Oversee the deep extraction, econometric synthesis, and AI-accelerated modeling of complex segment data across Salesforce, Looker, and enterprise data warehouses to uncover leading indicators of churn, pipeline risk, or expansion upside.
• Transition fragmented, manual spreadsheets into unified, live executive dashboards (Airtable / Looker) that serve as the single source of truth for the ELT.
• Architect and leverage prompt-based AI frameworks, generative agents, and conversational intelligence tools to synthesize unstructured sales interaction data and competitor signals into real-time executive intelligence.
• Produce concise, qualitative executive narratives that explain why metrics are moving and define the specific operational actions required to accelerate performance.
Strategic Thought Leadership & ELT Advisory (10%)
• Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership by providing financial framing for accelerate/pause/stop decisions on portfolio programs and GTM bets.
• Mentor junior analysts and operations professionals, enforcing strict analytical rigor, data architecture standards, and peer-review quality control.
This role is crucial in independently identifying systemic revenue opportunities, devising economic solutions, and providing strategic recommendations that directly influence the company's growth trajectory. The incumbent operates with minimal guidance, executing 2–4 deep strategic evaluations monthly.
Key domains of independent problem-solving include:
• Market Segmentation & Boundary Optimization: Independently analyzing historical win rates, sales cycle duration, and customer unit economics across customer cohorts to redefine market segment boundaries; modeling optimal sales capacity and specialized coverage models to maximize seller productivity and pipeline velocity.
• Predictive Retention Diagnostics & Commercial Guardrails: Uncovering macro-level retention risks across the customer lifecycle through cohort and survival analysis; designing commercial qualification standards, Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) criteria, and onboarding readiness frameworks that eliminate early-stage revenue fallout before deals are finalized.
• Whitespace Sizing & Expansion Portfolio Architecture: Sizing Total Addressable Market (TAM) and Serviceable Available Market (SAM) across existing enterprise and commercial customer bases; modeling multi-year migration economics, cross-sell attach rates, and contract consolidation strategies to capture high-margin recurring revenue without cannibalizing core sales focus.
• AI-Assisted Workflow Automation & Intelligence:
• Customer Interaction Analysis: Utilizing conversational intelligence and AI tools to analyze unstructured customer feedback, sales call transcripts, and market trends to identify emerging competitor pricing shifts in real time.
• Enhanced Predictive Modeling: Applying AI-assisted data analysis to streamline econometric modeling, evaluate sales scenarios, and test policy impacts across historical datasets.
• Automated Reporting & Insights: Building automated workflows to track pipeline health, detect deal anomalies, and generate clear executive summaries, converting manual data compilation into continuous operational visibility.

As a Customer Enablement Delivery Consultant, you will be the person our customers learn from. You will run the onboarding sessions, live webinars, office hours and recorded walkthroughs that take a new customer from first login to confident daily use, and you will keep existing customers current as the product changes. You will deliver a lot of sessions, to many customers, and make each one feel personal. You will be measured on how quickly customers reach value and how little help they need afterward, not on how many sessions you ran.
We move fast and everyone builds. You will adapt the standard curriculum on the fly, record a quick walkthrough when a customer needs one, and feed what you hear back to the people designing our content.
You’ll be:
• Delivering live virtual and recorded enablement for small and mid-sized business customers, including onboarding, product release sessions, office hours and one-to-many webinars, and adapting the standard curriculum to each audience’s industry, roles and goals.
• Running sessions that work for busy, distracted people: short, hands-on, built around the customer’s own data and workflows, and followed by the right self-serve resources so learning continues after the call.
• Using scheduling, engagement and product adoption data to prioritize which customers need live help, which can be served digitally, and which need a follow-up before they stall.

Job Description
Data Platform Strategy & Operations Lead, Data Operations
We are seeking an experienced Data Platform Strategy & Operations Lead to join the Tools Rationalization, Data Innovation and Operations team within the Enterprise Data Office. This role owns strategy definition, roadmap, operating model, financial performance, service health for EDO-owned or EDO-supported data platforms and tools, including Databricks, Snowflake, Data observability platform, and related capabilities.
About the Data Operations Team:
The Data Operations team provides the operating discipline and cross-functional leadership needed to run shared enterprise data platforms reliably. The team connects EDO platform strategy with technology delivery, production operations, financial management, data quality, observability, and stakeholder outcomes.
Vision : Enable dependable, scalable, observable, and cost-effective data platforms that teams across the bank can adopt with confidence to deliver Data Product.
Mission: Establish clearly defined platform roadmaps, enable new features, improve operational readiness, provide data observability and implement support models and performance management practices that improve reliability, transparency, and business outcomes.
About the Role:
The Data Platform Strategy & Operations Lead is a senior leader accountable for the end-to-end lifecycle of EDO-owned or EDO-supported data platforms. The role combines platform strategy, roadmap leadership, operational governance, FinOps, service management, enterprise data observability, and stakeholder communication.
This position translates enterprise data strategy, stakeholder demand, platform consumption, service performance, cost, risk, and emerging capabilities into prioritized roadmaps working with respective technology Teams. It also establishes the operating controls required for reliable production services and ensures that incidents, capacity constraints, data-quality/governance issues, and support trends feed back into platform investments and continuous improvement.
This role will own the data observability platform and be responsible for rollout across the bank along with ongoing maintenance of the processes and procedures to ensure data incidents are tracked and resolved timely by the responsible teams.
Key Activities:
· Help define and maintain multi-year platform roadmap for EDO owned data platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, observability platform, in partnership with technology and broader bank stakeholders.
· Connect business demand, architecture direction, capability maturity, technical dependencies, operational capacity, funding, cost, risk, and adoption priorities for roadmap planning and execution.
· Review and sign-off on operational readiness for owned platforms including disaster recovery plans and testing, performance management, ITSM metrics, capacity, request, and service-level metrics tracking and continuous-improvement actions. This includes Vendor Service Performance review.
· Drive FinOps, consumption reporting, forecasting, capacity review, showback or chargeback inputs, optimization recommendations, and benefit realization across supported data platforms.
· Own business and stakeholder communications for roadmap impacts, planned changes, incidents, service interruptions, recovery progress, risks, and service-level performance in coordination with TOS team.
· Own the enterprise data observability platform, including its product roadmap, rollout strategy, onboarding standards, integration priorities, service model, vendor management, and capability improvement.
· Lead the rollout of data observability across prioritized data products and pipelines, ensuring appropriate data-quality controls, lineage, freshness, volume, schema, reliability, and operational-health monitoring are implemented before production acceptance.
· Establish an end-to-end “eyes on glass” operating model that provides centralized visibility into critical data products, pipelines, and supporting platform services, with defined monitoring coverage, alert thresholds, severity criteria, routing, and escalation paths.
· Define observability onboarding and production-readiness criteria with data product owners, data engineers, platform teams, governance, and TOS, and track identified gaps through closure.
· Ensure data incidents generated are assigned to accountable product, pipeline, platform, or data owners, acknowledged within agreed targets, actively managed, and resolved within established SLAs.

Job Description
Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in driving product visioning, planning and development to deliver on our human + digital product strategy and staying one step ahead of evolving economic, technological, and customer needs.
This Product Manager will join the Business Banking Customer Onboarding organization and help shape and deliver the tools and capabilities that make it easier for customers to establish, activate, and begin using their banking relationships.
The role will own and influence a portfolio of onboarding capabilities used by customers and bankers, ranging from existing digital onboarding experiences to new capabilities designed to simplify how customers get started with U.S. Bank.
Working across Business Banking, Product, Technology, UX, Architecture, and external partners, this Product Manager will identify customer and business needs, translate those needs into product requirements, establish priorities, and guide capabilities from concept through implementation and adoption. The role is particularly collaborative and requires the ability to influence product and technology teams outside of the immediate organization to ensure Business Banking customer needs are represented.
Key Responsibilities:
• Own the product roadmap and backlog for assigned Business Banking customer onboarding tools and capabilities.
• Develop product vision and priorities based on customer needs, business objectives, and stakeholder requirements.
• Partner with Deposits, Business Card, Lending, and other Business Banking teams to understand how onboarding capabilities need to support their products and customers.
• Translate business and customer needs into actionable product requirements and priorities.
• Lead the implementation and evolution of onboarding capabilities, including solutions involving third-party technology partners.
• Partner with Technology, Architecture , UX, Marketing, vendors, and other Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.
• Influence teams outside of the immediate organization to ensure Business Banking requirements are incorporated into shared technologies and customer experiences.
• Evaluate new features and enhancements from a customer and product perspective and provide product acceptance and sign-off.
• Identify opportunities to simplify onboarding, reduce customer friction, and help customers activate and begin using their accounts and services more quickly.
• Provide customer and product perspective to UX partners to support intuitive experiences for customers and bankers.
Basic Qualifications:
• Product management experience.
• Experience working across business, product, and technology teams.
• Experience defining product requirements and supporting products or capabilities through implementation.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate product needs, priorities, and direction to diverse stakeholders.
• Ability to work collaboratively and influence outcomes across teams.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience owning or contributing to product roadmaps and product backlogs, including prioritization and requirements development.
• Experience with customer-facing digital products, onboarding experiences, account opening, customer activation, or related digital journeys.
• Experience in banking, financial services, payments, deposits, lending, business banking, or another complex or regulated environment.
• Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive product outcomes without direct authority.
• Experience partnering with engineering, technology, architecture, UX, and other technical stakeholders.
• Experience implementing products or capabilities involving third-party vendors or technology providers.
• Strong customer focus with the ability to evaluate whether features and experiences effectively address customer needs.
• Ability to translate business and customer needs into clear product requirements and communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical audiences.
• Comfort learning unfamiliar technologies and working with technical teams while maintaining ownership of the broader customer and product outcome.
**The role offers a hybrid/flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.**

Job Description
As a Data Analytics Consultant , you’ll use data to answer business questions, identify meaningful trends, and provide insights that support better decisions. You’ll work with large and complex data sets from multiple sources, applying analytical and statistical techniques to turn information into clear, actionable recommendations.
You’ll collaborate with business and technical partners to understand questions, conduct analysis, communicate findings, and measure the results of recommendations put into action.
In this role, you will:
• Gather, integrate, and analyze large volumes of data from multiple sources to address business questions.
• Identify and interpret trends, patterns, relationships, and opportunities within complex data sets.
• Apply statistical techniques and analytical tools to develop insights and recommendations.
• Translate complex analysis into clear, concise findings that enable partners to make data-driven decisions.
• Develop reports and visualizations that make analytical results accessible and actionable.
• Collaborate with business, technology, and analytics partners to provide a holistic view of data and findings.
• Support advanced analytics and predictive modeling initiatives.
• Measure and monitor the results of implemented recommendations and identify adjustments based on performance.
• Work with analytics and data tools that may include Python, Power BI, Adobe Analytics, Snowflake, Azure, Databricks, and GitHub Copilot.
• Apply agile methods and ways of working to support collaboration and delivery.
• Ensure data acquisition, sharing, analysis, and resulting recommendations comply with company standards.
Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience
• Four to five years of statistical and/or data analytics experience
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with advanced analytics, statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and complex data sets.
• Experience with Python, reporting, business intelligence, and data visualization tools such as Power BI.
• Experience with data platforms and environments such as Snowflake, Azure, and Databricks.
• Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar web analytics tools and AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot.
• Understanding of database architecture, data structures, and source systems.
• Strong project management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate analytical findings for varied audiences.
• Experience applying agile ways of working and collaborating across business and technical teams.
• Experience in financial services and/or progressively responsible reporting, business intelligence, or analytics work; an advanced quantitative degree is a plus.

Job Description
U.S. Bank is seeking a Data Analyst to support Merchant Payment Services (MPS) by combining advanced analytical capability with a strong customer experience mindset. This role will acquire and integrate data from multiple sources, apply statistical techniques and analytical tools, and translate complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. The analyst will examine Voice of Customer (VoC), operational and behavioral data to identify trends, key drivers, root causes and measurable improvement opportunities across the MPS customer journey.
The role partners closely with CX, Product, Operations, Technology and business stakeholders to design analyses, evaluate interventions, improve experience measurement and help leaders make evidence-based decisions. The ideal candidate is technically strong, curious about customer behavior, and able to connect rigorous analysis to practical business action.
What You’ll Do
· Acquire, integrate, validate and analyze large or complex datasets from customer, survey, operational, behavioral and business sources.
· Apply statistical methods to answer business questions, identify meaningful trends and patterns, assess relationships, and distinguish signal from noise.
· Design and evaluate A/B tests and other experiments, including hypothesis development, test design, statistical significance, interpretation and recommendations.
· Use Python, SQL and related analytical tools to prepare data, automate repeatable analyses, and develop reproducible analytical workflows.
· Conduct advanced analyses such as driver analysis, segmentation, forecasting, predictive modeling, root-cause analysis and pain-point sizing, as appropriate to the business question.
· Analyze VoC and CX data to identify customer needs, experience gaps, key satisfaction drivers and improvement opportunities across MPS journeys.
· Synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear, compelling insights and executive-ready narratives.
· Translate findings into prioritized recommendations that improve customer satisfaction, adoption, retention, efficiency or other relevant business outcomes.
· Develop and enhance dashboards, visualizations and recurring reporting that make insights accessible and actionable for stakeholders.
· Measure and monitor the results of implemented recommendations, identify emerging trends, and propose adjustments based on evidence.
· Partner cross-functionally with CX, Product, Operations, Technology, Data Science, Business Intelligence and business teams to provide a holistic view of performance and customer experience.
· Present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leaders; communicate methods, assumptions, limitations and implications clearly.
· Ensure data acquisition, use, sharing and analytical outputs comply with company standards, controls and applicable data-governance requirements.
· Stay current on analytics, experimentation, VoC and CX measurement practices and recommend enhancements to methods, tools and processes.
Basic Qualifications
· Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience
· Five to seven years of statistical and/or data analytics experience
Preferred Skills/Experience
· Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with R, SAS, SPSS or other statistical software is beneficial.
· Hands-on experience designing, analyzing and interpreting A/B tests or other controlled experiments.
· Experience with advanced analytics or statistical methods, including regression, driver or relative-importance analysis, segmentation, forecasting and predictive modeling.
· Experience with Voice of Customer and customer experience measurement, including CSAT, NPS, CES, journey analytics, pain-point analysis or related approaches.
· Experience with Qualtrics or a similar VoC platform, including survey data extraction, preparation and analysis.
· Ability to combine survey, customer, operational, financial and behavioral data to quantify experience gaps and business impact.
· Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with proficiency in Power BI or similar tools and advanced Excel and PowerPoint capabilities.
· Experience translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and measurable hypotheses.
· Strong problem-solving, project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
· Effective interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders through evidence.
· Experience in payments, merchant acquiring, financial services or another complex, data-rich industry.
· Master’s degree in a quantitative, analytical or customer-focused discipline is a plus.

Job Description
Counterparty Risk Group
The counterparty credit risk management function is responsible for the management and control of counterparty risk at US Bank. The group provides independent review of counterparty risk across the business, producing detailed analysis of the derivative portfolio for internal and external constituents and manage the control framework under which counterparty risk is governed.
Job Description
Responsible for conducting pre-trade counterparty credit risk analysis for a broad range of products, including interest rate derivatives, foreign exchange (FX) derivatives, commodity derivatives, credit derivatives, and repo transactions . The role involves quantifying counterparty risk exposure through measures such as Expected Exposure (EE), Potential Future Exposure (PFE), and stressed exposure metrics to assess the potential impact of adverse market movements and counterparty default.
The analyst evaluates proposed transactions against approved credit limits, risk appetite, collateral arrangements, and regulatory requirements to ensure appropriate risk-taking and limit compliance prior to trade execution. Working closely with trading, credit, and risk management teams, the analyst identifies material risk concentrations, recommends risk mitigants where necessary, and helps ensure that counterparty credit risk is accurately measured, monitored, and controlled across the trading portfolio.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
- Typically more than six years of applicable experience
Preferred Qualifications and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline, with 2-4 years of experience in counterparty risk, market risk, trading, CVA, or a related quantitative risk management function ; or
• Master's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 1-2 years of relevant experience in counterparty risk, market risk, trading, CVA, or quantitative analytics .
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to evaluate and interpret complex risk exposures.
• Understanding of counterparty credit risk concepts, including Expected Exposure (EE), Potential Future Exposure (PFE), CVA, collateral management, and netting agreements .
• Knowledge of financial products such as interest rate derivatives, FX derivatives, commodity derivatives, credit derivatives, and repo transactions .
• Ability to assess transactions against counterparty credit limits and identify material risk drivers.
• Proficiency in data analysis and risk reporting tools; experience with Python, SQL, VBA, or risk management platforms is a plus.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to present risk assessments and recommendations to trading, credit, and senior risk management stakeholders.
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced trading and risk management environment.

In this role, you will analyze complex data, identify emerging fraud trends, and develop strategies that prevent fraud across new account originations. You will own fraud rule strategies for one or more products, leveraging SAS, SQL, Python, and other analytical tools to design, test, implement, and optimize fraud controls. Working closely with partners across operations, technology, and risk management, you will quantify business impacts, balance fraud mitigation, customer experience, and operational efficiency to drive continuous improvement of fraud prevention capabilities
The ideal candidate is passionate about protecting customers, thrives in a fast‑paced environment, and brings creativity to identifying fraud patterns and shaping effective rule strategies. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role requires strong analytical judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to drive fraud strategy initiatives with limited oversight.
You will evaluate emerging fraud trends, assess the performance and efficiency of existing rules, and leverage statistical analysis and performance monitoring to make data-driven recommendations regarding rule thresholds, segmentation, and treatment strategies. You will also design and execute strategy tests and champion/challenger initiatives to evaluate rule performance and identify opportunities for optimization. As a self‑starter and collaborative contributor, you will work closely with teams across and beyond the Quantitative Fraud Strategy organization to develop sustainable strategies, share insights, and support rule development across key areas including First‑Party Fraud and Third‑Party Fraud.
This role emphasizes analytical skills, effective decision-making, and the ability to deliver clear, actionable recommendations informed by a strong understanding of rule strategy, operational considerations, and strategic priorities.
Primary Responsibilities
•
• Develop, implement, and continuously refine fraud rule strategies that leverage departmental data, balancing fraud mitigation, false positive rates, and alignment with organizational priorities
• Analyze large, complex datasets to identify emerging fraud trends, performance shifts, and strategic opportunities that inform rule development and refinement
• Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations and communicate strategy updates, rule performance insights, and business impacts to management, partners, and key stakeholders
• Monitor and evaluate rule performance on an ongoing basis, detecting anomalies, validating thresholds, and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen existing strategies and processes
• Leverage approved AI, analytics, automation, and visualization tools to accelerate insight generation, improve operational efficiency, and enhance fraud detection capabilities
• Collaborate closely with operations, technology, risk management, and cross‑functional teams to validate rule effectiveness, conduct root‑cause analysis, and ensure alignment with compliance and governance standards
Basic Qualificatio ns
- Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
- Typically more than six years of applicable experience
Preferred Skills and Experience
•
• Strong background in fraud analytics and rule development, with demonstrated ability to identify emerging fraud trends and translate findings into effective rule changes
• Strong understanding and experience in SQL, SAS, and Python, with the ability to independently design analytical frameworks, automate complex processes, build predictive models, and translate large-scale data into actionable fraud risk strategies and business recommendations.
• Experience supporting fraud strategy development within account origination, onboarding, identity verification, or digital banking environments
• Experience with external fraud and identity providers (Socure, LexisNexis, Sentilink, etc.)
• Experience performing strategy testing, segmentation analysis, or champion/challenger experiments
• Experience working in large datasets to support strategy testing, treatment analysis, and performance evaluation
• Knowledge of Fair and Responsible Banking principles and compliance considerations in strategy development
• Comprehensive knowledge of bank systems and experience with fraud decisioning platforms and rule engines
• Thorough understanding of fraud typologies, including First-Party Fraud, Third-Party Fraud, Synthetic Identity Fraud, and related fraud risks, along with experience developing mitigation strategies
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present complex analytical findings, fraud trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
• Ability to influence cross-functional partners through data-driven recommendations and effective communication.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑moving environment, demonstrating strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and effective decision-making
• Commitment to compliance, internal controls, and ethical use of technology, including responsible use of approved AI tools to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and productivity
• Proficient computer navigation skills, including Microsoft Office and data analysis software
• Bachelor’s degree in Quantitative field; Master’s degree a plus
LOCATION EXPECTATIONS: This role requires working from a U.S. Bank Location three (3) or more days per week.

The Payment Sales Consultant serves as a senior payments strategist, leading the end-to-end delivery of U.S. Bank's treasury and payment solutions while driving client growth, retention, and revenue expansion throughout the St. Louis and Kansas City markets. Acting as a trusted advisor to clients and Relationship Managers, this recognized industry expert develops sales strategies, manages complex portfolios, mentors team members, and delivers innovative solutions across receivables, payables, liquidity, merchant, card, and trade services.

• Strong relationship management and business development skills with a proven ability to deepen client relationships and drive revenue growth.

Holistic Payments & Deposits Solutioning

• Translate those needs into integrated, client-centric solutions by engaging product specialists and implementation teams.
