ROLE SUMMARY
The Data Analyst, Medical Insights Senior Manager is accountable for delivering ad hoc and exploratory analysis that answers business and scientific questions the platform can't natively address, working globally across regions and the Medical Insights team. This role partners closely with the Insights Platform Lead, surfacing where recurring analytical requests reveal gaps the platform should be built to close. It's a strategic fit for an analyst who wants direct, high-visibility impact on real business decisions while helping shape the future direction of a fast-growing global analytics platform.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
Ad Hoc & Exploratory Analysis (~70-80%)
• Respond to ad hoc business and medical questions that cannot currently be answered through InsightXplorer, going directly to underlying data sources as needed.
• Investigate and synthesize findings into clear, decision-relevant outputs for Medical Affairs stakeholders.
• Prepare, validate, and maintain datasets required for exploratory and recurring analyses.
• Partner with Engagement Leads to clarify business questions, analytical scope, and timelines.
Experimentation & Innovation (~20-30%, protected)
• Test, pilot, and evaluate new data sources, analytical methods, or AI-enabled approaches ahead of platform investment.
• Produce proof-of-concept analyses that give the Product Director independent, evidence-based input into roadmap prioritization decisions.
• Document findings, limitations, and recommendations from experimentation to inform go/no-go platform decisions.
Quality & Documentation
• Maintain documentation for data sources, definitions, transformations, assumptions, and analytical methods.
• Support responsible, compliant use of Medical Insights data in accordance with governance, privacy, and legal requirements.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of external stakeholders to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.
• Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Clinical Informatics, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
• 6+ years of relevant experience conducting data analysis, interpretation, and reporting in a pharmaceutical, healthcare, or regulated environment; 5+ years with Masters; 1+ year with PharmD/PHD
• Proficiency with analytical and data-visualization tools such as SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Dataiku, Python, or R.
• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches and clear outputs, working independently.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical accuracy, documentation, and reproducibility.
Preferred Qualifications
• Advanced degree or certification in analytics, data science, statistics, or a related discipline.
• Experience in Medical Affairs or a related pharmaceutical function.
• Familiarity with natural-language processing, machine learning, or text-analytics approaches.
• Experience running proof-of-concept or pilot analyses ahead of production build-out.
Professional Capabilities
• Applies analytical and critical thinking to complex medical and business questions.
• Balances reactive, time-sensitive analysis with protected proactive experimentation.
• Communicates complex analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Other Job Details:
• Last Date to Apply for Job: November 30th, 2026.
• NOT eligible for Relocation Package
• Locations: North America - any Pfizer site
• This position is hybrid and requires working from site 2 to 3 days per week

Patient Solutions is an evolving and highly important area for the success of Pfizer Specialty Care (SC). Due to the complexity of the patient journey in many specialty care therapeutic areas, up to 50% of specialty medications never get dispensed after an HCP writes the script. The role of the Patient Solutions and Engagement (PSE) team is to simplify a patient’s path from diagnosis through treatment , doing so by educating patients about disease area & Pfizer medications, partnering to accelerate time to treatment, and championing the voice of the patient.
Reporting to the SC PSE Lead, the Patient Solutions Strategy Lead is a Specialty Care enterprise-focused role responsible for defining and driving the strategic roadmap of SCPSE’s model, positioning Pfizer as a definite leader in specialty patient support over the next two years. Providing subject matter expertise and strategies in compliant ways to simplify patient and customer experience in SC while ensuring the nuances of each therapeutic area, he/she will be a key member of the US SCPSE leadership team.
Working closely with the Patient Solutions leadership, the SC Patient Services (PPS) Lead, and marketing, the Strategy Lead will lead the short-mid term strategy for how the Patient Solutions teams, HUB, SPP & digital enablement come together to ensure that patients who need Pfizer’s specialty medicines can access and sustain their therapy.
Leveraging external and competitive insights and trends, the role will bring actionable insights to ensure we are proactively evolving to meet the needs of patients & customers. In so doing he/she will partner to support seamless execution across all parts of patient support services. The strategy lead will also partner with PS leaders, Pfizer Digital and PPS to develop and govern an AI/digital roadmap for patient solutions and in translating strategy into executional excellence, and own the SC PSE performance framework and dashboards with ISS and Enablement.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITES
Strategy, Vision & Transformation
• Own and advance the strategic roadmap for PSE — translating a SC Patient Solutions vision into phased plans, resource cases, and measurable milestones.
• Partner with PSE LT to define and advance teams vision, strategy, and competitive positioning.
• Develop the multi-year operating model strategy — encompassing field force design, territory deployment, NBA integration, and digital-physical channel orchestration.
• Lead the SC Patient Solutions BAT in partnership with PSE Enablement Lead, ensuring cross-functional understanding and activation against priority strategies.
Competitive Intelligence & External Landscape
• Assess the external landscape across patient support, access strategy, and HCP engagement & deliver actionable insights on emerging trends, competitive activity, regulatory developments, and payer dynamics in Rare Disease and I&I.
Digital, AI & Technology Strategy
• Partner with Enablement, Pfizer Digital and PPS to develop AI/digital roadmap aligned with operating model roadmap & capabilities e.g. intelligent case management, predictive modelling, and FRM decision-support.
• Evaluate and recommend emerging technology platforms through— closely monitoring vendors and emerging solutions with GAV/Digital functional teams.
Patient Outcomes, Analytics & Measurement
• Own the SCPSE performance framework, ensuring pull-through & accountability of leading indicators (e.g. time-to-therapy, paid fulfillment rate, NTB conversion) and lagging outcomes (e.g. persistence), working with IIS, Enablement & PPS leads.
• Identify KPI evolution aligned with operating model roadmap & brand strategies.
Cross-functional Leadership & Brand Partnership
• Act as a key partner to brand teams for full understanding of brand trends, patient access needs, and SCPSE strategy — including PSAC coordination between PS, PPS and brand team.
• Drive connectivity across SCPSE and partnering functions to ensure alignment of patient needs across the full journey — with a focus on seamless experience across all SC TA’s.
• Partner with Patient Services leaders in the access and reimbursement space to represent and advance Pfizer's interest and expertise externally.
•
• Function as a key enabler in building a strong SCPSE enterprise culture — partnering with PX, marketing, legal and compliance, and commercial colleagues to ensure the function's value, mission, and vision are understood and activated.
QUALIFICATIONS
• Strong understanding of US Patient Solutions Space – both Access & Reimbursement, Patient Engagement and Advocacy
• 12+ years' pharmaceutical industry experience with recent patient support experience and a BA degree
• Demonstrated track record of leading transformation agendas in patient support, commercial operations, or market access — with evidence of moving from vision to measurable outcomes.
• Working knowledge of AI/digital enablement in patient services — eg. NBA tools, CRM platforms, automated PA workflows. Strategic literacy required; deep technical expertise is not.
• Experience developing outcomes-based performance frameworks and presenting them with credibility to senior leadership.
• Familiarity with the hub services landscape — including insourcing/outsourcing considerations, specialty pharmacy dynamics, and vendor partnership models.
• Proven record of challenging the status quo in best interest of patients (while ensuring 100% compliance).
• Familiarity with strategic and operating planning processes.
• Exceptional interpersonal skills and mastery of working in a matrix environment.
• Experience working cross-functionally in the patient support space, with demonstrated ability to influence and persuade key stakeholders.
• Demonstrated strategic mindset with past example(s) of strategy contributions.
• Must be able to both drive strategy and execute with speed and high quality.
• Strong learning agility with the ability to understand and adapt to the nuances within Specialty Care, to continuously deliver rigorous and tailored solutions
• Role model for the PFE Values (Courage, Excellence, Equity and Joy).
• Strong communication / presentation skills and executive presence to be able to interact effectively with all levels of the organization, including senior management.
NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS
Ability to travel 20%. Location: NY HQ preferred; flexibility for US Pfizer sites & Remote.

ROLE SUMMARY
The Associate, AIA Strategy provides analytical and project support to the cross-portfolio strategic initiatives that shape how Pfizer's U.S. Commercial organization deploys AI. The role helps frame problems, structure analysis, build executive-ready materials, and keep initiatives moving, turning ambiguous cross-functional questions into clear, well-organized work that informs portfolio decisions.
Reporting to the Senior Director, AI Strategy Lead, AIA, the Associate works closely with members of the Strategy & Portfolio team and partners across the broader AI Acceleration (AIA) organization. The role offers broad exposure to the portfolio and leadership team, with increasing ownership of workstreams and deliverables over time.
WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Cross-portfolio strategic initiatives are how AI Acceleration turns strategy into coordinated action across Product Management, Data, Tech, and Transformation. As the volume and ambition of that work grows, the Strategy & Portfolio team needs dedicated analytical capacity to keep it well-structured, rigorous, and moving.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Initiative Support
• Help frame problems and structure workstreams for cross-portfolio strategic initiatives.
• Build and maintain project plans, timelines, and action trackers; keep initiatives on schedule.
• Prepare agendas, pre-reads, and follow-ups for working sessions and leadership reviews.
• Surface risks, dependencies, and open decisions early so they can be resolved.
2. Analysis and Synthesis
• Gather, organize, and synthesize data, research, and stakeholder input into clear findings.
• Build analyses and simple frameworks that inform portfolio prioritization and investment decisions.
• Turn ambiguous or messy inputs into structured, decision-ready outputs.
• Support value and ROI tracking by assembling and quality-checking inputs.
3. Executive-Ready Materials
• Own specific deliverables end-to-end, including decks, briefs, and summaries, to a high standard.
• Translate complex analysis into clear, concise materials for senior and executive audiences.
• Maintain a consistent, on-brand standard across Strategy & Portfolio outputs.
4. Portfolio and Operating-Model Support
• Help maintain the portfolio view, roadmap, and planning cadence, including trackers and operating rhythm.
• Support preparation for portfolio council, planning, and leadership-review cycles.
• Keep shared documentation, inputs, and records accurate and current.
5. Cross-Functional Coordination
• Coordinate across the AI Acceleration leadership team — Product Management, Data, Tech, and Transformation — to gather inputs and move initiatives forward.
• Build strong working relationships that help the team operate as the connective layer across the portfolio.
• Communicate clearly and reliably with partners at all levels.
6. Learning and Growth
• Take on stretch assignments that build strategic, analytical, and leadership skills.
• Grow in scope, autonomy, and ownership over the first 12 to 18 months.
SUCCESS MEASURES
• Quality and relevance of horizon-scanning insights and strategic recommendations.
• External technology opportunities converted into pilots, partnership recommendations, product concepts, or roadmap priorities.
• Speed and rigor of opportunity evaluation and disposition.
• Adoption of recommendations in U.S. Commercial planning and investment decisions.
• Influence on future Commercial Engine and applied AI priorities.
• Quality of external capability assessments and partnership recommendations advanced to the AI Partnerships & Ecosystem Lead.
• Clarity and transparency of the innovation opportunity pipeline.

Must-Have

• Internship or coursework in management consulting, corporate strategy, or product and portfolio analysis.
• Interest in, or exposure to, AI and its commercial applications.
• Familiarity with pharmaceuticals, healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
• Comfort with data-analysis tools and modern productivity and AI tools.

Role Summary
Discovery, Preclinical, and Translational Solutions (DP&TS) sits at the center of Pfizer’s scientific software work, building the digital tools that help researchers move from target identification through clinical translation.
This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll build and run workloads on AWS and GCP using Kubernetes and containers, and you’ll write production code in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll own both the platforms and the applications that run on them.
We’re looking for a Solution Engineer to own data visualization, analytics, and collaboration capabilities for integrative biology within DP&TS. In this individual contributor role you’ll design, build, and maintain the platform, not just direct others. You’ll also work closely with the aligned capability lead to prioritize what gets built.
You’ll need strong technical depth in data visualization, analytics, collaboration platforms, and cloud-native engineering, along with the ability to set standards for the capability area. You’ll lead contractors as needed and partner across scientific, product, and engineering stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable solutions.
Reporting to the Principal Engineer, Integrative Biology Solutions, you’ll own the technical direction for visualization, analytics, and collaboration capabilities. This role doesn’t conduct data science research but you’ll need a strong grasp of how data scientists work and what they need from visualization and collaboration tooling to build the right platform.
Your technical decisions affect the speed, quality, and reproducibility of research across DP&TS. The problems cross scientific workflows, data engineering, and cloud infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
• Own and Lead Solution Implementation: own visualization, analytics, and collaboration solutions for Integrative Biology end-to-end: design, build, deployment, and maintenance.
• Collaborate with Capability Lead on Prioritization and Roadmap: work with the R&D Capability Lead to prioritize and scope features; translate scientific needs into concrete technical requirements and delivery plans.
• Design and Implement Advanced Visualization and Analytics Solutions: architect, build, and maintain scalable visualization and analytics solutions for Integrative Biology research, including interactive dashboards, visual exploration tools, and platforms that handle large-scale biological datasets.
• Build and Operate Cloud Infrastructure: design, provision, and operate infrastructure on AWS and GCP using infrastructure-as-code. Deploy and manage containerized workloads on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE), including cluster configuration, networking, access control, scaling, and cost management.
• Develop Production Software: write, test, and maintain production-quality code in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, including services, APIs, automation, and web-based visualization applications. Follow sound engineering practices: version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD.
• Deliver Collaboration Solutions: build and maintain collaboration environments that let data scientists and research teams share and explore biological data securely and reproducibly.
• Lead Contractor Teams and Delivery: direct contractor teams when needed: provide technical guidance, review work, and hold delivery to quality and security standards.
• Define Standards and Best Practices: set and maintain technical standards and governance frameworks for the capability area, ensuring consistency and quality across the Integrative Biology ecosystem.
• Drive Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence: proactively identify and address reliability, performance, scalability, and security gaps through monitoring, logging, and alerting across cloud and Kubernetes environments. Keep solutions current as scientific and operational needs evolve.
• Understand and Translate Scientific Needs: build a working knowledge of how data scientists use visualization, analytics, and collaboration tools — and use that understanding to build the right platform, not just a technically sound one.
Basic Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline)
Experience:
• 6+ years of progressive experience in solution engineering, software engineering, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on design and implementation of cloud platforms and data visualization, analytics, or collaboration solutions
• Proven experience owning and leading the end-to-end delivery of technical solutions in a complex enterprise or scientific environment, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance
• Experience leading contractor teams or matrixed delivery teams to implement technical solutions, with strong ability to provide technical direction, manage work quality, and drive delivery outcomes
Technical Skills
• Proficiency in Python and/or other modern high-level languages used in data engineering and scientific computing
• Hands-on experience building and operating workloads on both AWS and GCP
• Production experience with Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or similar) and containerization (Docker), including Helm or equivalent packaging
• Strong software development skills in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, with experience shipping and maintaining production code
• Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
• Working knowledge of data engineering and data platform concepts, including data ingestion, transformation, and storage patterns relevant to supporting visualization and analytics workloads in cloud environments
Other Requirements
• Demonstrated experience in working with regulated data, compliance frameworks, and secure development practices
• Ability to lead complex engineering efforts across global, cross-functional teams
• Fluent in English; capable of clear technical communication across scientific and engineering disciplines
Preferred Qualifications
Education: Master’s or PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or related discipline)
Domain Expertise
• Experience working in pharmaceutical R&D, life sciences, academic research, or a similar scientific research environment; familiarity with how data scientists and computational biologists work and what visualization, analytics, and collaboration tools they depend on
• Conceptual understanding of the data and analytical workflows used in integrative biology research, including the types of visualizations, analysis outputs, and collaborative review processes involved in omics, imaging, proteomics, or other high-dimensional biological data domains
Cloud and Platform Engineering
• AWS or GCP professional certifications; CKA or CKAD
• Experience with GitOps tooling (e.g., Argo CD, Flux)
• Experience with observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Cloud Monitoring)
• Experience building web front ends with modern frameworks (e.g., React) for data visualization
Research Domain Awareness
• Hands-on experience with data visualization and analytics tools and platforms used in omics, imaging, proteomics, or other high-dimensional biological data analysis (e.g., Tableau, Spotfire, custom D3/Plotly/Dash applications)
• Experience implementing or administering scientific collaboration solutions (e.g., electronic lab notebooks, knowledge management platforms, shared analytical workspaces) in a research or enterprise environment
Scientific Collaboration
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with data scientists, computational biologists, or research scientists to understand their workflows, translate their needs into technical requirements, and deliver solutions that fit their ways of working
• Familiarity with FAIR data principles, scientific data management best practices, or open-source tools and ecosystems used in the life sciences research community

At Pfizer, we are committed to discovering and developing innovative medicines and vaccines to improve the lives of people around the world. Pfizer Global Supply (PGS) External Supply (ES) manages Pfizer’s Buy-side network of contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) that manufacture and supply Pfizer medicines and vaccines, while Pfizer CentreOne (PC1) is Pfizer’s Sell-side business. As the External Supply Network Strategy Lead, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing the strategic network direction of both the ES Buy-side network and the PC1 Sell-side network in close collaboration with the PGS Network Strategy team, ensuring their continued success in delivering exceptional services to Pfizer and to our customers.
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced individual to join our team as the External Supply Network Strategy Lead. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing the strategic network roadmap for PC1 (Sell-side), aligning it with the PGS overall network strategy and the strategic network roadmap for External Supply, covering the Buy-side (ES CMO network) aligned with the PGS overall network strategy and business objectives. This position is an individual contributor role that will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including the PGS Network Strategy team, ES Sourcing, ES Procurement, ES Cluster Leads, PC1 Business Development, PC1 Operations, Quality, Finance and senior leadership, to drive growth and enhance the overall value proposition of PC1 and the supply resilience and value across Pfizer’s external CMO network.
On the Sell-side (PC1), this role is accountable for ensuring adherence/alignment to the PGS Network Strategy and for supporting the PC1 BD/Operations strategy across the network with respect to new sales growth initiatives and capability offerings.
On the Buy-side (ES), this role is accountable for the ES Network Strategy: leading ES Network Strategy Assessments and Network Strategy Projects (scoped from SKU to product to CMO to business portfolio), supporting governance of the ES Sourcing process (including exploratory sourcing requests) and of the ES Exit process – the end-to-end management of network ‘Ins & Outs’ – together with ownership of the ES Network Strategy Operating Model and governance.
This role will also partner with the PC1 Operations for account lifecycle strategies.
Actively identifies and realises synergies between the Buy-side and Sell-side networks, e.g. leveraging the ES contract manufacturing organization (CMO) network to support PC1 network supply nodes.
Furthermore, the individual must be detail oriented, good with data analytics, a strong user of Digital/Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools (including AI agents and Network Intelligence/data tools), and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with the ability to respond to multiple, conflicting business needs with urgency and accuracy.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead Sell-side (PC1) Network Strategy:
• Partner with PC1 in the development and execution of the strategic network plan for Pfizer CentreOne, including defining long-term goals, identifying growth opportunities and assessing the competitive landscape, in strong collaboration with the PC1 Business Development team
• Lead the governance between PC1 and Network Strategy on PGS/PC1 sales strategy alignment, PC1 market variability analysis and PC1 progress on new business generation for the targeted assets
• Commit to PC1 financial growth objectives
• Continuously search for strategic opportunities within PGS to support enterprise objectives and present opportunities to ES and PGS Network Strategy Leadership
Lead Buy-side (ES) Network Strategy:
• Develop, maintain and execute the ES Network Strategy for Pfizer’s external CMO network, aligned with the PGS Network Strategy and ES business strategy, covering network shape and footprint, capability and capacity, supply resilience and make-vs-buy considerations
• Lead ES Network Strategy Assessments (evaluation of the ES network impact of portfolio, supply and enterprise decisions) and Network Strategy Projects, scoped from SKU to product to CMO to business portfolio
• Provide leadership and governance of the ES Sourcing process (including exploratory sourcing requests) and the ES Exit process, ensuring a controlled end-to-end flow of network ‘Ins & Outs’ in partnership with ES Procurement, ES Clusters, Quality, Finance and Supply Chain
• Own the ES Network Strategy Operating Model (including the Strategic Relationship Model and Technology Platform Model) and the ES Network Strategy governance, providing overall project status tracking and Ins & Outs reporting to ES leadership
• Act as the authoritative source for ES Network Intelligence queries, providing data-driven responses on the ES network and ensuring network data and tools remain current and trusted
Integrate Buy-side and Sell-side Network Strategy:
• Maintain a single, integrated view of Pfizer’s supply network (ES CMOs and PC1 supply nodes) and present integrated network opportunities and risks to ES and PGS Network Strategy Leadership
• Identify and realise cross-network synergies
• Ensure consistent network strategy methodologies, data standards and governance are applied across both sides of the business
Cross-functional Collaboration:
• Partner with the PGS Network Strategy team to ensure alignment with available capacity and capabilities for PC1 Business Development
• Foster strong relationships with internal stakeholders, such as PC1, ES Procurement, ES Cluster Leads, ES Quality, PGS Strategy & Operational Excellence Network, finance, legal, regulatory affairs and supply chain, to ensure alignment and collaboration on strategic initiatives
• Accountable for the management and visibility of the PGS Capability and Capacity tool and the ES network data and intelligence tools
• Support PC1 Business Development on new sales strategies impacting PGS and align PGS internal stakeholders for input and approval
Industry Engagement:
• Stay abreast of industry trends through relevant industry forums, conferences and trade associations

Associate Consultants are responsible for conducting a variety of analyses across multiple “big data” platforms to generate quantitative summaries, insights, and recommendations that address key business questions for our clients. • An interest in and desire to learn about the constantly evolving healthcare industry

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
Position Summary
At BMS, Business Insights & Technology (BI&T) is critical to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, analytics, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
Transform your education and experience into fast-track career growth by joining the Technology Rotational Development Program, offering a high-performing culture that is made up of a powerfully diverse and inclusive workforce. The Technology Rotational Development Program’s (IT RDP) mission is to cultivate future leaders that accelerate BMS’s technology and AI transformation to ultimately serve our patients.
We are looking for MBA/Master’s graduates with professional experience for our June 2027 cohort who have a passion for driving innovative technology solutions to accelerate our mission of helping patients prevail over serious diseases. The program offers you the flexibility to create your own path through rotational projects and stretch assignments aligned with your interests and the company’s most critical needs, allowing for a completely customized developmental experience. Upon completion of the program, associates will have the opportunity to continue in a full-time role that aligns with their career aspirations and passion for enhancing patient lives with digital solutions.
IT RDP Is an Individualized Career Launch Pad that Offers 3 Key Areas of Opportunities:
1) Learn: Obtain Expertise in Your Desired Domains (Technical & Non-Technical)
• Real work from day one. You’ll spend 80% of your time on high-impact rotation projects and 20% on your own growth and career development.
• Learning built into the job. Training, workshops, conferences, and professional events help you build expertise quickly in the areas you want to pursue.
• Room to stretch and connect. Stretch assignments push you past your comfort zone, and People & Business Resource Groups (PBRGs) connect you with colleagues across BMS.
• Impact beyond the workplace. Volunteering opportunities let you give back to the community, with up to two paid volunteer days each year.
2) Network: Build an Extensive Network (Internal and External)
• Mentorship at every step. Each rotation pairs you with an executive sponsor and a rotation sponsor, and you’ll have more mentors throughout the program.
• A seat at the leadership table. Regular meetings with technology leadership teams, including the Chief Digital & Technology Officer (CDTO), give you direct exposure to how BMS sets its technology strategy.
• An alumni network that opens doors. In more than 30 years, the program has built a strong network of alumni in leadership roles across BMS.
• Connections across BMS and beyond. You’ll meet peers in rotational programs in other BMS functions and grow your professional network outside the company.
3) Leadership Brand: Craft Your Leadership Trademark
• Learn directly from senior leaders. You’ll get visibility with senior leaders and mentorship from them, so you can see how they make decisions and lead.
• See the full picture. Monthly discovery sessions with BI&T leaders across the organization show you how each part of the business uses technology. This also helps you pick your next rotation and your long-term path.
• Growth built around you. A personalized development plan, internal courses, workshops, and free LinkedIn Learning help you shape the kind of leader you want to become.
Program Structure
• 2-year full-time rotational program
• Three 8-month rotations in different BI&T areas such as AI, R&D, Commercialization, Cybersecurity, Cloud Team, etc.
• Customized rotations and unique stretch assignments
• Rotations will be based within one of our central New Jersey offices
• Lead one key program pillar, including recruiting, communications and marketing, events, or onboarding
• Close-knit, collegial environment
Basic Qualifications:
• Graduation with an MBA or other master’s degree in December 2026 or Spring 2027
• Minimum of 3 years of full-time professional experience, including demonstrated leadership such as leading cross-functional teams or delivering products, programs, or initiatives against defined timelines
• All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of their employment. Please note that visa sponsorship, including for student or temporary work authorization programs, is not available for this role. Candidates must have work authorization that does not require sponsorship now or in the future.
Preferred Qualifications:
• MBA preferred; we also welcome candidates from other relevant master’s programs, such as Data Science, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, or Operations
• Dual or combined degrees (e.g., an engineering or technical undergraduate degree paired with an MBA)
• Experience in technology, AI, or healthcare
• Experience developing or delivering technology products on a defined timeline
If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.
What We Look For:
• Energy and a strategic mindset to pursue excellence, setting high standards for themselves and their teams and pushing to learn something new every day
• Desire to constantly learn the ever-changing technology landscape and apply key findings to ensure BMS remains a leader in the industry
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to organize and present ideas in a convincing and compelling manner to audiences at multiple levels within the organization, including executive audiences
• Ability to examine complex business situations, draw conclusions, and recommend and execute innovative solutions in a timely manner
• Embraces new ideas and diverse perspectives, is open to change, and demonstrates resilience
• Demonstrated leadership experience through professional work, student or professional organizations, or community involvement, such as leading cross-functional teams or delivering a product or program against a defined timeline (technology product experience a plus)
• Takes ownership of their own outcomes and their team’s, celebrates successes, shares information transparently, and is eager to coach and mentor others
• Act with urgency and agility by consulting with the right people to move quickly, break silos, and make decisions with efficiency and effectiveness
• Passion for using business insights and technology to solve real industry challenges and help patients live healthier lives
Other Desired Skills
• Foundational understanding of, or strong curiosity about, IT concepts such as cloud, data, applications, AI, or cybersecurity. Exposure to programming or query languages (e.g., Python, SQL) is a plus. Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt across rotations.
• Project Management, Analytics, Business Analysis, Business Case Development, Process Redesign & Continuous Improvement, Quality Mindset & Performance Measurement, Financial Analysis, Change Management, Design Thinking, Product Management, Agile/Scrum
We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
Compensation Overview:
Princeton - NJ - US: $103,700 - $125,660

The role owns patient journey insight, direct-to-consumer (DTC) omnichannel content, the tracking and local adaptation of US patient materials, and professional society and congress engagement, and supports Corporate Affairs-led disease awareness campaigns. Reports to the Business Unit Director; Brand Leads and the Corporate Affairs Lead are the primary internal customers.
Key Responsibilities
• Patient Strategy Execution:
• Co-creates the annual patient plan with Brand Leads and the Corporate Affairs Lead, escalating competing priorities to the Business Unit Director.
• Translates brand strategy into patient-facing execution plans; Brand Leads retain accountability for brand strategy and performance.
• Accountable for the quality, timeliness and compliance of patient-facing tactics, and for defining and reporting their success metrics.
• Manages assigned budget and agency/vendor support, and uses field and market insight to continuously improve patient engagement.
• Patient Journey and Insight:
• Owns the patient journey for each brand, from diagnosis through treatment initiation and adherence, identifying friction points that limit outcomes.
• Maintains the cell therapy referral-to-treatment pathway, including referral, apheresis, bridging therapy, caregiver requirements and treating center logistics.
• Integrates market research, BI&A analytics, secondary data, and field and Corporate Affairs insight into patient segmentation and actionable recommendations.
• Omnichannel and DTC Content:
• Owns end-to-end DTC patient content, from omnichannel strategy and creation through deployment, including Spanish-language development and cultural adaptation. HCP-facing content remains with Brand Leads.
• Partners with the Omnichannel COE and BI&A to measure and optimize DTC channel performance.
• US Materials Tracking, Adaptation and Local Approval:
• Monitors all US disease awareness (unbranded) and product-related (branded) patient materials across the portfolio, maintaining a central tracker of new releases, updates, label changes and withdrawals.
• Assesses each US material for relevance to Puerto Rico patients and recommends whether to use as-is, adapt, adjust or not deploy locally, prioritizing alignment with Brand Leads and the Corporate Affairs Lead.
• Leads the adaptation process: Spanish translation and linguistic quality review, cultural and health-literacy adjustments, and alignment with local labeling, access and patient support programs.
• Coordinates with US content owners on source files, usage rights and change notifications, and guides each material through local Medical, Legal and Regulatory review and approval.
• Maintains version control, approval status and expiration/re-certification dates, ensuring only current, locally approved versions are in use and that materials are updated or withdrawn promptly when the US source changes.
• Corporate Affairs Support:
• Provides disease-state content, patient journey insight and burden-of-illness material for Corporate Affairs-led disease awareness campaigns and corporate initiatives such as Patient Week and C2C.
• Develops and adapts Spanish-language disease awareness materials on request, within the applicable review process for unbranded content.
• Professional Society and Congress Engagement:
• Owns relationships with hematology and oncology professional societies in Puerto Rico against defined annual objectives, in alignment with Brand Leads.
• Leads the end-to-end congress and events process, from planning and cross-functional coordination through compliant execution and post-event assessment.
• Identifies opportunities to strengthen BMS support, education and competitive engagement at events.
Key Performance Metrics
• Sales growth from patient customers
• Reach, engagement and conversion rates across patient journeys
• Patient-side launch readiness milestones delivered on time for new brands and indications
• Quality, cycle time and compliance of patient-facing materials through review
• Share of priority US materials assessed, adapted and locally approved within target timelines
Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, science, marketing or related field
• 5+ years’ pharmaceutical industry experience, including 3+ years in oncology, hematology or cell therapy
• Fully bilingual in Spanish and English, able to develop, translate and adapt content in both languages
• Experience developing patient-facing and disease awareness content across digital and omnichannel channels, including MLR review and local adaptation of US or global materials
• Strong knowledge of patient journeys and ability to turn BI&A analytics and segmentation into action
• Proven success in a matrix organization, building relationships across Corporate Affairs, Medical, Regulatory, Access, PASS and Sales
Behaviors
• Strategic Agility: Anticipates industry change and executes priorities that keep BMS competitive.
• Intellectual Curiosity and Learning Agility: Seeks new information, learns quickly and asks insightful questions to make sound decisions.
• Impact and Influence: Builds credibility through quality work, trust and candor, and influences across organizational boundaries.
• Collaboration: Builds alignment with Brand Leads, Corporate Affairs, Medical, Access and Sales to deliver shared outcomes.
• Leading Transformation and Change: Drives continuous improvement and innovation, and engages others to embrace change.
• Decision Making: Combines analysis, experience and sound judgment to decide with clarity and speed.
• Communication: Communicates clearly, credibly and convincingly in English and Spanish.
• Execution: Delivers key priorities through the matrix by setting clear expectations, metrics and contingency plans, and holding the team accountable.

BPO: Category Management & Strategic Sourcing Senior Advisor
Overview of Role:
The Category Management & Strategic Sourcing Senior Advisor is a senior individual contributor position accountable for end-to-end sourcing and contracting of Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services across Cigna. This includes shaping category strategy with business owners, running competitive sourcing events, recommending the supplier that best meets business objectives, and delivering contracts that govern the supplier relationship.
BPO contract structures are evolving quickly as AI and automation change how work gets delivered. We are looking for a creative, progressive sourcing professional who can move beyond traditional FTE-based models and help design pricing, performance, and governance structures that capture the value of AI and automation and remain commercially enforceable.
Responsibilities
• Lead sourcing strategy and execution for BPO initiatives of all sizes, from market analysis and RFPs through supplier selection and contract signature.
• Develop category plans with business owners, informed by supplier market trends, spend analysis, and strategic objectives.
• Challenge traditional approaches and bring forward new sourcing strategies and contract models, including outcome-based, transaction-based, and hybrid pricing that reflect AI and automation.
• Lead negotiations, backed by detailed financial and total cost analysis, and negotiate MSAs, SOWs, and change orders that optimize value and limit risk.
• Partner with Third-Party Management to build long-term supplier relationships with clear service levels, performance reporting, and accountability.
• Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for business stakeholders and the sourcing team.
• Lead matrix teams, manage timelines, and report on progress against savings and sourcing objectives.
KEY COMPETENCIES AND ATTRIBUTES
• BA/BS in Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• 5+ years of progressive experience in a large, global organization.
• Strong sourcing experience, preferably in a BPO category such as claims, contact center, revenue cycle, or patient access, that has offshore/onshore delivery leveraging FTE or transaction-based pricing.
• Proven negotiation, financial analysis, and structured problem-solving skills.
• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to influence executives and cross-functional partners.
• Experience with SAP Ariba or similar source-to-pay tools; Icertis or other contract lifecycle tools a plus.
• Demonstrated experience in drafting and reviewing contracts that include Master Services Agreements and Statements of Work strongly preferred.

We Are
Accenture is recognized as a global leader in AI and cloud transformation, helping businesses across industries design, build, and operationalize AI at enterprise scale.
Technology Strategy & Transformation (TS&T) - Digital Foundation s builds innovative AI solutions that turn strategy into production. We Advise, Design, Build and operationalize AI solutions to deliver tangible, real results - on programs that affect how entire industries operate. Our work spans agentic AI architecture, composable and event-driven platforms, AI-assisted engineering, and the operating models and business cases that make AI adoption durable.
You Are
A strong software engineer with genuine curiosity about AI and the drive to build production systems on real enterprise programs. Technical depth is your foundation; you want to apply it to complex enterprise problems and grow toward senior technical and advisory roles.
The Work
AI is reshaping what enterprises can build, how fast they can move, and where competitive advantage comes from. As a Consultant, you are a hands-on builder and technical contributor on AI transformation programs:
• Build agentic systems : Write production code: multi-agent systems (planning, execution, evaluation, and coordination roles), LLM integrations with LLM APIs (Claude/Anthropic, GPT-4) and prompt engineering, agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent), RAG pipelines, vector search or embedding-based retrieval, MCP Server/Client, composable AI components, and the software engineering that makes them reliable at scale. Work with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate) and graph databases and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Neptune). This is the core of the role.
• Engineer with AI coding agents: Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) daily, alongside testing, version control, and CI/CD, to ship production code.
• Contribute to solution architecture: Work alongside Architects to translate architecture decisions into working systems. Your implementation experience directly informs architecture quality. Apply microservices, event-driven design (including streaming on Kafka, Kinesis, or EventBridge), API-led integration, and containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). Understand how data moves between systems, basic transformation patterns, and what AI systems need from data. Know how AWS, Azure, and GCP services are used in production, and where integration and complexity live across enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, data platforms).
• Test and observe AI quality: Contribute to AI evaluation (quality assurance, risk assessment, and compliance for enterprise AI deployments) and AI observability (LLM tracing, failure mode analysis, LLMOps, prompt versioning).
• Deliver your workstream: Manage your own tasks within a delivery workstream: plan the work, meet commitments, flag blockers early, and understand how your work fits into the wider program and what depends on it. Communicate progress and blockers clearly to senior practitioners and team leads, and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do next.
• Develop client-facing skills: Build technical credibility with client engineering and architecture teams through delivery. Document technical decisions, write clear specifications, break technical requirements into discrete tasks, present your work to senior practitioners, and act on feedback. Build awareness of how the client's vertical (financial services, healthcare, retail, logistics, or public sector) shapes the work.
• Learn and apply practice patterns: Engage with established patterns for agentic AI, document what you learn, and contribute to reusable assets. Explore developments in agentic AI, test new approaches, and bring learnings into delivery work.
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 20 to 50% depending on business need and client requirements.
Here's what you need
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in software engineering or technology consulting.
• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on software development experience with production deployments, including testing, version control, and CI/CD.
• Minimum of 1 year of experience building with LLM APIs or AI/ML components in production contexts.
• Minimum of 1 year of experience using AI coding agents (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) in software development workflows.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)
Bonus Points if you Have
• Industry experience in at least one vertical (financial services, healthcare, retail, logistics, or public sector)
• AI evaluation: quality assurance, risk assessment, and compliance for enterprise AI deployments
• AI observability: LLM tracing, failure mode analysis, LLMOps, prompt versioning
• Cloud certification (AWS, Azure, GCP) or AI/ML certification (AWS ML Specialty, GCP Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer)

• Contribute to Accenture's OT Security practice through reusable assets, methods, and delivery excellence across engagements

Here's what you need

Provides solutions to complex business problems for area(s) of responsibility where analysis of situations requires an in depth knowledge of organizational objectives. • Support enterprise security assessments and the application of security controls aligned with relevant industry frameworks and regulatory requirements.

• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewalls (PAN-OS), including configuration, deployment, administration and troubleshooting in enterprise environments using Panorama and/or Strata Cloud Manager.

• Minimum of 3 years of technical writing and report generation
• Minimum of 3 years of experience with enterprise network security concepts and architectures, including Zero Trust, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), Security Service Edge (SSE), micro-segmentation, routing protocols (BGP and OSPF), IPsec VPN, SD-WAN, network segmentation and high availability.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting enterprise network security across LAN, WAN, data center and public cloud environments, including advanced troubleshooting, technical analysis and root-cause identification.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)
• Travel will be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 75 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements
Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Skills):
• Industry-recognized certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCNP, CCIE Security or Enterprise, GIAC, TOGAF or SABSA.
• Experience with additional Palo Alto Networks products and technologies, including Prisma SD-WAN, SD-WAN for NGFW, VM-Series, CN-Series, Cloud NGFW for AWS and Azure, Enterprise DLP, SaaS Security, IoT Security, Prisma Browser, ADEM, Strata Logging Service and Cortex XSIAM/XDR integrations.
• Palo Alto Networks certifications, including PCNSE or current role-based certifications such as Next-Generation Firewall Engineer, Security Service Edge Engineer or SD-WAN Engineer.
• Multi-vendor network security experience, including Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA), Netskope, Cisco (ASA/Firepower, Secure Access, Umbrella), Fortinet, Check Point and Illumio/Guardicore, as well as experience with firewall migration tools.

• Knowledge of cloud networking and security technologies across AWS (Transit Gateway and Gateway Load Balancer), Azure (Virtual WAN), GCP and cloud-native firewall services, as well as Identity and Access Management solutions such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity and Cloud Identity Engine.
• Exposure to IT security testing activities, including vulnerability assessments, security configuration reviews and validation of network security controls.

We Are
Accenture’s Talent Reinvention Partner and we’re helping clients reinvent how people and organizations work—delivering leadership, talent, operating models, workforce intelligence, and change solutions to accelerate the workforce agenda in the age of AI. We develop forward‑thinking leaders who can lead effectively in an AI‑augmented workplace and navigate change with confidence. Our team is at the forefront of talent, HR, and organizational consulting, supporting clients across AI‑enabled skilling and reskilling, talent strategy, leadership development, employee experience, and change management .
You Are
An experienced change leader who understands that work has fundamentally changed. Digital, data, and Generative AI are no longer emerging capabilities – they are part of the everyday fabric of how work gets done, decisions are made, and value is created. You have led complex transformations in environments where people work alongside advanced digital tools, and you know how this shifts roles, skills, ways of working, and expectations of leadership. You bring a clear point of view on how to design and lead change when speed, scale, and continuous adaptation are the norm, and where human judgment, accountability, and trust remain essential. You use data, analytics, and AI-enabled insights to inform decisions and guide action, while applying experience and judgment to interpret what the data cannot. You are comfortable using Generative AI to accelerate analysis, design, and delivery, and you take responsibility for the quality, ethics, and impact of the outcomes. Clients and teammates look to you not just to “manage change,” but to help them operate and lead effectively in human + digital teams. You model how AI is used in the flow of work, coach others to build confidence and capability, and help teams deliver high-impact change in environments of continuous reinvention.
The Work
You will help clients reinvent how their organizations operate in an AI-enabled, data-informed world where work is digital by default, change is continuous, and people work alongside advanced tools to deliver outcomes at speed and scale.
Key responsibilities include:
• Support clients through large-scale reinvention efforts, including reimagining work, workforce models, and human-centered experiences in environments shaped by data, automation, and Generative AI
• Lead and design enterprise change programs, helping clients execute and sustain change in contexts where ways of working, roles, and skills are evolving rapidly alongside advances in technology and AI
• Partner with clients to define and enable how GenAI is used across the organization, addressing readiness, skills shifts, workforce impacts, and responsible use while reinforcing clear human accountability and governance.
• Use quantitative and qualitative data, analytics, and AI-enabled insights to assess readiness, track adoption and behavior change, and inform decisions and course correction.
• Design agile, future-ready change strategies that enable new ways of working, including operating models where humans and digital tools work together seamlessly.
• Apply human-centered design principles to co-create change solutions and personalized change journeys that can be scaled through digital and AI-enabled approaches Use Generative AI thoughtfully to accelerate change delivery, such as developing, testing, and tailoring engagement content, learning assets, and manager enablement, while remaining accountable for quality, tone, and impact
• Help clients build lasting, scalable change capabilities so they can continuously adapt as technologies, business models and ways of working evolve.
• Contribute to Accenture business development through proposals, storytelling, and building trusted client relationships.
• Be willing to travel as needed to support clients.
Here’s What You Need
• Minimum of 3 years’ Organization Change Management experience.
• Minimum of 1 year of experience as a consulting practitioner.
• Minimum of 1 year of experience working on technology-enabled or digital transformation initiatives (GenAI exposure preferred)
Bonus Points If You Have
• High Tech Industry experience preferred
• Applied experience using Generative AI (GenAI) to deliver organizational change work, including:
• Using GenAI-supported analytics and insights to understand workforce dynamics, readiness, adoption, sentiment, and behavior change
• Generating, testing, and tailoring communications and manager enablement content at speed and scale
• Supporting GenAI-enabled learning, reskilling, and knowledge sharing within organizations
• Enabling responsible GenAI adoption through clear change approaches, governance, and human accountability
• Experience leading or working in human + digital teams, where Generative AI is actively used to analyze information, generate content, and support decision-making—while ownership, judgment, and accountability remain clearly human
• Experience designing, implementing, and scaling HR and Talent processes (e.g., workforce planning, learning, performance, skills) in technology-enabled environments
• Familiarity with AI-enabled HR and workforce tools, including workforce analytics, skills platforms, automation, and future workforce design
• A demonstrated commitment to staying current on the capabilities, limitations, risks, and governance of emerging technologies—and translating them into practical, ethical, and sustainable ways of working for clients.

We Are
Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our client's needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people uses the coolest tech to out-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.
Do you have the deep functional and technical experience to help implement security solutions that align with our clients’ business objectives? Do you have the expertise to design and deliver solutions for establishing system user's credentials, and processes for applying those credentials to access enterprise systems and applications?
You Are
This is not a consulting role. It is not a project delivery role. It is not a research position. A Forward Deployed AI Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to make complex AI platforms work in real, messy organizational environments.
You own outcomes: time-to-value, adoption, reliability, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
The market is beginning to understand what leading technology companies have demonstrated: AI products fail not because the models are weak but because deployment is broken. The gap between a successful AI pilot and an AI capability that scales is bridged by engineers who can translate platform capability into measurable business value inside a real enterprise environment. That is this role.
The Work
Forward Deployed AI Engineers form the execution spine of our Reinvention Deployment Engineering pods. We are building the largest FDE capability in the services industry. The engineers who join at this stage will define what the role looks like at scale and will have access to the hardest enterprise AI problems in the market across every industry.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead enterprise AI platform deployments across complex multi-stakeholder client environments - Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir - owning the full program from architecture through adoption
• Own program-level delivery outcomes: time-to-value, reliability, adoption velocity, and scalability across multiple concurrent workstreams, with commercial metrics attached
• Lead rapid experimentation at pace: drive ambiguous business problems to working production systems in days or weeks across complex enterprise environments
• Architect and govern enterprise AI solutions across the full technology stack: identity, data, security, governance, platform layer, and multi-system workflow integration at program scale
• Lead AI governance framework implementation: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and model risk management applied to live production systems, not theoretical compliance exercises
• Shape AI reinvention strategy for client CTO, CFO, and CISO: build value architecture, ROI backlogs, use case prioritization frameworks, and multi-year AI adoption roadmaps
• Define and publish reusable reinvention blueprints, security patterns, and accelerators that scale across multiple client engagements and grow the FDE practice
• Lead architecture design sessions, executive workshops, and code-with sessions with client engineering and C-suite leadership teams
• Codify delivery learnings, failure patterns, and engineering standards that shape the FDE practice and enable the next generation of forward deployed engineers
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
Here's what you need
• Minimum of 8 years of engineering experience with cloud-native systems, including APIs, microservices, containerization, and serverless architectures (Within a cybersecurity discipline depth in at least one area: AppSec, SecOps / detection engineering, cloud security, IAM, offensive security / penetration testing, or GRC is preferred)
• Minimum of 1 year of experience designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments
• Minimum of 2 years of experience with AI platforms (OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, or open-source models), including building abstraction layers for multi-provider pipelines
• Minimum of 8 years of experience leading software engineering teams, including delivery oversight, resource allocation, and professional development of direct reports
• Minimum 6 years of demonstrated end-to-end delivery ownership experience in a client-embedded or production environment (Security delivery is preferred)
• Minimum of 6 years of experience defining enterprise AI architecture across identity, data, security, governance, and multi-system integrations
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience
Professional Skills Requirements
• Proven ability to communicate security risk in business terms: can translate threat exposure into risk-adjusted investment rationale a CISO or CFO would act on
• People lead responsibilities: experience managing, developing, and performance-managing a team of engineers; setting individual development plans and conducting career conversations
• Experience leading enterprise AI deployments across multi-stakeholder environments
• Experience managing and developing engineering teams, including performance management and development planning
• Experience working with enterprise AI platforms such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir
• Experience working directly with senior stakeholders (CTO, CFO, CISO) on AI strategy and investment decisions
• Experience leading executive workshops, architecture design sessions, or cross-functional technical engagements

As a Digital Product Manager – Strategy & Program Delivery , you will help translate business strategy into digital product initiatives and lead complex programs from concept through implementation.
You will partner across business, product, technology, operations, marketing, analytics, risk and compliance teams to define product strategies, develop roadmaps, gather requirements, and deliver strategic initiatives. You will manage multiple workstreams and coordinate internal stakeholders, external vendors and technology partners to drive execution and measurable business outcomes.
You are a strategic thinker and hands-on problem solver who can operate independently in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, translating business needs into actionable plans, influencing without direct authority, and moving initiatives forward from initial concept through launch.
The Work
• Partner with business and product leaders to define and execute digital product strategies, roadmaps and strategic initiatives, supported by business cases, recommendations and executive-level presentations.
• Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation and post-launch evaluation, managing multiple concurrent workstreams across product, technology, operations, marketing, analytics, risk and compliance.
• Establish project governance, including integrated plans, milestone tracking, risk and issue management, decision logs and executive reporting.
• Identify dependencies, risks and roadblocks, and work across teams to drive timely resolution and accountability.
• Translate business requirements into functional requirements, features, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Conduct market, customer and competitive research to identify trends, opportunities and threats, and evaluate product opportunities on customer impact, business value, feasibility, cost and expected outcomes.
• Define product objectives, success measures, KPIs and OKRs with stakeholders, and monitor performance with clear updates on progress, risks, decisions and recommended actions.
• Identify opportunities to improve digital experiences, product capabilities and business processes.
• Support digital product development and technology implementations, including APIs, platform capabilities, automation and AI-enabled solutions.
• Coordinate with external vendors, fintechs and technology providers on requirements, implementation plans and deliverables, partnering with Procurement, Legal, Risk, Compliance and Technology as needed for implementation and governance.
• Facilitate working sessions, stakeholder reviews and leadership discussions to drive decisions, alignment and execution, applying Agile and iterative practices to continuously improve products and delivery.
Basic Qualifications
• Minimum 3 years of experience in digital product management.
• Minimum 2 years of experience in at least one of the following: financial services, credit or lending, payments, marketing, customer acquisition, product development, or analytics.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, workstreams, dependencies and deliverables.
• Experience with digital acquisition, customer onboarding, payments, lending or digital servicing products.
• Familiarity with AI, automation, data analytics and emerging financial technologies.
• Experience developing and maintaining project plans, risk and issue logs, governance routines and executive reporting.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing presentations for senior leadership.
• Experience with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Power BI, Excel or PowerPoint.
• PMP, CAPM, Certified Scrum Product Owner, Agile or other relevant product/program management certification.

You are:
As an AI led FDE , you embed with design & product teams to originate, design, and ship AI-powered digital products and experiences into production. You will build on top of enterprise data and technology foundations to create AI-powered products that face customers, employees, and business users, driving revenue, engagement, and better decisions
The work:
• Identify where AI creates measurable business value before a brief exists. Originate use cases, prioritize by impact, and shape the engagement.
• Differentiate through a product-led approach. Pair AI & data depth with product strategy and product thinking, so the work ladders to a real product and its outcomes, not a proof of concept.
• Bring fluency in the design-to-product pipeline. Move from insight and concept through design, prototype, and production the way Design & Digital Products builds, connecting strategy directly to what ships.
• Design and build AI systems end to end: RAG architecture, agentic orchestration, prompt & context engineering, evals & guardrails, tool-use patterns, and MCP integration.
• Select the right model and approach: frontier-model selection, and when to apply fine-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, exercising judgment over execution across cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs.
• Activate AI within the client's existing enterprise data platforms. Connect AI products to where the data lives using data-gravity patterns rather than re-architecting infrastructure.
• Build AI-powered digital products and experiences full-stack, with production accountability. Ship working code, not recommendations.
• Deploy responsibly to production: MLOps, model serving, security, and cost / latency discipline at product level, with effective monitoring.
• Codify best-practice delivery patterns and feed field learnings back into the offering to make delivery repeatable.
Basic Required Qualifications:
• Minimum 3 years of AI & Data experience, including solutioning, designing, or delivering AI & Data projects, with hands-on work shipping GenAI features (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails), not strategy decks alone.
Prefered Qualificaitions:
• Hands-on delivery experience on at least one enterprise AI platform in production: AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or Databricks Mosaic AI.
• Working fluency with GenAI frameworks and patterns: LangChain or LlamaIndex, agentic orchestration (CrewAI / AutoGen), MCP, prompt and context engineering, and model selection across frontier and open-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral).
• Model judgment: knows when to apply fine-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, and can reason about cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs.
• Product engineering ability: full-stack build of AI-powered digital products, ships working code, and can activate AI against existing enterprise data using data-gravity patterns rather than re-architecting infrastructure.
• Product-led mindset: connects AI & data work to product strategy and the design-to-product pipeline, and can originate use cases and shape an engagement before a brief exists.
• Experience managing senior stakeholders.
• Strong program management and verbal and written communication skills.
• Driven and entrepreneurial: ability to originate and shape new deals and lead go-to-market activities.
• Excellent leadership and people skills: proven ability to build effective teams, foster collaboration and inclusion, and build strong relationships with stakeholders / clients.

Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses.
Accenture’s Trust & Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society.
You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, you may be exposed to objectionable or disturbing content flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns.
This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. This role requires active participation in Accenture’s well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.
Key Responsibilities:
• Review, classify and/or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels
• Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and/or responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work.
• Investigate, resolve, and relay complex content issues to the broader Trust and Safety team
• Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.
• Analyze the model's responses for appropriateness, inappropriateness, refusal to answer, or appending disclaimers to the response according to client definitions and guidance.
• Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model's responses.
• Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy.
Role Requirements:
• This is an onsite role at the client site in San Jose, CA. You will be expected to relocate to and work in San Jose and the pay range is set accordingly.
• Must be flexible to work any shift including nights, weekends and holidays

• Minimum 1 year of customer service experience
Preferred Qualifications:
• Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture
• High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported
Professional Skills:
• Strong coping, emotional resilience, and stress-management skills
• Excellent comprehension, communication, and English skills
• Ability to perform duties objectively, devoid of inherent biases or personal beliefs, in the best interest of client policies
• Strong attention to detail
• Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams
• Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
