We Are:
The Accenture Edge Workday Mid-market business is a core growth driver within Accenture, focused on helping Mid-market companies reinvent, scale, and compete with the agility required in today’s market. Mid-market organizations share the same bold ambitions as large enterprises, they are undergoing a significant transformation, driven by the need to modernize operations, accelerate growth, and respond to evolving industry demands. Accenture brings the full strength of our global capabilities—deep industry expertise, ecosystem partnerships, and proven innovation—to make enterprise grade solutions accessible, scalable, and simplified for midmarket needs. Powered by curated offerings, preconfigured solutions, accelerators, and AI enabled delivery models, Accenture Mid-market brings together teams across our global network to help clients drive real ROI, innovate faster, and transform with confidence. The Mid-market portfolio spans repeatable, industrialized solutions across technology, operations, security, cloud, and industry-specific needs to meet clients where they are on their reinvention journey. www.accenture.com
We are looking to expand our Workday Edge Mid-market team with the best talent, who have experience in the mid-market, across the business suite, and across functions, that will enable us to continue to drive transformations at scale. www.accenture.com
You Are:
You are an experienced delivery leader who is comfortable owning complex Workday programs end to end, managing budgets, risks and governance, and building trust with client executives. You bring the core capabilities of a Workday Delivery Lead across Financials, HCM or full-platform (Financials and HCM) programs, along with an understanding of how Workday opportunities are won, and the ability to turn delivery experience into clear, credible content and staffing support for the sales cycle.
The Work:
As the Go To Market (GTM) Lead, you will connect delivery with the Edge Workday sales team to support the growth of the delivery portfolio. You will take input from the sales team on the assets they need, coordinate with functional and technical leads to produce polished, prospect-facing content such as case studies, reference materials and solution overviews, and coordinate GTM webinars. You will ramp up delivery resources to support sales cycles and coordinate the individuals who support sales opportunities. You will be responsible for client success and the referenceability of the projects you lead.
As the Delivery Lead, you will team with mid-market clients on their Workday transformation programs through your combined mid-market and Workday delivery expertise, which includes your ability to:
· Lead day-to-day delivery of Workday Financials, HCM or full-platform programs for mid-market clients across solution design, budget management, resource planning and quality assurance
· Serve as the primary escalation point for delivery issues, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies
· Partner with client stakeholders to align on scope, timelines and deliverable expectations throughout the project lifecycle
· Manage onshore/offshore delivery team structures, coordinating across time zones for seamless execution and knowledge transfer
· Drive cutover planning, rehearsals and execution, ensuring a controlled and successful transition to the live Workday environment
· Oversee project financials, including EAC, revenue recognition, margin management and change order processing
· Facilitate governance rituals, including steering committee meetings, project status reporting and executive briefings
· Ensure adherence to Accenture delivery standards, quality frameworks and client contractual obligations
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements
What You Need
• Active Workday Pro certification in Financials (such as Record to Report) or HCM (such as HCM Core)
• A minimum of 12 years of experience in enterprise technology delivery or project leadership, including at least 5 years of hands-on Workday functional experience in Financials and/or HCM
• A minimum of 3 full-lifecycle Workday implementations managed end to end, from initiation through go-live and hypercare, with accountability for scope, schedule and delivery quality across teams of 5+ resources
• A minimum of 3 years leading offshore or distributed delivery teams of 5+ resources across 2+ time zones
• A minimum of 3 years of executive-level stakeholder engagement, including steering committee presentations, escalation management and status reporting to VP-level or C-suite audiences
• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (12 years) work experience (If an Associate’s Degree, 6 years of work experience)
Bonus Points If:
• Experience delivering Workday solutions for mid-market clients (revenues of about $300M to $3B) and familiarity with their constraints and compressed timelines
• Experience delivering both Workday Financials and HCM, including full-platform programs
• Active PMP (Project Management Professional) certification from PMI
• A minimum of 2 go-live cutovers managed, including cutover runbooks, mock cutovers and go/no-go decisions
• A minimum of 3 years managing project financials, resource plans and delivery risk across 3+ simultaneous workstreams
• Familiarity with Workday deployment methodology and agile delivery practices
• Experience supporting pre-sales or go-to-market activities, such as proposals, solution orals, client demos or webinars

We are:
A forward-thinking services company at the forefront of AI-native innovation. We partner with enterprise clients to create next-generation, agent-powered workflows engineered to scale in real-world settings. Our engineers embed deeply with customers, moving projects beyond experimentation into operational reality.
You are:
Forward Deployed AI Engineers form the execution spine of our Reinvention Deployment Engineering pods. We are building the largest FDE capability in the services industry. The engineers who join at this stage will define what the role looks like at scale and will have access to the hardest enterprise AI problems in the market across every industry. You are a critical thinker that thrives in ambiguity, delivering concrete results by designing, building, and running custom AI agents that augment workflows and scale across modern infrastructure. You’ll help shape the playbook for how enterprises adopt and scale AI-native engineering globally.
The Work:
This is not a consulting role. It is not a project delivery role. It is not a research position. A Forward Deployed AI Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to make complex AI platforms work in real, messy organizational environments. You own outcomes: time-to-value, adoption, reliability, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
The market is beginning to understand what leading technology companies have demonstrated: AI products fail not because the models are weak but because deployment is broken. The gap between a successful AI pilot and an AI capability that scales is bridged by engineers who can translate platform capability into measurable business value inside a real enterprise environment. That is this role.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead enterprise AI platform deployments across complex multi-stakeholder client environments — Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir — owning the full program from architecture through adoption
• Own program-level delivery outcomes: time-to-value, reliability, adoption velocity, and scalability across multiple concurrent workstreams, with commercial metrics attached
• Lead rapid experimentation at pace: drive ambiguous business problems to working production systems in days or weeks across complex enterprise environments
• Architect and govern enterprise AI solutions across the full technology stack: identity, data, security, governance, platform layer, and multi-system workflow integration at program scale
• Shape AI reinvention strategy for client CTO, CFO, and CISO: build value architecture, ROI backlogs, use case prioritization frameworks, and multi-year AI adoption roadmaps
• Define and publish reusable reinvention blueprints, patterns, and accelerators that scale across multiple client engagements and grow the FDE practice
• Lead architecture design sessions, executive workshops, and code-with sessions with client engineering and C-suite leadership teams
• Codify delivery learnings, failure patterns, and engineering standards that shape the FDE practice and enable the next generation of forward deployed engineers
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
What You Need:
• Minimum of 10 years engineering experience with cloud-native systems (APIs, microservices, containerization, serverless).
• Minimum of 1 years of deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments.
• Minimum of 2 years of experience with AI platforms — OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, plus open-source models — including building abstraction layers to manage multi-provider pipelines.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience programming in Python, Java, or equivalent; familiarity with evaluation tooling, logging, monitoring, and agent observability.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience deploying to production — CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in client communication and collaboration, including being capable of leading technical workshops and delivering under ambiguity.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent or (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience), AI certifications or agentic tool experience is a plus.
Bonus Points If:
• You’ve served as an Agentic AI Engineer in an Enterprise environment
• You’ve defined or worked with enterprise-grade architectures for compound AI systems, orchestration frameworks, or agent registry/stream-based architectures.
• You understand the AI-native paradigm — blending cloud-native with generative model architectures — optimizing for performance, modularity, and efficiency.
• You’ve delivered solutions across multiple industries (e.g., finance, healthcare) by tailoring agentic workflows to industry needs.

You are:

The Work:
The right candidate for this role would have an Understanding of the end-to-end hospital revenue cycle, from pre-registration and charge capture to claim scrubbing and denial management.
Epic Resolute HB/PB Builds: Has experience in configuring:
Fee Schedules: Setting up and updating chargemasters, pricing, and fee arrays.
Charge router/coding/Claim: Building Workqueues for accounts that require review, and checks to avoid denials
Payer Contracts: Configuring expected reimbursements, DRGs (Diagnosis-Related Groups), and fee schedules for different insurance plans.
Remittance & Denial Posting: Setting up auto-posting for ERAs (Electronic Remittance Advice) and mapping Denial Codes for routing to specialized follow-up workqueues
Coding Standards: Working knowledge of medical coding, specifically ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, revenue codes, and modifiers.
Integration Points: Understanding how HB interacts with clinical modules (e.g., Willow for pharmacy, OpTime for surgery), as well as Epic's ADT/Prelude (registration) and SBO (Single Billing Office).
Data & Analytics: Ability to generate billing reports, build custom dashboards
Troubleshooting: Investigating system errors, analyzing claim rejections
Depending on the client engagement, the Epic Resolute Professional Billing and Hosptial Billing Certified Senior Analyst or Team Lead will be responsible for collaborating with Accenture team, software vendor team, and client in the following areas.
1. Document current state business workflows.
2. Assist with the analysis and design of new business workflows.
3. Identify and define detailed product requirements and use cases.
4. Provide input into high level functional specifications.
5. Work with project managers, architects, business analysts and other team members to define metrics and performance goals for the application.
6. Participate in transitioning the requirements and use cases to ensure a clear and complete understanding of the requirements.
7. Assist in translating requirements and use cases into test conditions and expected results for product, performance, and user acceptance testing.
8. Participate in quality management reviews of the design and performance of work products to ensure they fulfill the requirements.
9. Perform or advise on system configuration and integration setup and assist with testing activities.
10. Serve as an intermediary with client's Epic team and Accenture tech leads to support bilateral understanding of data structures, workflows and technology capabilities and limitations.
11. Assist in the development and documentation of data requests and source to target mapping.
12. Other duties as assigned. This work may include implementation, optimization, upgrades, and application support.
This is an ATC role and will require onsite 3 days per week in an ATC location: Nashville, Columbus, Dallas, or Atlanta.
Here is what you need:
• Minimum of 3 years experience in Healthcare IT in an Epic Resolute Professional Billing and Epic Resolute Hospital Billing role
• Experience and certification in Epic Resolute Professional Billing and Epic Hospital Billing
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)
Bonus points if you have:
• Minimum of 3 year of experience working for a consulting firm
• Experience in at least 1 full implementation of Epic
• Experience in Epic PB/ PB Claims, HB/HB Claims, Charge Router, Real Time Eligibility, rev cycle back end knowledge of applications

Who we are:
Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.
Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.
Who you are:
You are an AI Value Engineer who bridges the gap between business need and AI build in customer service. You identify where AI can create real value in a client's service operation, quantify it in terms leaders care about, and track the value AI initiatives create long after launch, so clients can see exactly what their investment is returning. You are equally at home building a value model, facilitating a stakeholder workshop, and shaping a rapid prototype.
You bring a commercial, outcome-driven mindset to everything you do. You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions with data, and explain tradeoffs in plain language to client leaders and engineers alike. You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, moving between engagements and picking up new domains quickly. Above all, you are a curious, collaborative teammate who makes the people around you better.
The work:
• Embed with client service and business teams to understand how their service operation creates and loses value, from contact volumes and drivers to agent workflows, operating costs, and customer outcomes.
• Identify and quantify AI value hypotheses, analyzing contact drivers, interaction data, and operational metrics to find where AI can improve containment, handle time, first-contact resolution, CSAT, retention, and cost-to-serve.
• Run use-case discovery and prioritization workshops with client stakeholders, mapping use cases against value, feasibility, and risk to build a prioritized AI roadmap.
• Build business cases and ROI models that client leaders can trust and defend, including baselines, benefit assumptions, build and run costs, and sensitivity analysis.
• Run cost-benefit and scenario analyses to identify the best solution, comparing options such as build versus buy, platform and model choices, levels of automation, and phased rollouts, and making the tradeoffs behind each one clear.
• Build the full cost of AI into the business case, including run costs such as token usage, inference, and platform fees, how those costs scale with volume, and the human oversight AI solutions still need, such as review and escalations, so clients can see the true cost per interaction of each option.
• Map value to specific build initiatives, translating each prioritized use case into scope, success metrics, and requirements that Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Solution Engineering teams can build against.
• Define service scorecards with client leaders, selecting and prioritizing the KPIs that matter most for their business goals, such as lowering cost-to-serve, improving customer experience, or retaining revenue, and balancing efficiency metrics like containment and handle time against quality metrics like resolution, CSAT, and customer effort, so AI is never optimized for one at the expense of the other.
• Define how value will be measured before a build begins, setting baselines, KPIs, and measurement plans, and using control groups or A/B tests to attribute impact to the AI solution rather than other factors.
• Track the value AI initiatives create over time, creating and maintaining value dashboards and benefits tracking across a client's portfolio of AI use cases. Pull data from client data warehouses and data lakes using SQL or Python to validate savings and results against the business case.
• Run regular value reviews with client business, finance, and service leaders, reporting realized versus planned value, flagging early when an initiative is off track, and recommending what to fix, scale, or stop.
• Feed realized value back into the roadmap, so the next round of AI investment is prioritized by proven results rather than projections.
• Tell the story with data, designing clear visualizations, dashboards, and executive-ready presentations that turn complex analysis into a simple narrative: where value is, what it is worth, and what to do next, so clients can make confident investment decisions.
• Contribute reusable value models, benchmarks, and use-case libraries from the field so our teams can size and prove value faster on the next engagement.
• Help onboard and mentor junior teammates, and contribute to project debriefs and team POVs.
Here's what you'll need:
• 3+ years of professional experience in management or technology consulting, business analysis, value engineering, product management, or customer service operations and analytics.
• 3+ years of experience working on customer service, contact center, or customer experience projects or operations, with a strong command of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and their financial impact. Experience should include:
• Experience building business cases, ROI models, and value measurement frameworks for technology or AI initiatives, and tracking realized value after launch.
• Experience defining service scorecards or KPI frameworks and prioritizing metrics based on business needs.
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets, including cost-benefit and scenario analysis.
• Hands-on SQL skills to pull and analyze data from data warehouses and data lakes (Python is a plus), and experience with a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
• Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with the ability to choose the right visual for the message and build a clear, compelling narrative from data for executive audiences.
• A working understanding of AI and LLM capabilities, limits, and cost drivers, such as token usage, model choice, and inference volume, enough to assess feasibility, compare AI and human cost per interaction, and challenge assumptions about what AI can deliver.
• Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
• Willingness to travel regularly to client locations.
Bonus points if you have:
• Experience with contact center analytics, such as contact driver and intent analysis, speech and interaction analytics, or workforce management data.
• Experience designing experiments, such as A/B tests and control groups, to measure business impact.
• Experience with benefits realization or value tracking practices, including working with client finance teams to validate savings and returns.
• Experience with customer service platforms.
• A portfolio of business cases, value models, or prototypes you can walk us through.
• Bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Our Utilities CFO & Enterprise Value Practice sits at the intersection of two of the most dynamic transformations in industry — the reinvention of the Office of the CFO and the energy transition reshaping electric, gas, and water utilities. We partner with utilities CFOs and finance leaders to modernize the close, accounting, fixed assets, controllership, regulatory reporting, planning, and rate-case-ready data — unlocking insight, productivity, and measurable enterprise value as our clients navigate clean energy, grid modernization, and capital-intensive investment cycles.
You Are:
A trusted advisor to finance leaders who helps modernize accounting, fixed assets, and finance operations. You combine hands-on finance and ERP experience with strong consulting, communication, and delivery skills, and you bring a working understanding of the priorities that shape capital-intensive, regulated industries such as utilities. You are comfortable partnering across business, technology, client, product, testing, training, and offshore teams to align priorities, solve complex finance problems, and guide users through new ways of working. You bring practical knowledge of finance process design, fixed asset and capital accounting, and finance data, and you know how to translate CFO priorities into scalable solutions that improve controllership, decision support, and enterprise value.
The Work:
• Support finance transformation programs for utilities CFO and controller organizations, including finance process redesign, solution design, data conversion, testing, training, deployment, and post-go-live adoption.
• Lead or contribute to workstreams across core finance areas — General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets / capital accounting, Project Accounting, Intercompany, and regulatory/FERC reporting — aligning design to the client’s chart of accounts, accounting policies, and controllership requirements.
• Design and deliver Fixed Asset and capital accounting capabilities tailored to utilities — including CWIP, unitization, asset retirement obligations (AROs), depreciation studies, regulatory asset treatment, and integration with Projects and GL.
• Translate utilities CFO priorities into measurable enterprise value cases — building business cases, value architectures, and KPI baselines that link finance capabilities to outcomes such as faster close, improved forecast accuracy, rate-case readiness, and reduced cost-to-serve.
• Analyze finance process data — chart of accounts, sub-ledger mappings, master data, journals, asset registers, and reconciliations — to inform design, cleanse legacy data, and validate cutover readiness.
• Collaborate across client stakeholders, Accenture delivery teams, product teams, integration teams, testing teams, training teams, and offshore resources to deliver coordinated finance transformation outcomes.
• Support scrum ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, user story development, acceptance criteria, demos, and defect triage for finance workstreams.
• Provide hands-on training, coaching, and enablement for utilities finance users, super users, and project team members to support long-term adoption.
• Support execution of cutover activities, deployment readiness, change enablement, and stakeholder communications for finance releases.
• Identify opportunities to improve delivery methods, solution quality, and cross-team collaboration while helping utilities CFOs realize finance transformation value.
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
What You Need:
• Minimum of 3 years Finance transformation consulting experience — including process design, controllership, close optimization, or CFO advisory work.
• Minimum of 3 years hands-on experience implementing or supporting ERP Finance solutions (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud ERP) across GL, AP, AR, or Fixed Assets.
• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with Fixed Asset / capital accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, and integration with Projects.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience working with finance process data — chart of accounts design, sub-ledger to ledger reconciliation, data conversion, or finance master data management.
• Minimum of 1 years of experience serving utilities clients (electric, gas, or water) or in a utilities finance, controllership, or regulatory function.
• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent (6 years) work experience. If an Associate's Degree, 3 years of work experience is required.
Bonus Points If:
• You have a CPA, CMA, ACCA, MBA, or equivalent accounting/finance credential.
• You have familiarity with utilities-specific accounting and reporting — FERC/USoA chart of accounts, regulatory assets and liabilities, rate cases, AROs, CWIP, and unitization.
• You have ERP Finance certification (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting, Oracle Cloud ERP Financials).
• You have experience with EPM tools (SAP Group Reporting/SAC, Oracle EPM) and how they connect to finance.
• You have familiarity with embedding GenAI / agentic AI into close, controls, planning, and reporting processes.
• You have experience working in Scrum or Agile delivery environments, including user stories, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, demos, or defect resolution.
• You have experience collaborating across cross-functional business, technology, integration, testing, training, client, and offshore teams.

Our mission: help clients unlock significant value by optimizing product design, engineering, and cost structures, driving strategic improvements in product development and lifecycle management through Design to Value.
You are:
As a Design to Value Consultant , you will support cross‑functional teams in identifying, analyzing, and executing product and cost optimization opportunities. You’ll contribute to DtV workshops, product teardowns, cost modeling efforts, and detailed analyses that uncover actionable insights. • Conduct product, cost, and design analyses to identify value improvement opportunities using DtV and value engineering methodologies.
• Support the execution of DtV workshops, including preparing materials, analyzing inputs, and synthesizing insights into clear recommendations.

• Participate in product teardowns and lab‑based assessments to analyze components, materials, and manufacturing approaches.
• Support cross‑functional teams—engineering, procurement, operations—in evaluating product redesign and optimization concepts.
• Develop clear, data‑backed presentations and deliverables that communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
• Collaborate with project leads to manage workstreams, track progress, and ensure high‑quality outputs.
• Contribute to internal capability building through knowledge documentation, tool development, and best‑practice sharing within the DtV team.
• Mentor junior team members, share best practices, and contribute to internal capability building.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in engineering, product development, manufacturing, strategic sourcing, supply chain, or operations
• Strong analytical and structured problem‑solving skills, with experience working with complex datasets and quantitative analyses
• Exposure to cost modeling, basic CAD interpretation, product architecture analysis, or engineering design concepts
• Ability to work collaboratively in cross‑functional teams, communicate clearly, and synthesize information into structured outputs
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

• Experience supporting consulting projects or structured problem‑solving engagements
• Exposure to Direct Materials Procurement or Strategic Sourcing
• You’ve worked with cost‑engineering tools, CAD models, or manufacturing/production environments
• You’ve participated in product teardowns, value engineering, or design reviews
• You have experience developing business cases or evaluating cost/benefit trade‑offs
• Strong analytical problem-solver with experience structuring complex datasets, building business cases, and translating insights into clear recommendations

Who we are:
Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.
Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.
Who you are:
You are a Forward Deployed Engineer who brings an architectural perspective to integrating AI across complex enterprise systems. You embed directly with clients to connect AI components and cooperating AI agents with the platforms customer service runs on (CRM, contact center, knowledge, telephony, and data), and you build the integrations and reusable patterns that let AI scale across a client's service ecosystem.
You are a builder who is just as comfortable in a client workshop as in a code editor. You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, moving between engagements, picking up new platforms quickly, and explaining technical choices in plain language to engineers and business stakeholders alike. Above all, you are a curious, collaborative teammate who makes the people around you better.
The work:
• Embed with client teams, on site and remote, to understand how their service operation really works, from contact center and agent workflows to the systems and data behind them.
• Join discovery workshops with client business and technology teams, helping identify, size, and prioritize the AI use cases with the highest impact on customers and the business.
• Build rapid prototypes that prove how AI agents can plug into a client's service ecosystem, often within days, before a full build begins.
• Design and build integrations that connect AI agents to CRM, contact center, knowledge management, ticketing, telephony, and enterprise data platforms through APIs, events, platform-native connectors, and tool-use patterns such as MCP.
• Design how multiple AI agents coordinate across systems, including which agent owns which task, which systems each one can access, and how requests are routed between them.
• Map and build the data flows between platforms, so customer, order, case, and interaction data move reliably and securely between AI agents and the systems of record.
• Connect AI agents to systems through event-driven patterns, so they can react in real time to moments like a delayed order, a failed payment, or an escalated case.
• Build the human handoff and escalation flows that pass full customer context from AI agents to human agents across voice, chat, and messaging.
• Carry customer identity and context across channels, so a customer who starts in chat and moves to voice never has to start over, whether they are talking to an AI agent or a person.
• Harden integrations for production with testing, logging, observability, and CI/CD, and document integration specifications, reference architectures, and reusable patterns for the wider team.
• Bring conversation designs, customer experience journeys, and prototypes to life in code, flagging technical constraints early and iterating quickly as designs evolve and as real usage data comes in.
• Support production rollout and adoption: write runbooks, train client teams on new AI-powered workflows, and help deliver a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
• Use AI-assisted engineering tools every day across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise the speed and quality of delivery.
• Contribute reusable components, accelerators, and lessons learned from the field so our teams deliver faster on the next engagement.
• Help onboard and mentor junior teammates, and contribute to project debriefs and team POVs.
Here's what you'll need:
• 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data or platform engineering, or a client-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, technical consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering. Experience should include hands-on experience building and deploying AI or LLM-powered applications, ideally integrated with real enterprise systems rather than prototypes or demos only.
• 1+ years of experience working on customer service, contact center, or customer experience projects or operations, with an understanding of the metrics that matter there, such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, and CSAT.
• 3+ years of experience programming skills in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java, plus SQL for querying data and validating pipelines.
• Willingness to travel regularly to client locations.
Bonus points if you have:
• Hands-on experience with API and enterprise system integration, including REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, authentication and identity (such as OAuth), and event-driven or messaging patterns.
• Hands-on experience integrating with enterprise platforms, ideally customer service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect, including their data models and platform-native connectors.
• Working knowledge of how AI agents call tools and external systems, including tool-use patterns such as MCP, on at least one enterprise agent platform such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, or Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
• Experience deploying on at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
• The ability to translate technical work into clear business value, and to communicate with everyone from developers to client leaders.
• Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with changing client requirements.
• Exposure to conversational AI across voice and digital channels, such as IVR modernization, chat and messaging, or intelligent routing.
• Experience with integration platforms or event streaming, such as MuleSoft or Kafka.
• Associate-level cloud certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate.
• A portfolio of real-world AI projects or deployed solutions you can walk us through.
• Experience with client-facing projects, ideally in consulting, agency, or other professional services.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

We Are
Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our client's needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people uses the coolest tech to out-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.
Do you have the deep functional and technical experience to help implement security solutions that align with our clients’ business objectives? Do you have the expertise to design and deliver solutions for establishing system user's credentials, and processes for applying those credentials to access enterprise systems and applications?
If so, read on and apply. Accenture’s more than 2,000 security professionals deliver holistic and proactive security solutions in 47 countries, and we’d love to discuss our open Identity and Access Management (I&AM) Security role with you
You Are
An engineer who has stayed an engineer. You came up building things, and you have no interest in a career track that takes that away. You're resourceful about how you get there. You know which problems call for a library, which call for a vendor product, and which call for writing the thing yourself. You read the spec instead of guessing what it says. You've debugged something at 2am because you wanted to know why it broke, not because anyone asked.
You've shipped code that other people depended on and that you were on the hook for when it broke. You go one layer deeper than the assignment required. You can explain a hard technical idea to someone who doesn't share your background without either condescending or hiding behind jargon.
You almost certainly haven't done this specific work before. Very few people have, which is most of why it's interesting.
The Work
The Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Identity Platform is a hands-on technical role. How much of any given week you spend writing code will vary by engagement, but you'll be expected to understand the systems you work on at implementation depth, and to be able to build in them when the work calls for it. If your recent experience is limited to producing architecture decks, running vendor implementations, or coordinating offshore delivery, this is probably not the right fit, and we would rather tell you now than in the third interview.
Enterprises are deploying AI agents faster than anyone has figured out how to secure them. An agent authenticates to twelve systems, spawns subagents, calls tools on behalf of a user who left the company last month and holds credentials nobody inventoried. The identity primitives that industry spent twenty years building for humans and service accounts don't cleanly extend to actors that are autonomous, ephemeral, and delegating authority to each other.
We're building the platforms that solve this: agent registries, delegated authorization models, runtime attribution, and policy engines that make decisions in single-digit milliseconds. Some of it ships to Fortune 100 clients. Some of it becomes the reference architecture the industry copies. There's no vendor product to install because in several of these areas the product doesn't exist yet.
You'd be a Forward Deployed Engineer, which means you write the code and you're in the room, possibly virtually, with the client while it runs in their environment.
Specifically:
• Build and ship services in the agentic identity stack: authorization engines, agent registries, credential brokers, and authentication layers for MCP servers
• Own a component end to end: design, implementation, deployment, and what happens when it fails at 3am
• Reverse-engineer how identity actually works in a client environment, then design what it should be
• Prototype against emerging standards and vendor betas, often before documentation exists
• Build the internal tooling and reference implementations the rest of the practice reuses
• Explain your design to a client's engineers and defend the parts they push back on
Most people arrive without the identity background, including people who are strong at all of it now. If you have some of it, tell us. If not, we'll teach you, and you'll learn it faster here than anywhere else because you'll be implementing the specs rather than reading about them.
What We'd Like to See
Optional, and not part of how we evaluate candidates. If you'd like to include a link to code you've written, an open-source contribution, or a technical writeup, we enjoy reading them. If your work is under NDA and you'd rather describe in prose what you built, what was hard about it, and what you'd change, that's equally welcome. Applications without either are considered on exactly the same basis.
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
Here's What You Need
• Minimum of 3 years of professional experience building and shipping production software
• Hands-on technical work within the last 18 months, counting production development, prototyping, or code review
• Minimum of 2 years of professional development in at least one of Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript, Java, or C++
• Minimum of 2 years building concurrent or distributed systems that ran in production
• Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience deploying and operating cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers and CI/CD pipelines
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science ( or equivalent) OR (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)
Professional Skills Requirements
• At least 1 production service or component you owned end to end, covering design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation
Bonus points if you have
• Experience with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token exchange, SAML, SPIFFE, PKI, or mTLS
• Experience with MCP, agent frameworks, or LLM application development
• Experience in identity and access management, IGA, PAM, secrets management, or non-human identity
• Applied cryptography experience, including enough to know what you don't know
• Participation in a production on-call rotation
• Judgment about which problems call for a library, which call for a vendor product, and which call for writing the thing yourself
• Comfort explaining a design to a client's engineers and defending the parts they push back on

Who we are:
Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.
Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.
Who you are:
You are an AI Solution Engineer who can turning AI into products people actually use. You embed directly with clients to build reliable, production AI products for customer service, integrating foundation models, RAG pipelines, agents, data services, and application components into the experiences customers and service employees rely on every day. You know the difference between a demo and a product, and you build for the product.
You are a builder who is just as comfortable in a client workshop as in a code editor. You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, moving between engagements, picking up new platforms quickly, and explaining technical choices in plain language to engineers and business stakeholders alike. Above all, you are a curious, collaborative teammate who makes the people around you better.
The work:
• Embed with client teams, on site and remote, to understand how their service operation really works, from contact center and agent workflows to the systems and data behind them.
• Join discovery workshops with client business and technology teams, helping identify, size, and prioritize the AI use cases with the highest impact on customers and the business.
• Build rapid prototypes, often within days, to show clients what is possible and prove value before a full build begins.
• Build and ship production AI applications for customer service: conversational AI agents across voice and digital channels, human agent-assist copilots, knowledge assistants, interaction summarization and quality automation, and analytics agents that let leaders ask questions of their service data in plain language.
• Integrate foundation models, RAG pipelines, agents, data services, and application components, and evaluate and configure models within the application, tuning prompts, context, retrieval, and model choice to optimize solution performance.
• Design how each AI agent behaves, including its instructions, memory, tools, and reasoning steps, and ground it in client knowledge through RAG pipelines, vector search, and knowledge graphs over knowledge bases, case history, and customer records.
• Build eval suites and guardrails that measure answer quality, catch regressions, and keep AI agent behavior safe and compliant as models, prompts, and data change.
• Write production-grade Python and TypeScript services with solid testing, logging, observability, and CI/CD, and balance the cost, latency, and safety tradeoffs that separate a demo from a system clients can run.
• Build AI features into the tools service agents and customers use every day, such as the agent desktop in contact center and CRM platforms, working with enterprise AI architecture engineer on the underlying system connections.
• Bring conversation designs, customer experience journeys, and prototypes to life in code, flagging technical constraints early and iterating quickly as designs evolve and as real usage data comes in.
• Support production rollout and adoption: write runbooks, train client teams on new AI-powered workflows, and help deliver a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
• Use AI-assisted engineering tools every day across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise the speed and quality of delivery.
• Contribute reusable components, accelerators, and lessons learned from the field so our teams deliver faster on the next engagement.
• Help onboard and mentor junior teammates, and contribute to project debriefs and team POVs.
Here's what you'll need:
• 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data or platform engineering, or a client-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, technical consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering. Experience should include:
• Hands-on experience building and deploying AI or LLM-powered applications, ideally integrated with real enterprise systems rather than prototypes or demos only.
• Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript, plus SQL for querying data and validating pipelines.
• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (such as Claude, Gemini, or GPT), prompt and context engineering, RAG pipelines and vector databases, and systematic model and prompt evaluation.
• Experience with agentic frameworks and tool-use patterns such as MCP, and with REST and GraphQL API integration.
• Experience deploying on at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), ideally using its AI and agent tooling, such as Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, or Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
• 1+ years of experience working on customer service, contact center, or customer experience projects or operations, with an understanding of the metrics that matter there, such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, and CSAT.
• Willingness to travel regularly to client locations.
Bonus points if you have:
• Experience with conversational AI and agent platforms such as Google Customer Engagement Suite, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Salesforce Agentforce, or ServiceNow AI Agents.
• Experience with contact center or CRM platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect.
• Exposure to conversation intelligence, such as speech and interaction analytics, sentiment, or automated quality assurance.
• A full-stack engineering background in web, mobile, or API development.
• A portfolio of real-world AI projects or deployed solutions you can walk us through.
• Experience with client-facing projects, ideally in consulting, agency, or other professional services.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

This high-impact role sits at the intersection of biopharma R&D, digital innovation, and enterprise transformation — advising R&D leaders at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
You will lead end-to-end strategy engagements, build lasting client relationships across R&D functions, drive business development, and contribute to practice growth through thought leadership and capability building. This is a balanced role: part trusted advisor, part business builder, part practice champion. You will be expected to partner across the various Accenture businesses to be successful in this role.
We Are:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at www.accenture.com .
Accenture's Life Sciences R&D practice helps biopharma organizations transform discovery, early development, and development operations through scientific strategy, data and AI integration, and operational reinvention. We work with R&D leaders — Chief Scientific and Medical Officers, Heads of R&D Functions, SVP and VP-level capability owners — to shape R&D strategy, accelerate pipeline decisions, and build the capabilities needed to compete in the age of AI-driven drug discovery and development.
This is a growth-focused practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.
You Are:
An R&D expert with proven work experience in the Life Sciences R&D industry. You are a strategic problem solver with extensive consulting and industry experience. You are a clear and effective communicator, and you have an open, relatable manner with clients and colleagues. You perform well in an agile, fast-paced working environment. You know how to balance being a leader with contributing to the collective efforts of the team. You have led business development and sales origination efforts to provide transformative programs and targeted consulting engagements.
You have energy and drive in abundance, along with personal resilience, a passion for serving clients, and a love of continual learning. You have a flair for breaking down challenges and processes into logical parts and constructing crystal-clear reasoning and analyses—an aptitude you use to decimate problems.
The Work (Role Responsibility)
• Lead complex R&D strategy engagements from problem framing through delivery, ensuring measurable client impact.
• Advise clients on R&D transformation priorities including strategy, pipeline portfolio management, scientific data and AI integration, R&D operational excellence, R&D operating model, etc.
• Develop and present strategic recommendations, transformation roadmaps, and reinvention narratives to Heads of R&D functions, and other senior stakeholders.
• Serve as a guiding presence throughout the program lifecycle — shaping critical program stages, driving quality assurance, and ensuring delivery excellence on large-scale engagements.
• Build, manage, and grow senior client relationships across biopharma R&D functions.
• Partner with the broader Accenture team to bring the tailored expertise needed for an individual R&D Strategy engagement in support of our clients (e.g., Data & AI, Technology Strategy & Advisory, Talent & Organization)
• Originate and shape new opportunities, lead proposals and commercial pursuits, and contribute to Accenture's pipeline growth in the Life Sciences R&D space.
• Identify adjacent opportunities and expand existing client relationships across the R&D value chain.
• Represent Accenture's R&D Strategy point of view in client briefings, industry forums, and executive conversations
• Develop and contribute to thought leadership on R&D transformation, AI-driven discovery and development, and scientific innovation — publishing assets that establish Accenture's differentiated perspective in the market.
• Build reusable offerings, frameworks, and assets that accelerate future client engagements.
• Mentor and develop junior colleagues; actively contribute to performance management and recruiting.
• Partner with Accenture’s global industry leads, capability leads, and cross-functional teams to evolve the R&D Strategy practice and go-to-market strategy.
Here’s What You Need (Basic Qualifications)
Candidates must have at least 8 years of combined experience in the following areas:
• Deep expertise in Life Sciences R&D with experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm or a leading biopharma company in an R&D strategy or transformation function.
• A proven track record leading strategy engagements with measurable outcomes for biopharma clients.
• Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations and transformation roadmaps to C-suite, SVP, and VP-level R&D stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of how AI, data, digital technologies, and scientific informatics are reshaping biopharma R&D — and the ability to translate that understanding into client strategy.
• Demonstrated success in business development: identifying opportunities, shaping proposals, and building senior client relationships.
• Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing junior professionals.
• Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as client and business needs require.
Bachelor's degree
Bonus Points (Preferred Skills)
• MBA, advanced scientific degree (PhD, PharmD, MD), or equivalent combination of education and experience in a relevant discipline.
• Experience building or scaling a new strategy offering, practice area, or capability from the ground up.
• Track record developing thought leadership — whitepapers, conference presentations, or published perspectives — in the life sciences or R&D space.
• Exercise operating across multiple biopharma sub-sectors (large pharma, emerging biotech, CROs, or medtech) and geographies

wd:nvidia/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite:JR203:
GPU clusters fail. Workloads crash at 3am, AI teams file tickets pointing at hardware, hardware teams point back at software, and the actual cause stays unknown until someone with deep enough context digs through DCGM metrics, XID history, and NCCL traces. That forensics work shouldn't fall to a human on-call every time. We're building the platform that automates it, and we need a PM who has been that on-call engineer.
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own workload failure attribution: how a GPU cluster figures out whether a failed job was caused by hardware, system software, or application code, and how that verdict gets surfaced to operators, schedulers, and the open source developer surface built on top of it. You will own the roadmap and work directly with the engineering and operations communities who deploy and extend this platform. This role is part of NVIDIA's DSX Platform, NVIDIA's open, modular infrastructure software for designing, operating, and optimizing AI factories at scale. No prior product management title required. If you are a deeply technical product manager, architect, SRE, or infra engineer who has lived the GPU cluster failure-triage problem, we want to hear from you.
What You'll Be Doing:
• Drive the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for workload failure attribution, in close collaboration with engineering on architecture and prioritization.
• Identify gaps in how customers and partners triage GPU cluster failures at scale and define new attribution capabilities to close them, including how an NCCL timeout gets attributed to hardware, system software, or application, and which signals belong in a public API vs. an entitled runtime extension.
• Work directly with cloud partners and cluster operators to translate their operational triage requirements into platform capabilities.
• Drive community engagement strategy for the open source attribution project, including contribution models, ecosystem partnerships, and developer adoption.
What We Need To See:
• 12+ years total experience.
• 5+ years in product management, solutions architecture, software engineering, or site reliability engineering on technical infrastructure products. Technical depth on GPU or AI infra is required.
• Familiarity with GPU failure modes: XID codes, ECC correctable and uncorrectable errors, DCGM metrics, NVLink and PCIe health signals.
• Technical understanding of why AI workloads fail: GPU hardware failure modes, distributed training failure patterns (NCCL timeouts, framework errors, hardware vs. system software vs. application fault distinction), and the telemetry systems (DCGM, sysfs, dmesg) that surface these signals.
• Demonstrated ability to work with senior technical customers and translate operational requirements into product decisions.
• Strong written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:
• Former SRE or infra engineer on GPU clusters. You have triaged job failures, parsed XID logs, and understand the cross-team deep dives that happen when a multi-thousand-GPU training run fails.
• Deep familiarity with GPU scheduling, topology-aware placement, or multi-tenant GPU cluster management: Slurm prolog/epilog, Kueue, or Kubernetes-native scheduler environments.
• Experience building products that produce structured diagnostics or attribution output: health verdict schemas, log analysis pipelines, rules-engine systems, or observability APIs at data center scale.
• Practical experience delivering or contributing to an open-source infrastructure project, including managing contributor engagement on GitHub.

• Lead and influence a multidisciplinary team towards shared goals, defining the discrete opportunities that are both impactful and achievable.

Role Impact
The Stars Population Health Business Intelligence Lead is a senior, hands-on technical analytics role embedded within the Stars Population Health Strategy team . This individual will independently work with large, complex healthcare datasets to develop advanced analytics, business intelligence solutions, measurement capabilities, and decision-ready insights that inform population health strategy and execution.
This role requires an experienced analytics professional who can operate across the full analytical lifecycle: translating an ambiguous business problem into an analytical approach, querying and manipulating underlying data, building analytical and business intelligence products, interpreting results, and translating findings into actionable recommendations for business and executive leaders.

• Provide independent, data-supported recommendations and influence cross-functional partners to establish shared accountability for Stars Population Health priorities and results.

• Cross-functional delivery: Partner with engineers, data scientists, and designers to deliver against roadmap and milestones, and contribute to shared playbooks, skills, and patterns.
• Governed delivery: Prepare the documentation, scorecards, and technical detail needed to move your solution through Humana's enterprise AI governance (AIRB, LRC, Responsible AI Council).
• Communication: Communicate progress, requirements, trade-offs, ROI, and eval results clearly to business and technical stakeholders.

The Manager, Solution Enablement – Order-to-Invoice Integration leads cross-capability functional and technical-functional integration activities supporting the end-to-end Order-to-Invoice (OTI) value stream and manages a team responsible for integration and Solution Enablement activities.
The role maintains an end-to-end view of dependencies across Order Management, aATP/BOP, Fulfillment, Inventory, Warehousing, Transportation, Global Trade, Intercompany, Shipping, Customer Returns, Billing, Master Data, and connected enterprise solutions. The Manager identifies cross-capability dependencies, integration risks, and systemic solution gaps and coordinates resolution with the appropriate accountable teams.
The successful candidate will combine strong business-process and SAP S/4HANA knowledge with systems thinking, people leadership, and the ability to connect business requirements with functional and technical solution implications in a complex global environment.
Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Solution Integration
Coordinate functional integration activities supporting the OTI value stream, maintaining an end-to-end view of processes, solutions, data, integrations, controls, and dependencies.
Assess solution designs and capability decisions for upstream and downstream impacts and identify cross-capability risks, gaps, and conflicting assumptions.
Coordinate resolution of cross-functional dependencies with the appropriate accountable teams, including Business Process, Solution Enablement, Solution Architecture, Technology/JJT, Data, Finance, Logistics, Commercial, Testing, and other stakeholders.
Apply strong functional knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash and Logistics to assess business-process, configuration, data, interface, and integration dependencies.
Support structured root-cause analysis and resolution of complex issues spanning multiple business processes, applications, integrations, and data domains.
Escalate unresolved integration risks and dependencies through established governance and decision channels.
OTI Capability Integration
Coordinate integration dependencies across Order Management, aATP/BOP, Fulfillment, Inventory, Warehousing, Transportation, Global Trade, Intercompany, Shipping, Customer Returns, Billing, and Master Data.
Evaluate the end-to-end impacts of availability, allocation, sourcing, fulfillment, logistics, intercompany, and billing decisions.
Identify critical master and transactional data dependencies across OTI capabilities and connected enterprise solutions.
Partner with accountable Business, Architecture, Technology, Finance, Tax, Trade Compliance, Data, and Solution Enablement teams to resolve cross-functional dependencies within established decision rights.
Testing & Deployment Readiness
Identify critical end-to-end business and integration scenarios required to validate OTI functional integration.
Partner with Testing and Quality teams to support appropriate coverage during system integration testing, end-to-end testing, business simulation, and regression testing.
Assess defects and test results for broader cross-capability or systemic impacts and coordinate resolution with the appropriate accountable teams.
Provide an OTI integration perspective into design, testing, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization readiness assessments.
Escalate unresolved integration issues or dependencies that may affect readiness through established governance.
Apply deployment and production learnings to support continuous improvement.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop team members supporting OTI integration and Solution Enablement activities.
Establish clear priorities, objectives, performance expectations, and accountability aligned with Solution Enablement and value-stream priorities.
Allocate resources based on business priorities, program demand, critical milestones, workload, capability needs, and development opportunities.
Build team capabilities in SAP S/4HANA, OTI business processes, systems thinking, integration analysis, structured problem solving, testing, and deployment readiness.
Promote cross-training and knowledge sharing to strengthen functional depth and end-to-end OTI capability.
Support talent development, career development, and succession planning.
Foster an inclusive, collaborative, accountable, and continuous-learning team environment.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Continuous Improvement
Build effective partnerships across Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Solution Architecture, Technology/JJT, Data, Testing, Compliance, and Operations.
Create clarity around cross-functional dependencies, assumptions, handoffs, accountabilities, and escalation paths.
Anticipate integration risks and engage accountable teams before issues affect program milestones or business outcomes.
Lead through expertise, influence, collaboration, and effective decision facilitation within established governance.
Promote global-template adoption, standardization, simplification, reuse, automation, and continuous improvement.
Identify opportunities to apply analytics, process mining, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve business and Solution Enablement outcomes.
Qualifications:
Education
• Minimum of a Bachelor’s or equivalent University Degree required; Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Operations, or a related discipline is preferred.
Experience & Skills
Required
• Minimum of 8 years of relevant business or functional experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Order-to-Cash/Order-to-Invoice, ERP, enterprise technology, digital transformation, or related disciplines.

The VSL will provide end-to-end leadership across reporting discovery, impact assessment, solution disposition, requirements, delivery, validation, deployment and adoption. The role will bridge MAKE business processes and the technical reporting ecosystem, ensuring that changes to SAP transactions, master data, interfaces and data structures are understood and addressed across downstream reporting and analytics solutions.
Each report will be assessed to determine whether it should be:
· Rebuilt for SAP S/4HANA
· Retired because it is no longer required
· Replaced by a standard Digital Brain report or dashboard
· Remediated by mapping/replacing legacy data through CDL
· Temporarily supported during the legacy/SAP S/4HANA transition
· Assigned an accountable solution owner, delivery team, technical dependency plan, testing approach and sustainable post-go-live support model.
The VSL will own the resulting cross-site reporting backlog and drive requirements, prioritization, remediation, testing, business validation, deployment and change management.
The VSL will work closely with each site’s SMEs and leadership to ensure users understand what is changing, which legacy reports will be retired, what the future-state solution will be and how reporting will operate after go-live.
The VSL will promote reuse of Global Template and enterprise reporting solutions, challenge unnecessary local variations, and reduce duplicate, obsolete or unsupported reports rather than recreating the legacy reporting landscape in the future-state environment.
Primary Accountability:
Ensure every business-critical MAKE report required to operate each manufacturing site has a defined future-state solution and is tested, validated and available when the site goes live on Transcend.
Ensure reporting solutions remain accurate, controlled and operational as SAP S/4HANA changes source data, master data, interfaces, business processes and downstream data dependencies.

The Finance Leadership Development Program (FLDP) is a 30-month program built for recent graduates who want to grow into future finance leaders. You will build leadership and technical skills through hands-on rotational assignments, formal training, and ongoing coaching. The program includes two rotations: an 18-month first rotation followed by a 12-month second rotation. These experiences are designed to accelerate your development by working in different finance and accounting areas across Johnson & Johnson businesses and locations.
For this role, first rotation placement to be located in El Paso, Texas / Juarez, Mexico supporting the MedTech Supply Chain business. Second rotation would be a relocation to one of our many New Jersey/Pennsylvania locations supporting either Innovative Medicine, MedTech or Corporate segments.
In addition to your rotations, you will complete five weeks of training throughout the program, led by internal and external experts. This interactive learning experience is designed to strengthen your business knowledge and help you build skills in problem-solving, analysis, teamwork, leadership, and technical finance work.
Through the program, you may gain experience across Johnson & Johnson MedTech, Innovative Medicine, and Corporate Headquarters. Each rotation is designed to give you meaningful experience, help you apply what you know, and expand your professional network across the company. You may work in areas such as Financial Planning and Analysis, Commercial Finance, Supply Chain Finance, Research & Development Finance, General Accounting, Corporate Consolidations, Treasury, Global Audit & Assurance, and Finance Solutions & Technology.
The FLDP and the Johnson & Johnson Finance organization also encourage participants to pursue professional certifications such as the CMA or CPA.
Dual United States & Mexican citizenship is required

We are searching for the best talent for a Crowdsourcing Strategic Planning & Operations Manager to be located in Cambridge, MA or New Brunswick, NJ.
Purpose: Johnson & Johnson External Scientific Innovation (ESI) is dedicated to identifying and enabling early-stage scientific innovations that have the potential to transform patient health outcomes worldwide.
The Global Scientific Sourcing (GSS) team supports this mission through scientific search and landscaping, crowdsourcing programs, notably QuickFire Challenges (QFCs), and infrastructure advancement. QFCs invite innovators to address real-world challenges across Therapeutics and MedTech, offering awards such as funding, access to world-class laboratory facilities, and connections to a global network of industry experts.
GSS is seeking a Strategic Planning & Operations Manager to support the strategic planning, design, and delivery of QuickFire Challenges. This role collaborates with internal and external partners to translate scientific and business priorities into well-defined challenge strategies, application materials, evaluation approaches, and implementation plans. Working closely with operational support, the manager aligns partners on objectives, key decisions, timelines, and outcomes while guiding continuous improvement of the QFC program, tools, and processes. The role also contributes to the ongoing strategy, scaling, and future direction of GSS crowdsourcing capabilities.
You will be responsible for:
Strategic Planning & Challenge Design
• Partnering with Therapeutic Area teams and other internal and external partners to define each challenge’s scientific focus, business objectives, scope, and intended outcomes.
• Translating challenge objectives into application questions, eligibility requirements, evaluation criteria, and review approaches that capture relevant information and support informed selection decisions.
• Developing challenge plans and timelines with operational support, aligning collaborators on deliverables, dependencies, responsibilities, and key decision points.
• Contributing to the ongoing strategy, scaling, and future direction of the QFC program, incorporating partner feedback and lessons learned.
Program Delivery & Partner Alignment
• Leading cross-functional working group discussions to align challenge strategy, resolve issues, and advance key decisions across development, launch, review, and award stages.
• Partnering with Legal, Healthcare Compliance, Digital Engagement, J&J Technology, Therapeutic Area teams, and external vendors to align program requirements, communications, approvals, and launch readiness.
• Providing program-level oversight of achievements, risks, and dependencies, working with operational support to address issues and advance decisions as needed.
• Guiding the application review and judging approach, including reviewer guidance and synthesis of findings, while partnering with the broader team on reviewer onboarding, score collection, scheduling, and review materials.
• Guiding communications and engagement approaches for applicants, finalists, and awardees, with day-to-day correspondence and administrative coordination supported by the coordinator.
• Working with vendors and consultants to align deliverables, timelines, and budget requirements with challenge objectives.
Program Insights & Continuous Improvement
• Managing the assessment and synthesis of application data, challenge metrics, and partner feedback to communicate outcomes and inform future challenge design.
• Maintaining and improving the QFC toolkit, playbook, templates, and operational guidance to support consistent, scalable program delivery.
• Identifying and prioritizing process improvements and automation opportunities, including appropriate use of Copilot, in partnership with operational support and relevant functional teams.
• Helping define business requirements and evaluate crowdsourcing technologies, including application and review portals, while partnering with operational support on testing, implementation, and day-to-day administration.

Education:
• A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required, preferably in a STEM-related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
Experience and Skills:
Required:
• 6+ years of relevant professional experience in strategic planning, consulting, program management, business operations, or a related field is required.
• Strong personal leadership, organizational skills, and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently across multiple functions and priorities, are required.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams) is required.
Preferred:
• Strong business writing and presentation skills are preferred.
• Experience in a health care setting, organization or industry association is preferred.
• Experience working with and managing vendors and consultants, and managing budgets is preferred.
• Experience translating partner needs into project plans, application materials, evaluation frameworks, or process improvements is preferred.
• Familiarity with Salesforce, project management tools such as Wrike, and Copilot is preferred.
