This role will support cross‑functional CAR‑T initiatives across the U.S. and Canada. This role sits within the Advanced Therapies team , responsible for delivering technology capabilities that support CAR‑T Patient Services, Commercial Operations, and Medical Affairs.
This leader will bridge business needs and technical delivery, ensuring robust, compliant, and scalable digital solutions that support the end‑to‑end cell therapy process. The role blends technical product ownership, process mapping, requirement analysis, stakeholder management, and solution design, with a focus on enabling a seamless and high‑quality CAR‑T patient experience.
In addition to core technical product ownership, this role serves as the primary liaison for the contact center. The role is a part‑time Technical Product Owner (TPO) for the Patient Support team and the TPO for the telephony system, owning requirements gathering for telephony enhancements that improve the patient and agent experience.
Key Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with Designers, Functional Analysts and Solution Architects to convert requirements into system designs, including workflows, data models, integration points, and user interactions.
• Drive clarity in requirements by validating and updating existing business processes, workflows, and system interactions for upcoming releases.
• Lead requirement gathering in an Agile delivery model, partnering closely with functional analysts, business product owners, and architecture teams to capture business needs and operational challenges.
• Partner with product and functional analysts to maintain and prioritize the product backlog, supporting scope definition and release planning.
• Participate in and at times lead white‑boarding sessions to ensure technical direction aligns with business objectives, representing the voice of the business.
• Coordinate and facilitate meetings, workshops, grooming sessions, and cross‑functional reviews to gather feedback and resolve open questions.
• Act as a primary liaison between the MyCARVYKTI Patient Support team and technical teams to ensure timely resolution of issues and transparent flow of information.
• Serve as the primary liaison for the contact center, representing agent, supervisor, and operations needs to technical teams and vendors and ensuring transparent communication on priorities, issues, and releases.
• Own the product vision, backlog, and roadmap for the telephony system (Genesys and Service Cloud Voice), including gathering, documenting, and prioritizing requirements for enhancements such as routing, IVR, call flows, reporting, and CRM integration.
• Serve as part‑time Technical Product Owner for the Patient Support team, partnering with Patient Support leadership to translate operational needs into prioritized, actionable requirements.
• Balance priorities between the telephony platform and Patient Support needs, aligning contact center enhancements with broader Advanced Therapies release planning and compliance requirements.
• Collaborate with testing teams to define business scenarios and test cases to validate system functionality against requirements.
• Partner with the business and Functional Analyst teams to prepare for and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring proper documentation of findings.
Qualifications
Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in technology product management, business analysis, or systems implementation.
• Demonstrated experience in Agile delivery, including requirement elicitation, backlog management, and user story development.
• Hands‑on experience with contact center telephony platforms, specifically Genesys and Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, including gathering and documenting requirements for enhancements.
• Strong ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and partner with architects, engineers, and testing teams.
• Excellent process‑mapping skills and experience documenting operational workflows.
• Strong communication, facilitation, and relationship‑management capabilities across cross‑functional teams.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive clarity in ambiguous situations, and work effectively in fast‑moving, highly collaborative environments.
Preferred:
• Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or advanced therapies (CAR‑T, cell therapy) environments.
• Exposure to patient services, case management workflows, or commercial operations within healthcare.
• Experience serving as a liaison to a contact center or customer support organization, with familiarity in call routing, IVR, agent workflows, and contact center reporting and analytics.
• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, process‑mapping tools (e.g., Visio), and enterprise product delivery frameworks.
• Understanding of regulated environments, including compliance, quality, privacy, and data‑security considerations.
